// =========================================================
// WORKER ROUTER
// =========================================================

export default {
  async fetch(
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );
	  
    const v13Response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestWithCors(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (v13Response) {
      return v13Response;
    }	  

    const origin =
      request.headers.get(
        "Origin"
      ) || "";

    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * CORS
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * The TV may eventually be opened directly as its own
     * Worker page OR called from lokiskingdom.com.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "OPTIONS"
    ) {
      return handleCorsPreflight(
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HEALTH CHECK
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/health"
    ) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          ok:
            true,

          resident:
            "recall-thy-name",

          network:
            "CRYPT NETWORK",

          year:
            1985,

          model:
            RECALL_MODEL,

          databaseAvailable:
            Boolean(
              env.WORLD_DB
            ),

          openAIConfigured:
            Boolean(
              env.OPENAI_API_KEY
            ),

          version:
            RECALL_ENGINE_VERSION
        },
        200,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * COMPLETE PUBLIC SHOW STATE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Used when:
     *
     * - the page opens;
     * - the TV turns on;
     * - the page refreshes;
     * - the UI needs authoritative counters;
     * - the client needs current combat/show state.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/state"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleState(
          request,
          env,
          url
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * TURN TELEVISION ON
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/tv/on"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleTurnTvOn(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * TURN TELEVISION OFF
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/tv/off"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleTurnTvOff(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * LIVE WATCH-TIME HEARTBEAT
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * The browser periodically reports that the television
     * is still actively open.
     *
     * The server remains authoritative for cumulative
     * watch time.
     *
     * We do NOT trust a browser-supplied number of seconds.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/tv/heartbeat"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleWatchHeartbeat(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * NEXT AUTONOMOUS HOST TURN
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Later parts implement:
     *
     * - conversation modes;
     * - character selection;
     * - personality prompts;
     * - memory;
     * - topic drift;
     * - TTS completion sequencing;
     * - combat dialogue.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/show/next"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleNextShowTurn(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }
	
	/*
	 * -------------------------------------------------------
	 * ANDROID BACKGROUND / POCKET MODE NEXT TURN
	 * -------------------------------------------------------
	 *
	 * Uses the exact same authoritative conversation engine
	 * as /show/next.
	 *
	 * The Android foreground media service calls this route
	 * after native Polly playback finishes while the WebView
	 * is asleep.
	 */

	if (
	  request.method ===
		"POST" &&
	  url.pathname ===
		"/show/background-next"
	) {
	  const response =
		await handleNextShowTurn(
		  request,
		  env
		);

	  return addCorsToResponse(
		response,
		origin
	  );
	}

	/*
	 * -------------------------------------------------------
	 * AMAZON POLLY TEXT TO SPEECH
	 * -------------------------------------------------------
	 *
	 * Server-side AWS credentials never reach the browser.
	 *
	 * Browser sends:
	 *
	 * {
	 *   text,
	 *   voice
	 * }
	 *
	 * Worker returns:
	 *
	 * audio/mpeg
	 */

	if (
	  request.method ===
		"POST" &&
	  url.pathname ===
		"/tts"
	) {
	  const response =
		await handlePollyTts(
		  request,
		  env
		);

	  return addCorsToResponse(
		response,
		origin
	  );
	}

    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * AUDIENCE INTERRUPTION
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Player input has conversational priority.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/show/interject"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleAudienceInterjection(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * CURRENT HOST
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/host"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleCurrentHost(
          request,
          env,
          url
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HOST STORE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Generates the current casting selection.
     *
     * Default:
     *
     *     7 candidates
     *
     * Price is NOT a simple combat-power ladder.
     *
     * Clothing, novelty, rarity, appearance, absurdity,
     * luxury and cosmetics may make a weak host cost more
     * than an apocalyptic god.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/host-store"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleHostStore(
          request,
          env,
          url
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HIRE HOST
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/host-store/hire"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleHireHost(
          request,
          env
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * TODAY IN 1985
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/today-in-1985"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleTodayIn1985(
          request,
          env,
          url
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * JUKEBOX PUBLIC CATALOG
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * The actual catalogue/player integration arrives
     * in a later part.
     */

    if (
      request.method ===
        "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/jukebox/catalog"
    ) {
      const response =
        await handleJukeboxCatalog(
          request,
          env,
          url
        );

      return addCorsToResponse(
        response,
        origin
      );
    }


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * MAIN TELEVISION PAGE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * HTML is defined in a later part.
     */

    return new Response(
      buildRecallV14FinalHtml(),
      {
        headers: {
          "content-type":
            "text/html; charset=UTF-8",

          "cache-control":
            "no-store"
        }
      }
    );
  }
};

// PRIMARY CONFIGURATION
// =========================================================

const RECALL_ENGINE_VERSION =
  "recall-thy-name-v1";


/*
 * We deliberately use the same GPT model family already
 * established for The Wizard.
 */

const RECALL_MODEL =
  "gpt-5.4";


const OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL =
  "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses";

const RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MODEL =
  "@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast";


const RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MAX_TOKENS =
  2800;


async function callRecallSallyBrain(
  env,
  {
    instructions,
    input,
    maxOutputTokens =
      RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MAX_TOKENS
  }
) {
  if (!env?.AI) {
    throw new Error(
      'SALLY BRAIN unavailable: add a Workers AI binding named "AI".'
    );
  }


  const messages = [
    {
      role:
        "system",

      content:
        String(
          instructions || ""
        )
    },

    {
      role:
        "user",

      content:
        String(
          input || ""
        )
    }
  ];


  const result =
    await env.AI.run(
      RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MODEL,
      {
        messages,

        max_tokens:
          Math.max(
            256,
            Math.min(
              RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MAX_TOKENS,
              integerNumber(
                maxOutputTokens,
                RECALL_SALLY_BRAIN_MAX_TOKENS
              )
            )
          ),

        temperature:
          0.8,

        repetition_penalty:
          1.08
      }
    );

  let text =
    "";


  if (
    typeof result?.response ===
      "string"
  ) {
    text =
      result.response;
  } else if (
    result?.response &&
    typeof result.response ===
      "object"
  ) {
    text =
      result.response.text ||
      result.response.response ||
      "";
  }


  text =
    String(
      text || ""
    ).trim();


  if (!text) {
    throw new Error(
      "SALLY BRAIN returned no spoken dialogue."
    );
  }


  return text
    .slice(
      0,
      MAX_MODEL_REPLY_LENGTH
    )
    .trim();
}

/*
 * THE NAMELESS MAN IS ONE PERSON.
 *
 * His voice does not reroll with hosts.
 */

const POLLY_NAMELESS_VOICE =
  "Matthew";


function choosePollyHostVoice(
  sex
) {
  const pool =
    sex ===
      "male"
        ? POLLY_MALE_HOST_VOICES
        : POLLY_FEMALE_HOST_VOICES;


  return pool[
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() *
      pool.length
    )
  ];
}


function isValidPollyVoice(
  voice
) {
  return POLLY_ALLOWED_GENERATIVE_VOICES
    .includes(
      voice
    );
}

/*
 * THIS IS IMPORTANT:
 *
 * A weak host wearing expensive sneakers may cost:
 *
 *     5,000 gold
 *
 * A naked God-Titan capable of dominating the
 * Nameless Man for years may cost:
 *
 *     1,000 gold
 *
 * That is intentional.
 *
 * Price primarily represents:
 *
 * - cosmetics;
 * - clothing;
 * - luxury;
 * - novelty;
 * - rarity;
 * - presentation;
 * - absurdity;
 * - collectability.
 *
 * Raw combat effectiveness can influence price,
 * but MUST NOT dominate it.
 *
 * The Host Store is casting.
 *
 * It is NOT a linear difficulty ladder.
 */

// =========================================================
// DATABASE ACCESS
// =========================================================

function requireWorldDatabase(
  env
) {
  if (!env.WORLD_DB) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing D1 binding. Add the shared Loki\'s Kingdom database as "WORLD_DB".'
    );
  }

  return env.WORLD_DB;
}


// =========================================================
// DATABASE CREATION
// =========================================================

async function ensureRecallDatabase(
  env
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  await db.batch([
    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * MASTER SHOW STATE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_show_state (
        visitor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        state_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * CONVERSATION LOG
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_conversation_log (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        visitor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        episode_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        speaker TEXT NOT NULL,
        speaker_name TEXT,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        conversation_mode TEXT,
        topic TEXT,
        lock_type TEXT,
        show_state TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    db.prepare(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
      idx_recall_conversation_visitor
      ON recall_conversation_log(
        visitor_id,
        id
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * DURABLE MEMORIES
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_memories (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        visitor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        character_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        importance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    db.prepare(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
      idx_recall_memories_visitor_character
      ON recall_memories(
        visitor_id,
        character_key,
        id
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * EPISODE HISTORY
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_episodes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        visitor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        episode_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
        host_id TEXT,
        host_name TEXT,
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        ended_at TEXT,
        historical_date TEXT,
        opening_topic TEXT,
        combat_started INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        host_died INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      )
    `),


    db.prepare(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
      idx_recall_episodes_visitor
      ON recall_episodes(
        visitor_id,
        episode_number
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HOST ARCHIVE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Dead or former hosts remain historically real.
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_host_archive (
        host_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        visitor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        host_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        host_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        hired_at TEXT,
        died_at TEXT,
        death_episode INTEGER,
        cause_of_death TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    db.prepare(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
      idx_recall_host_archive_visitor
      ON recall_host_archive(
        visitor_id,
        created_at
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HOST STORE SNAPSHOTS
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * The seven candidates remain stable until the store
     * is intentionally rerolled or consumed.
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_host_store (
        visitor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        generation_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        candidates_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * HISTORICAL 1985 EVENT CACHE
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Later parts may populate this manually or through
     * controlled historical retrieval.
     *
     * We store original factual summaries, not copied
     * newspaper articles.
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_1985_events (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        date_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT NOT NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_name TEXT,
        source_reference TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    db.prepare(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
      idx_recall_1985_events_date
      ON recall_1985_events(
        date_key,
        id
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * DAILY EVENT DISCUSSION HISTORY
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_event_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        visitor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        date_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        episode_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        discussed_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * WATCH HEARTBEATS
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * This supports server-authoritative accumulated
     * viewing statistics.
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_watch_sessions (
        visitor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        session_started_at TEXT,
        last_heartbeat_at TEXT,
        accumulated_seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `),


    /*
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     * REQUEST LOCK
     * -------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Prevent overlapping AI turns for one visitor.
     *
     * Especially important because autonomous dialogue can
     * otherwise race itself when the browser fires multiple
     * completion events.
     */

    db.prepare(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_request_locks (
        visitor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        locked_until_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `)
  ]);
}


// =========================================================
// STATE NORMALIZATION — SMALL GENERIC HELPERS
// =========================================================

function finiteNumber(
  value,
  fallback = 0
) {
  const number =
    Number(value);

  return Number.isFinite(
    number
  )
    ? number
    : fallback;
}


function integerNumber(
  value,
  fallback = 0
) {
  return Math.floor(
    finiteNumber(
      value,
      fallback
    )
  );
}


function clamp(
  value,
  minimum,
  maximum
) {
  return Math.min(
    maximum,
    Math.max(
      minimum,
      value
    )
  );
}


function normalizeBoolean(
  value,
  fallback = false
) {
  return typeof value ===
    "boolean"
      ? value
      : fallback;
}


function normalizeString(
  value,
  fallback = "",
  maxLength = 10_000
) {
  const text =
    typeof value ===
      "string"
      ? value
      : fallback;

  return text
    .slice(
      0,
      maxLength
    );
}


function validIsoDate(
  value
) {
  if (
    typeof value !==
      "string"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const timestamp =
    Date.parse(
      value
    );

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      timestamp
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return new Date(
    timestamp
  )
    .toISOString();
}


// =========================================================
// VISITOR ID NORMALIZATION
// =========================================================

function normalizeVisitorId(
  input
) {
  const value =
    String(
      input || ""
    )
      .trim();

  if (
    value.length < 8 ||
    value.length > 200
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$/
      .test(
        value
      )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return value;
}


// =========================================================
// SHARED PLAYER WORLD STATE
// =========================================================

/*
 * recall thy name uses the SAME world_state wallet
 * as Loki's Kingdom's other residents.
 *
 * We do not create a second fake pile of gold.
 */

function createFallbackWorldState() {
  const now =
    new Date()
      .toISOString();

  return {
    player: {
      hp:
        100,

      maxHp:
        100,

      hunger:
        0,

      money:
        0,

      conditions:
        [],

      inventory:
        [],

      equipment:
        {},

      spellsKnown:
        []
    },

    lastUpdatedAt:
      now
  };
}


// =========================================================
// RECALL STATE NORMALIZATION
// =========================================================

function normalizeRecallState(
  candidate
) {
  const fallback =
    createDefaultRecallState();

  const source =
    candidate &&
    typeof candidate ===
      "object"
      ? candidate
      : {};

  const televisionSource =
    source.television &&
    typeof source.television ===
      "object"
      ? source.television
      : {};

  const watchSource =
    source.watch &&
    typeof source.watch ===
      "object"
      ? source.watch
      : {};

  const calendarSource =
    source.calendar &&
    typeof source.calendar ===
      "object"
      ? source.calendar
      : {};

  const conversationSource =
    source.conversation &&
    typeof source.conversation ===
      "object"
      ? source.conversation
      : {};

  const combatSource =
    source.combat &&
    typeof source.combat ===
      "object"
      ? source.combat
      : {};

  const hostStoreSource =
    source.hostStore &&
    typeof source.hostStore ===
      "object"
      ? source.hostStore
      : {};

  const jukeboxSource =
    source.jukebox &&
    typeof source.jukebox ===
      "object"
      ? source.jukebox
      : {};

  /*
   * More detailed host/nameless normalization is added
   * in the Host Store and combat parts.
   *
   * For now preserve valid object state or use defaults.
   */

  const host =
    source.host &&
    typeof source.host ===
      "object"
      ? source.host
      : fallback.host;

  const nameless =
    source.nameless &&
    typeof source.nameless ===
      "object"
      ? source.nameless
      : fallback.nameless;

  const allowedShowStates =
    new Set([
      SHOW_STATE_OFF,
      SHOW_STATE_CONVERSATION,
      SHOW_STATE_HOSTILITY,
      SHOW_STATE_COMBAT,
      SHOW_STATE_HOST_DEAD,
      SHOW_STATE_HOST_STORE
    ]);

  const showState =
    allowedShowStates.has(
      televisionSource.showState
    )
      ? televisionSource.showState
      : fallback
          .television
          .showState;

  const lockType =
    (
      conversationSource
        .lockType ===
          LOCK_NONE ||
      LOCK_TYPES.includes(
        conversationSource
          .lockType
      )
    )
      ? conversationSource
          .lockType
      : LOCK_NONE;

  return {
    version:
      RECALL_ENGINE_VERSION,

    television: {
      poweredOn:
        normalizeBoolean(
          televisionSource
            .poweredOn,
          false
        ),

      showState,

      showStartedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          televisionSource
            .showStartedAt
        ),

      elapsedShowSeconds:
        Math.max(
          0,
          finiteNumber(
            televisionSource
              .elapsedShowSeconds,
            0
          )
        ),

      lastShowTimeAccountedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          televisionSource
            .lastShowTimeAccountedAt
        ),

      hostilityStarted:
        normalizeBoolean(
          televisionSource
            .hostilityStarted,
          false
        ),

		combatTriggered:
		  normalizeBoolean(
			televisionSource
			  .combatTriggered,
			false
		  ),

		brainMode:
		  televisionSource
			.brainMode ===
			  "sally"
				? "sally"
				: "premium",

		sallyBrainAnnounced:
		  normalizeBoolean(
			televisionSource
			  .sallyBrainAnnounced,
			false
		  )
    },

    host,

    nameless,

    watch: {
      episodesWatched:
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            watchSource
              .episodesWatched,
            0
          )
        ),

      totalWatchSeconds:
        Math.max(
          0,
          finiteNumber(
            watchSource
              .totalWatchSeconds,
            0
          )
        ),

      currentEpisodeStartedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          watchSource
            .currentEpisodeStartedAt
        ),

      currentViewingStartedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          watchSource
            .currentViewingStartedAt
        ),

      lastHeartbeatAt:
        validIsoDate(
          watchSource
            .lastHeartbeatAt
        ),

      lastAccountedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          watchSource
            .lastAccountedAt
        )
    },

    calendar: {
      dayIndex:
        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            calendarSource
              .dayIndex,
            0
          ),
          0,
          SHOW_CALENDAR_DAYS - 1
        ),

      currentDate:
        normalizeString(
          calendarSource
            .currentDate,
          SHOW_CALENDAR_START,
          10
        ),

      lastRealDateAdvanceKey:
        normalizeString(
          calendarSource
            .lastRealDateAdvanceKey,
          "",
          20
        ) || null,

      discussedEventIds:
        Array.isArray(
          calendarSource
            .discussedEventIds
        )
          ? calendarSource
              .discussedEventIds
              .slice(
                -200
              )
          : []
    },

    conversation: {
      mode:
        CONVERSATION_MODES
          .includes(
            conversationSource
              .mode
          )
            ? conversationSource
                .mode
            : "conversation",

      currentTopic:
        normalizeString(
          conversationSource
            .currentTopic,
          "",
          500
        ) || null,

      previousTopic:
        normalizeString(
          conversationSource
            .previousTopic,
          "",
          500
        ) || null,

      lockType,

      locked:
        lockType !==
          LOCK_NONE,

      activeSpeaker:
        (
          conversationSource
            .activeSpeaker ===
              CHARACTER_HOST
        )
          ? CHARACTER_HOST
          : CHARACTER_NAMELESS,

      lastSpeaker:
        (
          conversationSource
            .lastSpeaker ===
              CHARACTER_HOST ||
          conversationSource
            .lastSpeaker ===
              CHARACTER_NAMELESS ||
          conversationSource
            .lastSpeaker ===
              CHARACTER_AUDIENCE
        )
          ? conversationSource
              .lastSpeaker
          : null,

      awaitingTtsCompletion:
        normalizeBoolean(
          conversationSource
            .awaitingTtsCompletion,
          false
        ),

      audienceInterruptPending:
        normalizeBoolean(
          conversationSource
            .audienceInterruptPending,
          false
        ),

      turnNumber:
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            conversationSource
              .turnNumber,
            0
          )
        ),

      currentEpisodeTurnNumber:
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            conversationSource
              .currentEpisodeTurnNumber,
            0
          )
        ),

      longTermSummary:
        normalizeString(
          conversationSource
            .longTermSummary,
          "",
          MAX_LONG_TERM_SUMMARY_LENGTH
        ),

      lastModeChangeAt:
        validIsoDate(
          conversationSource
            .lastModeChangeAt
        ),

      lastTopicChangeAt:
        validIsoDate(
          conversationSource
            .lastTopicChangeAt
        ),

      lastUltraMonologueAtShowSecond:
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(
            conversationSource
              .lastUltraMonologueAtShowSecond
          )
        )
          ? Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                conversationSource
                  .lastUltraMonologueAtShowSecond
              )
            )
          : null
    },

    combat: {
      active:
        normalizeBoolean(
          combatSource
            .active,
          false
        ),

      startedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          combatSource
            .startedAt
        ),

      elapsedCombatSeconds:
        Math.max(
          0,
          finiteNumber(
            combatSource
              .elapsedCombatSeconds,
            0
          )
        ),

      lastAccountedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          combatSource
            .lastAccountedAt
        ),

      nextMajorEscalationAtSeconds:
        Math.max(
          MAJOR_COMBAT_ESCALATION_SECONDS,
          finiteNumber(
            combatSource
              .nextMajorEscalationAtSeconds,
            MAJOR_COMBAT_ESCALATION_SECONDS
          )
        ),

      currentAttacker:
        combatSource
          .currentAttacker ===
            CHARACTER_HOST
          ? CHARACTER_HOST
          : CHARACTER_NAMELESS,

      actionNumber:
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            combatSource
              .actionNumber,
            0
          )
        ),

      stalemate:
        normalizeBoolean(
          combatSource
            .stalemate,
          false
        ),

      lastAttack:
        combatSource
          .lastAttack ??
        null,

      lastDamage:
        Math.max(
          0,
          finiteNumber(
            combatSource
              .lastDamage,
            0
          )
        ),

      lastSpell:
        combatSource
          .lastSpell ??
        null
    },

    hostStore: {
      candidates:
        Array.isArray(
          hostStoreSource
            .candidates
        )
          ? hostStoreSource
              .candidates
              .slice(
                0,
                HOST_STORE_CANDIDATE_COUNT
              )
          : [],

      generatedAt:
        validIsoDate(
          hostStoreSource
            .generatedAt
        ),

      generationNumber:
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            hostStoreSource
              .generationNumber,
            0
          )
        ),

      lastHiredCandidateId:
        normalizeString(
          hostStoreSource
            .lastHiredCandidateId,
          "",
          200
        ) || null
    },

    jukebox: {
      enabled:
        normalizeBoolean(
          jukeboxSource
            .enabled,
          true
        ),

      currentAlbumId:
        normalizeString(
          jukeboxSource
            .currentAlbumId,
          "",
          500
        ) || null,

      currentSongId:
        normalizeString(
          jukeboxSource
            .currentSongId,
          "",
          500
        ) || null,

      currentSongTitle:
        normalizeString(
          jukeboxSource
            .currentSongTitle,
          "",
          1000
        ) || null,

      playing:
        normalizeBoolean(
          jukeboxSource
            .playing,
          false
        ),

      positionSeconds:
        Math.max(
          0,
          finiteNumber(
            jukeboxSource
              .positionSeconds,
            0
          )
        ),

      volume:
        clamp(
          finiteNumber(
            jukeboxSource
              .volume,
            1
          ),
          0,
          1
        ),

      shuffle:
        normalizeBoolean(
          jukeboxSource
            .shuffle,
          false
        ),

      repeat:
        normalizeBoolean(
          jukeboxSource
            .repeat,
          false
        )
    },

    createdAt:
      validIsoDate(
        source.createdAt
      ) ||
      fallback.createdAt,

    updatedAt:
      validIsoDate(
        source.updatedAt
      ) ||
      fallback.updatedAt
  };
}


// =========================================================
// LOAD RECALL STATE
// =========================================================

async function loadRecallState(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  await ensureRecallDatabase(
    env
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const row =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT
          state_json,
          created_at,
          updated_at

        FROM recall_show_state

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  if (!row) {
    const state =
      createDefaultRecallState();

    await saveRecallState(
      env,
      visitorId,
      state
    );

    return state;
  }

  let parsed =
    null;

  try {
    parsed =
      JSON.parse(
        row.state_json
      );
  } catch {
    parsed =
      null;
  }

  const state =
    normalizeRecallState(
      parsed
    );

  return state;
}


// =========================================================
// SAVE RECALL STATE
// =========================================================

async function saveRecallState(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const now =
    new Date()
      .toISOString();

  const normalized =
    normalizeRecallState(
      {
        ...state,

        updatedAt:
          now
      }
    );

  await db
    .prepare(`
      INSERT INTO recall_show_state (
        visitor_id,
        state_json,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )

      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)

      ON CONFLICT(visitor_id)
      DO UPDATE SET

        state_json =
          excluded.state_json,

        updated_at =
          excluded.updated_at
    `)
    .bind(
      visitorId,
      JSON.stringify(
        normalized
      ),
      normalized.createdAt ||
        now,
      now
    )
    .run();

  return normalized;
}


// =========================================================
// SHARED WORLD STATE — LOAD
// =========================================================

async function loadSharedWorldState(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  /*
   * Other Loki's Kingdom systems already use world_state.
   *
   * Do not replace or recreate the table here.
   */

  try {
    const row =
      await db
        .prepare(`
          SELECT state_json

          FROM world_state

          WHERE visitor_id = ?

          LIMIT 1
        `)
        .bind(
          visitorId
        )
        .first();

    if (!row) {
      return createFallbackWorldState();
    }

    let parsed;

    try {
      parsed =
        JSON.parse(
          row.state_json
        );
    } catch {
      return createFallbackWorldState();
    }

    if (
      !parsed ||
      typeof parsed !==
        "object"
    ) {
      return createFallbackWorldState();
    }

    return parsed;

  } catch (error) {
    /*
     * The TV can still display development information
     * if an old test database does not yet have world_state.
     *
     * Host purchasing later will require the real shared
     * world state.
     */

    console.error(
      "Shared world state load failed:",
      error
    );

    return createFallbackWorldState();
  }
}


// =========================================================
// PUBLIC PLAYER WALLET
// =========================================================

function getPublicPlayerState(
  worldState
) {
  const player =
    (
      worldState &&
      typeof worldState ===
        "object" &&
      worldState.player &&
      typeof worldState.player ===
        "object"
    )
      ? worldState.player
      : {};

  return {
    hp:
      Math.max(
        0,
        finiteNumber(
          player.hp,
          100
        )
      ),

    maxHp:
      Math.max(
        1,
        finiteNumber(
          player.maxHp,
          100
        )
      ),

    hunger:
      finiteNumber(
        player.hunger,
        0
      ),

    money:
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          player.money,
          0
        )
      )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// WATCH-TIME FORMATTER
// =========================================================

function formatWatchDuration(
  totalSeconds
) {
  const secondsTotal =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.floor(
        finiteNumber(
          totalSeconds,
          0
        )
      )
    );

  const seconds =
    secondsTotal %
    60;

  const totalMinutes =
    Math.floor(
      secondsTotal /
      60
    );

  const minutes =
    totalMinutes %
    60;

  const totalHours =
    Math.floor(
      totalMinutes /
      60
    );

  const days =
    Math.floor(
      totalHours /
      24
    );

  const remainderHours =
    totalHours %
    24;

  return {
    totalSeconds:
      secondsTotal,

    totalHours,

    minutes,

    seconds,

    days,

    remainderHours,

    /*
     * Primary display:
     *
     * 412 hours, 47 minutes, 6 seconds
     */

    hoursDisplay:
      (
        `${totalHours} hours, ` +
        `${minutes} minutes, ` +
        `${seconds} seconds`
      ),

    /*
     * Secondary display:
     *
     * [17 days, 4 hours, 47 minutes, 6 seconds]
     */

    daysDisplay:
      (
        `[${days} days, ` +
        `${remainderHours} hours, ` +
        `${minutes} minutes, ` +
        `${seconds} seconds]`
      )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// PUBLIC RECALL STATE
// =========================================================

function buildPublicRecallState(
  recallState,
  worldState
) {
  const watchDuration =
    formatWatchDuration(
      recallState
        .watch
        .totalWatchSeconds
    );

  return {
    ok:
      true,

    network:
      SHOW_NETWORK,

    show:
      SHOW_TITLE,

    year:
      SHOW_YEAR,

    player:
      getPublicPlayerState(
        worldState
      ),

    television: {
      poweredOn:
        recallState
          .television
          .poweredOn,

      showState:
        recallState
          .television
          .showState,

      elapsedShowSeconds:
        Math.floor(
          recallState
            .television
            .elapsedShowSeconds
        ),

      hostilityStarted:
        recallState
          .television
          .hostilityStarted,
		  
		        combatTriggered:
        recallState
          .television
          .combatTriggered,

      brainMode:
        recallState
          .television
          .brainMode ===
            "sally"
              ? "sally"
              : "premium",

      sallyBrainAnnounced:
        Boolean(
          recallState
            .television
            .sallyBrainAnnounced
        )
    },

    statistics: {
      episodesWatched:
        recallState
          .watch
          .episodesWatched,

      totalWatchSeconds:
        watchDuration
          .totalSeconds,

      totalHours:
        watchDuration
          .totalHours,

      hoursDisplay:
        watchDuration
          .hoursDisplay,

      daysDisplay:
        watchDuration
          .daysDisplay
    },

    calendar: {
      currentDate:
        recallState
          .calendar
          .currentDate,

      dayIndex:
        recallState
          .calendar
          .dayIndex
    },

    host:
      recallState.host,

    nameless: {
      /*
       * Do NOT expose a hidden canonical name,
       * because no such game value exists.
       */

      temporaryName:
        recallState
          .nameless
          .currentTemporaryName,

      invincible:
        true,

      combat:
        recallState
          .nameless
          .combat
    },

    conversation:
      recallState
        .conversation,

    combat:
      recallState
        .combat,

    hostStore:
      recallState
        .hostStore,

    jukebox:
      recallState
        .jukebox
  };
}


// =========================================================
// GENERIC RESPONSE HELPERS
// =========================================================

function jsonResponse(
  data,
  status = 200,
  origin = ""
) {
  const headers =
    new Headers({
      "content-type":
        "application/json; charset=UTF-8",

      "cache-control":
        "no-store"
    });

  if (
    isAllowedOrigin(
      origin
    )
  ) {
    headers.set(
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin",
      origin
    );

    headers.set(
      "Vary",
      "Origin"
    );
  }

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify(
      data
    ),
    {
      status,
      headers
    }
  );
}


function isAllowedOrigin(
  origin
) {
  return (
    origin ===
      "https://lokiskingdom.com" ||
    origin ===
      "https://www.lokiskingdom.com"
  );
}


function handleCorsPreflight(
  origin
) {
  const headers =
    new Headers({
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods":
        "GET, POST, OPTIONS",

      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
        "Content-Type",

      "Access-Control-Max-Age":
        "86400",

      "Vary":
        "Origin"
    });

  if (
    isAllowedOrigin(
      origin
    )
  ) {
    headers.set(
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin",
      origin
    );
  }

  return new Response(
    null,
    {
      status:
        204,

      headers
    }
  );
}


function addCorsToResponse(
  response,
  origin
) {
  if (
    !isAllowedOrigin(
      origin
    )
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  const headers =
    new Headers(
      response.headers
    );

  headers.set(
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin",
    origin
  );

  headers.set(
    "Vary",
    "Origin"
  );

  return new Response(
    response.body,
    {
      status:
        response.status,

      statusText:
        response.statusText,

      headers
    }
  );
}

// =========================================================
// AMAZON POLLY — CLOUDFLARE BINDING VALUE
// =========================================================

async function getEnvironmentBindingValue(
  binding
) {
  if (
    binding ===
      undefined ||
    binding ===
      null
  ) {
    return "";
  }


  /*
   * Cloudflare Secrets Store bindings expose:
   *
   *     await binding.get()
   *
   * Ordinary Worker secrets / variables expose the value
   * directly as a string.
   *
   * Support both.
   */

  if (
    typeof binding ===
      "object" &&
    typeof binding.get ===
      "function"
  ) {
    const value =
      await binding.get();

    return String(
      value ||
      ""
    );
  }


  return String(
    binding
  );
}


// =========================================================
// AMAZON POLLY — BYTE / HEX HELPERS
// =========================================================

function bytesToHex(
  bytes
) {
  return Array.from(
    bytes
  )
    .map(
      (byte) =>
        byte
          .toString(16)
          .padStart(
            2,
            "0"
          )
    )
    .join("");
}


async function sha256Bytes(
  value
) {
  const encoder =
    new TextEncoder();


  const input =
    typeof value ===
      "string"
      ? encoder.encode(
          value
        )
      : value;


  const digest =
    await crypto.subtle.digest(
      "SHA-256",
      input
    );


  return new Uint8Array(
    digest
  );
}


async function sha256Hex(
  value
) {
  return bytesToHex(
    await sha256Bytes(
      value
    )
  );
}


async function hmacSha256(
  key,
  value
) {
  const encoder =
    new TextEncoder();


  const keyBytes =
    typeof key ===
      "string"
      ? encoder.encode(
          key
        )
      : key;


  const cryptoKey =
    await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      "raw",
      keyBytes,
      {
        name:
          "HMAC",

        hash:
          "SHA-256"
      },
      false,
      [
        "sign"
      ]
    );


  const signature =
    await crypto.subtle.sign(
      "HMAC",
      cryptoKey,
      encoder.encode(
        value
      )
    );


  return new Uint8Array(
    signature
  );
}


// =========================================================
// AMAZON POLLY — AWS SIGV4
// =========================================================

async function createAwsPollySignedRequest({
  accessKeyId,
  secretAccessKey,
  region,
  body
}) {
  const service =
    POLLY_SERVICE;


  const method =
    "POST";


  const canonicalUri =
    "/v1/speech";


  const canonicalQueryString =
    "";


  const host =
    (
      "polly." +
      region +
      ".amazonaws.com"
    );


  const endpoint =
    (
      "https://" +
      host +
      canonicalUri
    );


  const now =
    new Date();


  const amzDate =
    now
      .toISOString()
      .replace(
        /[:-]|\.\d{3}/g,
        ""
      );


  const dateStamp =
    amzDate.slice(
      0,
      8
    );


  const payloadHash =
    await sha256Hex(
      body
    );


  const canonicalHeaders =
    (
      "content-type:application/json\n" +
      "host:" +
      host +
      "\n" +
      "x-amz-date:" +
      amzDate +
      "\n"
    );


  const signedHeaders =
    "content-type;host;x-amz-date";


  const canonicalRequest =
    (
      method +
      "\n" +
      canonicalUri +
      "\n" +
      canonicalQueryString +
      "\n" +
      canonicalHeaders +
      "\n" +
      signedHeaders +
      "\n" +
      payloadHash
    );


  const algorithm =
    "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256";


  const credentialScope =
    (
      dateStamp +
      "/" +
      region +
      "/" +
      service +
      "/aws4_request"
    );


  const stringToSign =
    (
      algorithm +
      "\n" +
      amzDate +
      "\n" +
      credentialScope +
      "\n" +
      (
        await sha256Hex(
          canonicalRequest
        )
      )
    );


  const kDate =
    await hmacSha256(
      (
        "AWS4" +
        secretAccessKey
      ),
      dateStamp
    );


  const kRegion =
    await hmacSha256(
      kDate,
      region
    );


  const kService =
    await hmacSha256(
      kRegion,
      service
    );


  const kSigning =
    await hmacSha256(
      kService,
      "aws4_request"
    );


  const signature =
    bytesToHex(
      await hmacSha256(
        kSigning,
        stringToSign
      )
    );


  const authorizationHeader =
    (
      algorithm +
      " " +
      "Credential=" +
      accessKeyId +
      "/" +
      credentialScope +
      ", " +
      "SignedHeaders=" +
      signedHeaders +
      ", " +
      "Signature=" +
      signature
    );


  return {
    endpoint,

    headers: {
      "content-type":
        "application/json",

      "x-amz-date":
        amzDate,

      "authorization":
        authorizationHeader
    }
  };
}


// =========================================================
// AMAZON POLLY — SYNTHESIZE
// =========================================================

async function synthesizePollySpeech(
  env,
  {
    text,
    voice
  }
) {
  const accessKeyId =
    (
      await getEnvironmentBindingValue(
        env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
      )
    )
      .trim();


  const secretAccessKey =
    (
      await getEnvironmentBindingValue(
        env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
      )
    )
      .trim();


  const region =
    (
      (
        await getEnvironmentBindingValue(
          env.AWS_REGION
        )
      )
        .trim() ||
      "us-east-1"
    );


  if (
    !accessKeyId ||
    !secretAccessKey
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Amazon Polly AWS credentials are not configured."
    );
  }


  const selectedVoice =
    POLLY_ALLOWED_GENERATIVE_VOICES
      .includes(
        voice
      )
        ? voice
        : POLLY_DEFAULT_HOST_VOICE;


  const requestBody =
    JSON.stringify({
      Engine:
        POLLY_ENGINE,

      OutputFormat:
        POLLY_OUTPUT_FORMAT,

      Text:
        text,

      TextType:
        "text",

      VoiceId:
        selectedVoice
    });


  const signed =
    await createAwsPollySignedRequest({
      accessKeyId,
      secretAccessKey,
      region,
      body:
        requestBody
    });


  const response =
    await fetch(
      signed.endpoint,
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        headers:
          signed.headers,

        body:
          requestBody
      }
    );


  if (
    !response.ok
  ) {
    const errorText =
      await response.text();


    throw new Error(
      (
        "Amazon Polly " +
        response.status +
        ": " +
        (
          errorText ||
          response.statusText ||
          "Speech synthesis failed."
        )
      )
    );
  }


  return response;
}


// =========================================================
// AMAZON POLLY — /tts ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handlePollyTts(
  request,
  env
) {
  let body =
    null;


  try {
    body =
      await request.json();

  } catch {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid TTS request."
      },
      400
    );
  }


  const text =
    String(
      body?.text ||
      ""
    )
      .trim();


  if (
    !text
  ) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "TTS text is empty."
      },
      400
    );
  }


  if (
    text.length >
      POLLY_MAX_TEXT_CHARACTERS
  ) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "TTS text is too long for one Polly request.",

        characters:
          text.length,

        maximum:
          POLLY_MAX_TEXT_CHARACTERS
      },
      413
    );
  }


  const requestedVoice =
    String(
      body?.voice ||
      POLLY_DEFAULT_HOST_VOICE
    )
      .trim();


  const voice =
    POLLY_ALLOWED_GENERATIVE_VOICES
      .includes(
        requestedVoice
      )
        ? requestedVoice
        : POLLY_DEFAULT_HOST_VOICE;


  try {
    const pollyResponse =
      await synthesizePollySpeech(
        env,
        {
          text,
          voice
        }
      );


    const headers =
      new Headers();


    headers.set(
      "content-type",
      pollyResponse.headers.get(
        "content-type"
      ) ||
        "audio/mpeg"
    );


    headers.set(
      "cache-control",
      "no-store"
    );


    headers.set(
      "x-recall-voice",
      voice
    );


    return new Response(
      pollyResponse.body,
      {
        status:
          200,

        headers
      }
    );

  } catch (
    error
  ) {
    console.error(
      "AMAZON POLLY TTS FAILED:",
      error
    );


    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        type:
          "polly-error",

        error:
          (
            error?.message ||
            String(
              error
            ) ||
            "Amazon Polly failed."
          )
      },
      502
    );
  }
}
