      // ===================================================
      // SHOW STATE RENDERING
      // ===================================================

      function renderShowState() {

        const showState =
          publicState
            ?.television
            ?.showState ||
          (
            televisionOn
              ? "conversation"
              : "off"
          );


        const chip =
          document.getElementById(
            "showStateChip"
          );


        setText(
          chip,
          String(
            showState
          )
            .toUpperCase()
        );


        chip.classList.remove(
          "alert"
        );


        chip.classList.remove(
          "combat"
        );


        if (
          showState ===
            "hostility"
        ) {
          chip.classList.add(
            "alert"
          );
        }


        if (
          showState ===
            "combat"
        ) {
          chip.classList.add(
            "combat"
          );
        }


        const lockType =
          publicState
            ?.conversation
            ?.lockType;


        const lockChip =
          document.getElementById(
            "lockChip"
          );


        if (
          lockType &&
          lockType !==
            "none"
        ) {
          lockChip.style.display =
            "block";


          setText(
            lockChip,
            (
              "LOCK: " +
              String(
                lockType
              )
                .toUpperCase()
            )
          );


        } else {
          lockChip.style.display =
            "none";
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // CALENDAR RENDERING
      // ===================================================

      function renderCalendar() {

        if (
          publicState
            ?.dateDisplay
        ) {
          setText(
            document.getElementById(
              "dateDisplay"
            ),
            publicState
              .dateDisplay
          );


          return;
        }


        const key =
          publicState
            ?.calendar
            ?.currentDate;


        if (!key) {
          return;
        }


        try {

          const date =
            new Date(
              key +
              "T12:00:00Z"
            );


          const value =
            new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
              "en-US",
              {
                weekday:
                  "long",

                month:
                  "long",

                day:
                  "numeric",

                year:
                  "numeric",

                timeZone:
                  "UTC"
              }
            )
              .format(
                date
              );


          setText(
            document.getElementById(
              "dateDisplay"
            ),
            value
          );


        } catch (
          error
        ) {
          setText(
            document.getElementById(
              "dateDisplay"
            ),
            key
          );
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // LOAD STATE
      // ===================================================

      async function loadState() {

        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              (
                "/state?visitorId=" +
                encodeURIComponent(
                  visitorId
                )
              )
            );


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              result.data.error ||
              "State could not be loaded."
            );
          }


          renderState(
            result.data
          );


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          appendMessage(
            (
              error.message ||
              "The television has no signal."
            ),
            "system",
            "SYSTEM"
          );
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // VOICE SELECTION
      // ===================================================

      function selectVoice(
        speaker
      ) {

        if (
          !(
            "speechSynthesis"
            in window
          )
        ) {
          return null;
        }


        const voices =
          window
            .speechSynthesis
            .getVoices();


        if (
          !voices ||
          voices.length ===
            0
        ) {
          return null;
        }


        const hostSex =
          publicState
            ?.host
            ?.sex ||
          "female";


        /*
         * The Nameless Man prefers a lower-pitched English
         * voice when one exists.
         *
         * Host selection is intentionally broad because
         * browsers expose wildly different voice lists.
         */

        if (
          speaker ===
            "nameless-man"
        ) {

          const preferred =
            voices.find(
              (voice) =>
                /david|daniel|mark|george|james|guy|male/i
                  .test(
                    voice.name
                  ) &&
                /^en/i.test(
                  voice.lang
                )
            );


          return preferred ||
            voices.find(
              (voice) =>
                /^en/i.test(
                  voice.lang
                )
            ) ||
            voices[0];
        }


        if (
          hostSex ===
            "female"
        ) {

          const preferred =
            voices.find(
              (voice) =>
                /samantha|victoria|zira|susan|karen|female|aria|jenny/i
                  .test(
                    voice.name
                  ) &&
                /^en/i.test(
                  voice.lang
                )
            );


          return preferred ||
            voices.find(
              (voice) =>
                /^en/i.test(
                  voice.lang
                )
            ) ||
            voices[0];
        }


        const preferred =
          voices.find(
            (voice) =>
              /david|daniel|mark|george|james|guy|male/i
                .test(
                  voice.name
                ) &&
              /^en/i.test(
                voice.lang
              )
          );


        return preferred ||
          voices.find(
            (voice) =>
              /^en/i.test(
                voice.lang
              )
          ) ||
          voices[0];
      }


      // ===================================================
      // STOP SPEECH
      // ===================================================
      function stopSpeech() {

        waitingForSpeech =
          false;


        speakingIndicator.textContent =
          "";


        /*
         * STOP PENDING AMAZON POLLY REQUEST.
         *
         * This is critical when an interruption arrives
         * while the MP3 is still being generated/downloaded.
         */

        if (
          currentPollyController
        ) {
          try {

            currentPollyController.abort();

          } catch (
            error
          ) {

            console.error(
              error
            );
          }


          currentPollyController =
            null;
        }


        /*
         * STOP CURRENT AMAZON POLLY AUDIO IMMEDIATELY.
         */

        if (
          currentPollyAudio
        ) {
          try {

            currentPollyAudio.onended =
              null;


            currentPollyAudio.onerror =
              null;


            currentPollyAudio.pause();


            currentPollyAudio.currentTime =
              0;

          } catch (
            error
          ) {

            console.error(
              error
            );
          }


          currentPollyAudio =
            null;
        }


        if (
          currentPollyObjectUrl
        ) {
          try {

            URL.revokeObjectURL(
              currentPollyObjectUrl
            );

          } catch (
            error
          ) {

            console.error(
              error
            );
          }


          currentPollyObjectUrl =
            null;
        }


        /*
         * Android fallback completion timer.
         */

        if (
          nativeSpeechCompletionTimer !==
            null
        ) {
          window.clearTimeout(
            nativeSpeechCompletionTimer
          );


          nativeSpeechCompletionTimer =
            null;
        }

    /*
     * STOP NATIVE AIB / AMAZON POLLY PLAYBACK.
     */

    if (
      typeof window.AndroidAIB !==
        "undefined" &&
      typeof window.AndroidAIB.stop ===
        "function"
    ) {
      try {

        window.AndroidAIB.stop();

      } catch (
        error
      ) {

        console.error(
          error
        );
      }
    }
        /*
         * Android native fallback.
         */

        if (
          typeof window.AndroidTTS !==
            "undefined" &&
          typeof window.AndroidTTS.stop ===
            "function"
        ) {
          try {

            window.AndroidTTS.stop();

          } catch (
            error
          ) {

            console.error(
              error
            );
          }
        }


        /*
         * Browser fallback.
         */

        if (
          "speechSynthesis"
          in window
        ) {
          window
            .speechSynthesis
            .cancel();
        }
      }
      // ===================================================
      // SPEAK
      // ===================================================
      function speakDialogue(
        text,
        speaker,
        onComplete
      ) {

        /*
         * Nothing from a previous speaker may survive
         * into this line.
         */

        stopSpeech();


        if (
          !voiceEnabled
        ) {
          window.setTimeout(
            onComplete,
            50
          );

          return;
        }


        const cleanText =
          String(
            text || ""
          ).trim();


        if (
          !cleanText
        ) {
          window.setTimeout(
            onComplete,
            50
          );

          return;
        }


        waitingForSpeech =
          true;


        const displayName =
          speaker ===
            "nameless-man"
              ? "THE NAMELESS MAN"
              : (
                  publicState
                    ?.host
                    ?.name ||
                  "HOST"
                );


        speakingIndicator.textContent =
          (
            displayName +
            " IS SPEAKING..."
          );


        let finished =
          false;


        const completeOnce =
          () => {

            if (
              finished
            ) {
              return;
            }


            finished =
              true;


            waitingForSpeech =
              false;


            speakingIndicator.textContent =
              "";


            /*
             * Clean up only the CURRENT Polly resources.
             */

            if (
              currentPollyAudio
            ) {
              currentPollyAudio.onended =
                null;


              currentPollyAudio.onerror =
                null;


              currentPollyAudio =
                null;
            }


            if (
              currentPollyObjectUrl
            ) {
              URL.revokeObjectURL(
                currentPollyObjectUrl
              );


              currentPollyObjectUrl =
                null;
            }


            currentPollyController =
              null;


            if (
              nativeSpeechCompletionTimer !==
                null
            ) {
              window.clearTimeout(
                nativeSpeechCompletionTimer
              );


              nativeSpeechCompletionTimer =
                null;
            }


            if (
              televisionOn &&
              autonomousLoopEnabled &&
              !interruptionInProgress &&
              !hostVacancy
            ) {
              onComplete();
            }
          };


        /*
         * ================================================
         * FALLBACK VOICE SYSTEM
         * ================================================
         */

        const speakWithFallback =
          () => {

            if (
              finished
            ) {
              return;
            }


            const nativeSpeechSupported =
              typeof window.AndroidTTS !==
                "undefined" &&
              typeof window.AndroidTTS.speak ===
                "function";


            if (
              nativeSpeechSupported
            ) {
              try {

                window.AndroidTTS.speak(
                  cleanText
                );


                const wordCount =
                  Math.max(
                    1,
                    cleanText
                      .split(/\s+/)
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .length
                  );


                const punctuationPauseCount =
                  (
                    cleanText.match(
                      /[.!?;:,]/g
                    ) ||
                    []
                  ).length;


                const estimatedMilliseconds =
                  Math.max(
                    900,
                    Math.min(
                      120000,
                      Math.round(
                        (
                          wordCount /
                          2.45
                        ) *
                          1000 +
                        punctuationPauseCount *
                          95 +
                        550
                      )
                    )
                  );


                nativeSpeechCompletionTimer =
                  window.setTimeout(
                    completeOnce,
                    estimatedMilliseconds
                  );


                return;

              } catch (
                error
              ) {

                console.error(
                  "Android fallback TTS failed:",
                  error
                );
              }
            }


            if (
              !(
                "speechSynthesis"
                in window
              ) ||
              !(
                "SpeechSynthesisUtterance"
                in window
              )
            ) {
              completeOnce();
              return;
            }


            currentVoice =
              selectVoice(
                speaker
              );


            const utterance =
              new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(
                cleanText
              );


            if (
              currentVoice
            ) {
              utterance.voice =
                currentVoice;


              utterance.lang =
                currentVoice.lang;

            } else {

              utterance.lang =
                "en-US";
            }


            if (
              speaker ===
                "nameless-man"
            ) {
              utterance.rate =
                0.93;


              utterance.pitch =
                0.91;

            } else {

              utterance.rate =
                0.97;


              utterance.pitch =
                1.0;
            }


            utterance.volume =
              1;


            utterance.onend =
              completeOnce;


            utterance.onerror =
              completeOnce;


            try {

              window
                .speechSynthesis
                .speak(
                  utterance
                );

            } catch (
              error
            ) {

              console.error(
                "Browser fallback TTS failed:",
                error
              );


              completeOnce();
            }
          };

    /*
     * ================================================
     * ANDROID NATIVE AMAZON POLLY — PART 1 HANDOFF
     * ================================================
     */

    const nativeAibSupported =
      typeof window.AndroidAIB !==
        "undefined" &&
      typeof window.AndroidAIB.speakPolly ===
        "function";


    if (
      nativeAibSupported
    ) {

      const voiceId =
        speaker ===
          "nameless-man"
            ? (
                publicState
                  ?.nameless
                  ?.voice
                  ?.voiceId ||
                "Matthew"
              )
            : (
                publicState
                  ?.host
                  ?.voice
                  ?.voiceId ||
                (
                  publicState
                    ?.host
                    ?.sex ===
                      "male"
                    ? "Stephen"
                    : "Danielle"
                )
              );


      const endpoint =
        (
          window.location.origin +
          "/tts"
        );


     let nativeSpeechId =
      "";


    window.__androidAibSpeechFinished =
      speechId => {

        if (
          finished ||
          speechId !==
            nativeSpeechId
        ) {
          return;
        }


        window.__androidAibSpeechFinished =
          null;


        window.__androidAibSpeechFailed =
          null;


        completeOnce();
      };


    window.__androidAibSpeechFailed =
      (
        speechId,
        error
      ) => {

        if (
          finished ||
          speechId !==
            nativeSpeechId
        ) {
          return;
        }


        window.__androidAibSpeechFinished =
          null;


        window.__androidAibSpeechFailed =
          null;


        console.error(
          "Native Amazon Polly failed:",
          error
        );


        speakWithFallback();
      };


    try {

      nativeSpeechId =
        String(
			window.AndroidAIB.speakPolly(
			endpoint,
			cleanText,
			voiceId,
			visitorId
			) ||
          ""
        );


      if (
        nativeSpeechId
      ) {
        return;
      }

    } catch (
      error
    ) {

      console.error(
        "Native Amazon Polly bridge failed:",
        error
      );
    }


    window.__androidAibSpeechFinished =
      null;


    window.__androidAibSpeechFailed =
      null;
}
        /*
         * ================================================
         * AMAZON POLLY — PRIMARY
         * ================================================
         */

        const speakWithPolly =
          async () => {

            const controller =
              new AbortController();


            currentPollyController =
              controller;


            const voiceId =
              speaker ===
                "nameless-man"
                  ? (
                      publicState
                        ?.nameless
                        ?.voice
                        ?.voiceId ||
                      "Matthew"
                    )
                  : (
                      publicState
                        ?.host
                        ?.voice
                        ?.voiceId ||
                      (
                        publicState
                          ?.host
                          ?.sex ===
                            "male"
                          ? "Stephen"
                          : "Danielle"
                      )
                    );


            const response =
              await fetch(
                "/tts",
                {
                  method:
                    "POST",

                  signal:
                    controller.signal,

                  headers: {
                    "content-type":
                      "application/json"
                  },

                  body:
                    JSON.stringify({
                      text:
                        cleanText,

                      voice:
                        voiceId
                    })
                }
              );


            /*
             * This speech was interrupted/replaced while
             * Polly was generating it.
             *
             * DO NOT resurrect the old speaker.
             */

            if (
              controller.signal.aborted ||
              currentPollyController !==
                controller
            ) {
              return;
            }


            if (
              !response.ok
            ) {
              const errorText =
                await response.text();


              throw new Error(
                (
                  "POLLY HTTP " +
                  response.status +
                  (
                    errorText
                      ? (
                          ": " +
                          errorText
                        )
                      : ""
                  )
                )
              );
            }


            const audioBlob =
              await response.blob();


            if (
              controller.signal.aborted ||
              currentPollyController !==
                controller
            ) {
              return;
            }


            if (
              !audioBlob ||
              audioBlob.size <=
                0
            ) {
              throw new Error(
                "Polly returned empty audio."
              );
            }


            currentPollyObjectUrl =
              URL.createObjectURL(
                audioBlob
              );


            const audio =
              new Audio(
                currentPollyObjectUrl
              );


            currentPollyAudio =
              audio;


            audio.preload =
              "auto";


            audio.volume =
              1;


            audio.onended =
              () => {

                if (
                  currentPollyAudio !==
                    audio
                ) {
                  return;
                }


                completeOnce();
              };


            audio.onerror =
              () => {

                if (
                  currentPollyAudio !==
                    audio ||
                  finished
                ) {
                  return;
                }


                console.error(
                  "Amazon Polly audio playback failed."
                );


                currentPollyAudio =
                  null;


                if (
                  currentPollyObjectUrl
                ) {
                  URL.revokeObjectURL(
                    currentPollyObjectUrl
                  );


                  currentPollyObjectUrl =
                    null;
                }


                speakWithFallback();
              };


            await audio.play();
          };


        speakWithPolly()
          .catch(
            error => {

              /*
               * INTENTIONAL INTERRUPTION.
               *
               * Never replace an interrupted Polly line
               * with fallback speech.
               */

              if (
                error?.name ===
                  "AbortError"
              ) {
                return;
              }


              if (
                finished
              ) {
                return;
              }


              console.error(
                "Amazon Polly failed; using fallback voice:",
                error
              );


              currentPollyController =
                null;


              if (
                currentPollyAudio
              ) {
                try {

                  currentPollyAudio.pause();

                } catch {
                }


                currentPollyAudio =
                  null;
              }


              if (
                currentPollyObjectUrl
              ) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(
                  currentPollyObjectUrl
                );


                currentPollyObjectUrl =
                  null;
              }


              speakWithFallback();
            }
          );
      }
      // ===================================================
      // VOICE TOGGLE
      // ===================================================

      function renderVoiceButton() {

        voiceButton.textContent =
          voiceEnabled
            ? "VOICE: ON"
            : "VOICE: OFF";
      }


      voiceButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {

          voiceEnabled =
            !voiceEnabled;


          localStorage.setItem(
            VOICE_KEY,
            String(
              voiceEnabled
            )
          );


          if (
            !voiceEnabled
          ) {
            stopSpeech();


            if (
              televisionOn &&
              autonomousLoopEnabled &&
              !turnInProgress &&
              !hostVacancy
            ) {
              window.setTimeout(
                requestNextTurn,
                100
              );
            }
          }


          renderVoiceButton();
        }
      );


      // ===================================================
      // GENERATION ABORT
      // ===================================================

      function abortCurrentGeneration() {

        if (
          currentGenerationController
        ) {
          try {
            currentGenerationController
              .abort();

          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            console.error(
              error
            );
          }
        }


        currentGenerationController =
          null;


        turnInProgress =
          false;
      }


      // ===================================================
      // HANDLE GENERATED DIALOGUE
      // ===================================================

      function handleDialogueResponse(
        data
      ) {

        if (!data) {
          return;
        }


        if (
          data.publicState
        ) {
          renderState(
            data.publicState
          );
        }


        if (
          data.combatEvent
        ) {
          appendCombatEvent(
            data.combatEvent
          );
        }


        if (
          data.text
        ) {

          const role =
            data.speaker ===
              "nameless-man"
                ? "nameless"
                : "host";


          const name =
            data.speaker ===
              "nameless-man"
                ? "THE NAMELESS MAN"
                : (
                    data.speakerName ||
                    publicState
                      ?.host
                      ?.name ||
                    "HOST"
                  );


          appendMessage(
            data.text,
            role,
            name
          );


          if (
            data.combatEvent
              ?.death
              ?.died
          ) {
            /*
             * The Nameless Man still gets to finish the line
             * associated with the killing attack.
             */

            speakDialogue(
              data.text,
              data.speaker,
              () => {

                hostVacancy =
                  true;


                openHostStore();
              }
            );


            return;
          }


          speakDialogue(
            data.text,
            data.speaker,
            () => {

              if (
                televisionOn &&
                autonomousLoopEnabled &&
                !hostVacancy
              ) {
                requestNextTurn();
              }
            }
          );
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // AUTONOMOUS NEXT TURN
      // ===================================================

      async function requestNextTurn() {

        if (
          !televisionOn ||
          !autonomousLoopEnabled ||
          turnInProgress ||
          interruptionInProgress ||
          hostVacancy
        ) {
          return;
        }


        turnInProgress =
          true;


        currentGenerationController =
          new AbortController();


        loadingCover.classList.add(
          "visible"
        );


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              "/show/next",
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "content-type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    visitorId:
                      visitorId
                  }),

                signal:
                  currentGenerationController
                    .signal
              }
            );


          if (
            result.response.status ===
              409 &&
            result.data.type ===
              "turn-already-running"
          ) {

            window.setTimeout(
              requestNextTurn,
              TURN_RETRY_MS
            );


            return;
          }


          if (
            result.response.status ===
              409 &&
            result.data.type ===
              "host-vacancy"
          ) {

            hostVacancy =
              true;


            await openHostStore();


            return;
          }


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              result.data.error ||
              "Broadcast turn failed."
            );
          }


          handleDialogueResponse(
            result.data
          );


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          if (
            error &&
            error.name ===
              "AbortError"
          ) {
            return;
          }


          appendMessage(
            (
              error.message ||
              "The broadcast signal broke."
            ),
            "system",
            "SYSTEM"
          );


          if (
            televisionOn &&
            autonomousLoopEnabled &&
            !hostVacancy
          ) {
            window.setTimeout(
              requestNextTurn,
              2500
            );
          }


        } finally {

          turnInProgress =
            false;


          currentGenerationController =
            null;


          loadingCover.classList.remove(
            "visible"
          );
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // TURN TV ON
      // ===================================================

      async function turnTelevisionOn() {

        powerButton.disabled =
          true;


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              "/tv/on",
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "content-type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    visitorId:
                      visitorId
                  })
              }
            );


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              result.data.error ||
              "The television would not turn on."
            );
          }


          renderState(
            result.data
          );


          televisionOn =
            true;


          autonomousLoopEnabled =
            true;


          hostVacancy =
            Boolean(
              result.data.requiresHost
            ) ||
            (
              result.data.host
                ?.combat
                ?.alive ===
                  false
            );


          renderPowerState();


          startHeartbeat();


          startLiveTicker();


          if (
            hostVacancy
          ) {

            appendMessage(
              "THE POSITION OF HOST IS VACANT.",
              "system",
              "CRYPT NETWORK"
            );


            await openHostStore();


          } else {

            requestNextTurn();
          }


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          appendMessage(
            (
              error.message ||
              "The television would not turn on."
            ),
            "system",
            "SYSTEM"
          );


        } finally {

          powerButton.disabled =
            false;
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // TURN TV OFF
      // ===================================================

      async function turnTelevisionOff() {

        /*
         * Highest priority operation.
         */

        autonomousLoopEnabled =
          false;


        televisionOn =
          false;


        stopSpeech();


        abortCurrentGeneration();


        if (
          currentInterruptionController
        ) {
          try {
            currentInterruptionController
              .abort();

          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            console.error(
              error
            );
          }
        }


        currentInterruptionController =
          null;


        interruptionInProgress =
          false;


        stopHeartbeat();


        renderPowerState();


        powerButton.disabled =
          true;


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              "/tv/off",
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "content-type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    visitorId:
                      visitorId
                  })
              }
            );


          if (
            result.response.ok
          ) {
            renderState(
              result.data
            );
          }


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          console.error(
            error
          );


        } finally {

          powerButton.disabled =
            false;


          renderPowerState();
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // POWER BUTTON
      // ===================================================

      powerButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        async () => {

          if (
            televisionOn
          ) {
            await turnTelevisionOff();

          } else {
            await turnTelevisionOn();
          }
        }
      );


      // ===================================================
      // HEARTBEAT
      // ===================================================

      async function sendHeartbeat() {

        if (
          !televisionOn
        ) {
          return;
        }


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              "/tv/heartbeat",
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "content-type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    visitorId:
                      visitorId
                  })
              }
            );


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            return;
          }


          const data =
            result.data;


          if (
            Number.isFinite(
              Number(
                data.statistics
                  ?.totalWatchSeconds
              )
            )
          ) {
            localWatchSeconds =
              Number(
                data.statistics
                  .totalWatchSeconds
              );
          }


          if (
            Number.isFinite(
              Number(
                data.elapsedShowSeconds
              )
            )
          ) {
            localShowSeconds =
              Number(
                data.elapsedShowSeconds
              );
          }


          if (
            data.showState &&
            publicState
          ) {
            publicState
              .television
              .showState =
                data.showState;
          }


          if (
            data.combatStartedNow
          ) {

            appendMessage(
              "THE COMBAT PHASE HAS BEGUN.",
              "combat-event",
              "CRYPT NETWORK"
            );


            /*
             * Pull full combat state.
             */

            await loadState();
          }


          if (
            data.hostilityStartedNow
          ) {
            appendMessage(
              "The atmosphere in the studio has changed.",
              "system",
              "CRYPT NETWORK"
            );
          }


          lastLocalTick =
            Date.now();


          renderStatistics();

          renderShowState();


        } catch (
          error
        ) {
          console.error(
            "Heartbeat failed:",
            error
          );
        }
      }


      function startHeartbeat() {

        stopHeartbeat();


        heartbeatTimer =
          window.setInterval(
            sendHeartbeat,
            HEARTBEAT_MS
          );


        sendHeartbeat();
      }


      function stopHeartbeat() {

        if (
          heartbeatTimer
        ) {
          window.clearInterval(
            heartbeatTimer
          );


          heartbeatTimer =
            null;
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // LIVE ONE-SECOND DISPLAY TICKER
      // ===================================================

      function startLiveTicker() {

        if (
          liveTimer
        ) {
          return;
        }


        lastLocalTick =
          Date.now();


        liveTimer =
          window.setInterval(
            () => {

              const now =
                Date.now();


              let elapsed =
                (
                  now -
                  lastLocalTick
                ) /
                1000;


              lastLocalTick =
                now;


              if (
                !televisionOn
              ) {
                return;
              }


              /*
               * This is display prediction only.
               *
               * Server remains authoritative.
               */

              elapsed =
                Math.max(
                  0,
                  Math.min(
                    2,
                    elapsed
                  )
                );


              localWatchSeconds +=
                elapsed;


              localShowSeconds +=
                elapsed;


              if (
                publicState
                  ?.television
                  ?.showState ===
                    "combat"
              ) {
                localCombatSeconds +=
                  elapsed;
              }


              renderStatistics();

            },
            1000
          );
      }


      // ===================================================
      // PLAYER INTERJECTION
      // ===================================================
      // ===================================================
      // PLAYER INTERJECTION
      // ===================================================

      async function interject(
        text
      ) {

        const message =
          String(
            text || ""
          ).trim();

        if (
          !message ||
          !televisionOn ||
          hostVacancy ||
          interruptionInProgress
        ) {
          return;
        }


        /*
         * Audience interruption has priority over whatever
         * the studio was doing.
         */

        stopSpeech();

        abortCurrentGeneration();

        autonomousLoopEnabled =
          false;

        interruptionInProgress =
          true;


        appendMessage(
          message,
          "audience",
          "AUDIENCE"
        );


        audienceInput.value =
          "";

        speakButton.disabled =
          true;


        /*
         * Kill any older interruption request before starting
         * the new authoritative one.
         */

        if (
          currentInterruptionController
        ) {
          try {
            currentInterruptionController
              .abort();
          } catch (
            error
          ) {
            console.error(
              error
            );
          }
        }


        currentInterruptionController =
          new AbortController();


        const controller =
          currentInterruptionController;


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              "/show/interject",
              {
                method:
                  "POST",

                headers: {
                  "content-type":
                    "application/json"
                },

                body:
                  JSON.stringify({
                    visitorId:
                      visitorId,

                    message:
                      message
                  }),

                signal:
                  controller.signal
              }
            );


          /*
           * DEAD-AIR INTERRUPTION RECOVERY
           *
           * The audience statement has already been persisted
           * by the server and audienceInterruptPending is set.
           *
           * Do not POST the audience statement again.
           *
           * Instead, restore autonomous continuation and wait
           * until the aborted previous browser turn has fully
           * released turnInProgress before asking /show/next
           * to consume the pending interruption.
           */

          if (
            result.response.status ===
              202 &&
            result.data
              .generationPending
          ) {

            interruptionInProgress =
              false;


            autonomousLoopEnabled =
              true;


            speakButton.disabled =
              false;


            const resumePendingInterruption =
              () => {

                if (
                  !televisionOn ||
                  hostVacancy
                ) {
                  return;
                }


                if (
                  turnInProgress ||
                  interruptionInProgress
                ) {
                  window.setTimeout(
                    resumePendingInterruption,
                    INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
                  );

                  return;
                }


                requestNextTurn();
              };


            window.setTimeout(
              resumePendingInterruption,
              INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
            );


            return;
          }


          if (
            result.response.status ===
              409 &&
            result.data.type ===
              "turn-already-running"
          ) {

            await waitForInterruptedTurnToClear();

            return;
          }


          if (
            result.response.status ===
              409 &&
            result.data.type ===
              "host-vacancy"
          ) {

            hostVacancy =
              true;


            interruptionInProgress =
              false;


            speakButton.disabled =
              false;


            await openHostStore();

            return;
          }


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              result.data.error ||
              "The interruption failed."
            );
          }


          /*
           * Successful immediate response.
           */

          interruptionInProgress =
            false;


          autonomousLoopEnabled =
            true;


          speakButton.disabled =
            false;


          if (
            result.data.publicState
          ) {
            renderState(
              result.data.publicState
            );
          }


          if (
            result.data.text
          ) {

            handleDialogueResponse(
              result.data
            );

          } else if (
            televisionOn &&
            !hostVacancy
          ) {

            /*
             * Successful request but no dialogue payload:
             * never strand the autonomous show.
             */

            window.setTimeout(
              requestNextTurn,
              INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
            );
          }


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          if (
            error &&
            error.name ===
              "AbortError"
          ) {
            return;
          }


          appendMessage(
            (
              error.message ||
              "The audience microphone failed."
            ),
            "system",
            "SYSTEM"
          );


          interruptionInProgress =
            false;


          autonomousLoopEnabled =
            true;


          speakButton.disabled =
            false;


          if (
            televisionOn &&
            !hostVacancy
          ) {
            window.setTimeout(
              requestNextTurn,
              INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
            );
          }


        } finally {

          if (
            currentInterruptionController ===
              controller
          ) {
            currentInterruptionController =
              null;
          }
        }
      }
      // ===================================================
      // INTERRUPTED TURN RECOVERY
      // ===================================================

      /*
       * If the abandoned server generation still owns the
       * request lock, give it a moment to finish.
       *
       * Then resume from authoritative persisted state.
       *
       * We do NOT repeatedly POST the same audience message,
       * because that would duplicate the audience entry.
       */

      async function waitForInterruptedTurnToClear() {

        let attempts =
          0;


        const retry =
          async () => {

            if (
              !televisionOn
            ) {
              return;
            }


            attempts +=
              1;


            await loadState();


            if (
              attempts <
                6
            ) {

              window.setTimeout(
                retry,
                INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
              );


              return;
            }


            interruptionInProgress =
              false;


            autonomousLoopEnabled =
              true;


            speakButton.disabled =
              false;


            speakingIndicator.textContent =
              "";


            if (
              !hostVacancy
            ) {
              requestNextTurn();
            }
          };


        window.setTimeout(
          retry,
          INTERRUPTION_RETRY_MS
        );
      }


      // ===================================================
      // AUDIENCE FORM
      // ===================================================

      audienceForm.addEventListener(
        "submit",
        async (
          event
        ) => {

          event.preventDefault();


          const text =
            audienceInput
              .value
              .trim();


          if (!text) {
            return;
          }


          await interject(
            text
          );
        }
      );


		audienceInput.addEventListener(
		  "keydown",
		  (
			event
		  ) => {

			if (
			  event.key !==
				"Enter"
			) {
			  return;
			}


			/*
			 * SHIFT + RETURN
			 *
			 * A real newline.
			 *
			 * Do not preventDefault().
			 * The textarea performs its normal newline action.
			 */
			if (
			  event.shiftKey
			) {
			  return;
			}


			/*
			 * RETURN
			 *
			 * Send the audience statement.
			 */
			event.preventDefault();


			if (
			  !speakButton.disabled
			) {
			  audienceForm
				.requestSubmit();
			}
		  }
		);

      // ===================================================
      // HOST STORE
      // ===================================================

      async function openHostStore() {

        hostStore.classList.add(
          "visible"
        );


        candidateGrid.innerHTML =
          "";


        storeGold.textContent =
          "LOADING CAST...";


        try {

          const result =
            await fetchJson(
              (
                "/host-store?visitorId=" +
                encodeURIComponent(
                  visitorId
                )
              )
            );


          if (
            !result.response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              result.data.error ||
              "Casting office unavailable."
            );
          }


          storeGold.textContent =
            (
              "GOLD: " +
              (
                result.data.playerGold ??
                0
              )
            );


          const candidates =
            Array.isArray(
              result.data.candidates
            )
              ? result.data.candidates
              : [];


          for (
            const candidate
            of candidates
          ) {
            candidateGrid.appendChild(
              buildCandidateCard(
                candidate,
                result.data.playerGold
              )
            );
          }


        } catch (
          error
        ) {

          candidateGrid.innerHTML =
            "";


          const failure =
            document.createElement(
              "div"
            );


          failure.className =
            "candidate";


          failure.textContent =
            (
              error.message ||
              "The casting office is closed."
            );


          candidateGrid.appendChild(
            failure
          );
        }
      }


      // ===================================================
      // CANDIDATE CARD
      // ===================================================

      // ===================================================
      // CANDIDATE CARD
      // ===================================================

      function buildCandidateCard(
        candidate,
        playerGold
      ) {

        const card =
          document.createElement(

            try {

              const response =
                await fetch(
                  "/host-store/hire",
                  {
                    method:
                      "POST",

                    headers: {
                      "content-type":
                        "application/json"
                    },

                    body:
                      JSON.stringify({
                        visitorId:
                          visitorId,

                        candidateId:
                          candidate
                            .candidateId,

                        customization: {
                          name:
                            nameInput
                              .value
                              .trim(),

                          sex:

                              .value,

                          voice:
                            voiceSelect
                              .value,

                          hairColor:
                            hairColor
                              .value,

                          hairstyle:
                            hairstyle
                              .value
                        }
                      })
                  }
                );


              const rawText =
                await response.text();


              let data =
                null;


              try {

                data =
                  rawText
                    ? JSON.parse(
                        rawText
                      )
                    : {};

              } catch (
                parseError
              ) {

                console.error(
                  "HOST HIRE RETURNED NON-JSON DATA:",
                  {
                    status:
                      response.status,

                    statusText:
                      response.statusText,

                    rawText:
                      rawText,

                    parseError:
                      parseError
                  }
                );


                throw new Error(
                  (
                    "HOST HIRE WORKER ERROR " +
                    response.status +
                    (
                      response.statusText
                        ? (
                            " " +
                            response.statusText
                          )
                        : ""
                    ) +
                    "\\n\\n" +
                    (
                      rawText ||
                      "The Worker returned no readable response body."
                    )
                  )
                );
              }


              if (
                !response.ok
              ) {

                if (
                  data?.type ===
                    "insufficient-gold"
                ) {

                  throw new Error(
                    (
                      "YOU NEED $" +
                      Number(
                        data
                          .requiredGold ||
                        0
                      )
                        .toLocaleString() +
                      ". YOU HAVE $" +
                      Number(
                        data
                          .currentGold ||
                        0
                      )
                        .toLocaleString() +
                      "."
                    )
                  );
                }


                const workerMessage =
                  (
                    data?.error ||
                    data?.message ||
                    data?.type ||
                    "The host could not be hired."
                  );


                console.error(
                  "HOST HIRE WORKER REJECTED REQUEST:",
                  {
                    status:
                      response.status,

                    statusText:
                      response.statusText,

                    data:
                      data
                  }
                );


                throw new Error(
                  (
                    "HOST HIRE ERROR " +
                    response.status +
                    ": " +
                    workerMessage
                  )
                );
              }


              if (
                !data ||
                typeof data !==
                  "object"
              ) {

                throw new Error(
                  "HOST HIRE ERROR: Worker returned an invalid success payload."
                );
              }


              if (
                !data.host
              ) {

                console.error(
                  "HOST HIRE SUCCESS RESPONSE HAD NO HOST:",
                  data
                );


                throw new Error(
                  "HOST HIRE ERROR: Worker reported success but returned no host."
                );
              }


              appendMessage(
                (
                  (
                    data.host.name ||
                    "HOST"
                  ) +
                  " HAS BEEN HIRED."
                ),
                "system",
                "CRYPT NETWORK"
              );


              if (
                data.publicState
              ) {

                renderState(
                  data.publicState
                );
              }


              hostVacancy =
                false;


              hostStore.classList.remove(
                "visible"
              );


              autonomousLoopEnabled =
                true;


              await loadState();


              requestNextTurn();

            } catch (
              error
            ) {

              console.error(
                "HOST HIRE FAILED:",
                error
              );


              window.alert(
                error?.message ||
                String(
                  error
                ) ||
                "Hiring failed."
              );


              hire.disabled =
                false;


              hire.textContent =
                "HIRE HOST";
            }
          }
        );


        card.appendChild(
          hire
        );


        return card;

// DOCUMENT ATTACHMENT STAGING
//
// Selecting a document does NOT send it.
// Selecting a document does NOT make the studio reply.
// Selecting a document does NOT immediately persist it.
//
// It is staged locally and travels with the next
// audience statement as ONE atomic turn.

const DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES =
  3 * 1024 * 1024;


documentButton.addEventListener(
  "click",
  () => {
    documentInput.click();
  }
);


documentInput.addEventListener(
  "change",
  async () => {
    const file =
      documentInput.files?.[0];

    if (!file) {
      return;
    }


    if (
      file.size >
      DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES
    ) {
      clearPendingDocument();

      documentStatus.textContent =
        "FILE TOO LARGE — 3 MB MAX";

      return;
    }


    documentButton.disabled =
      true;

    documentStatus.textContent =
      "READING...";


    try {
      const text =
        await file.text();


      if (!text.trim()) {
        throw new Error(
          "DOCUMENT CONTAINS NO TEXT"
        );
      }


      stagePendingDocument(
        file,
        text
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "Document attachment failed:",
        error
      );

      clearPendingDocument();

      documentStatus.textContent =
        error?.message ||
        "ATTACHMENT FAILED";
    } finally {
      documentButton.disabled =
        false;
    }
  }
);      // ===================================================

      function createJukeboxInterface() {

        if (
          jukeboxOverlay

        }


        /*

         */

        const button =

        /*

         */

        const controls =

        if (

          controls.appendChild(

        }


        /*

        jukeboxOverlay =

              "0 auto",

              "flex",

            flexDirection:
              "column",

            background:
              "#080808",

            border:
              "1px solid #444"
          }
        );

// =========================================================
// PART 8 CLIENT/SERVER OWNERSHIP PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * BROWSER OWNS:
 *
 * - rendering;
 * - TTS playback;
 * - stopping TTS;
 * - local visual interpolation of clocks;
 * - player text input;
 * - requesting the next turn;
 * - showing the Host Store.
 *
 *
 * SERVER OWNS:
 *
 * - actual watch seconds;
 * - actual show elapsed time;
 * - combat threshold;
 * - hostility threshold;
 * - damage;
 * - XP;
 * - levels;
 * - host death;
 * - host purchase;
 * - stored host;
 * - long-term memory;
 * - historical event cache;
 * - persistent conversation state.
 */


// =========================================================
// TTS LOOP PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * SERVER RETURNS DIALOGUE
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * BROWSER DISPLAYS IT
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * TTS SPEAKS IT
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * onend
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * /show/next
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * OTHER HOST SPEAKS
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * REPEAT
 *
 *
 * Therefore the player can simply sit there.
 *
 * No CONTINUE button is required for ordinary operation.
 */


// =========================================================
// INTERRUPTION PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * PLAYER TYPES:
 *
 *     "Do you believe in ghosts?"
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * BROWSER:
 *
 * - immediately stops TTS;
 * - aborts its current fetch where possible;
 * - freezes ordinary autonomous chaining;
 * - POSTs /show/interject;
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * RESPONDING HOST ADDRESSES GHOSTS
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * TTS COMPLETES
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * OTHER HOST RESPONDS
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * NORMAL AUTONOMOUS LOOP CONTINUES.
 *
 *
 * COMBAT DOES NOT RESET.
 */


// =========================================================
// WATCH CLOCK PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * SERVER COUNTER:
 *
 *     canonical
 *
 *
 * BROWSER COUNTER:
 *
 *     visual interpolation between heartbeats
 *
 *
 * Therefore the player sees:
 *
 *     412 hours, 47 minutes, 6 seconds
 *
 * tick:
 *
 *     412 hours, 47 minutes, 7 seconds
 *
 * live on screen.
 *
 *
 * The bracketed representation remains:
 *
 *     [17 days, 4 hours, 47 minutes, 7 seconds]
 */


// =========================================================
// REFRESH PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * REFRESH:
 *
 *     browser loses only ephemeral DOM rendering;
 *
 *     server retains:
 *
 * - episode count;
 * - accumulated watch time;
 * - current host;
 * - host HP;
 * - Nameless Man;
 * - Nameless level;
 * - Nameless XP;
 * - Nameless spells;
 * - conversation topic;
 * - lock state;
 * - relationship history;
 * - memories;
 * - combat state;
 * - combat elapsed time;
 * - historical date.
 *
 *
 * The show resumes from authoritative state.
 */


// =========================================================
// IMPORTANT:
// JUKEBOX IS NOT YET DRAWN IN PART 8
// =========================================================

/*
 * PART 1 already reserves:
 *
 *     /jukebox/catalog
 *
 * and:
 *
 *     state.jukebox
 *
 *
 * The television interface is deliberately complete enough
 * for PART 9 to insert the actual working jukebox without
 * rewriting this page architecture.
 */


// =========================================================
// IMPORTANT:
// HOST STORE REMAINS CASTING
// =========================================================

/*
 * The UI intentionally displays:
 *
 *     PRICE
 *
 * separately from:
 *
 *     POWER
 *
 * and:
 *
 *     EXPECTED MATCHUP.
 *
 *
 * Therefore the joke is visible.
 *
 *
 * Example:
 *
 *     ONE-HIT WEAKLING
 *     PRESTIGE ATHLETIC SNEAKERS
 *     $5,000+
 *
 *
 * beside:
 *
 *     GOD-TITAN
 *     NAKED
 *     $1,000-ish
 *
 *
 * Power does not become the price axis merely because the
 * interface exposes both.
 */

// THE EFSMB JUKEBOX
// EXISTING LOKI'S KINGDOM MUSIC SYSTEM
// CATALOGUE CONNECTION
// MUSIC STATE
// NON-DESTRUCTIVE INTEGRATION
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// JUKEBOX CONFIGURATION
// =========================================================

/*
 * We deliberately DO NOT duplicate musicCatalog.js
 * inside this Worker.
 *
 * Loki's Kingdom already owns the canonical catalogue.
 *
 * recall thy name therefore treats the actual existing
 * jukebox as another machine in the same kingdom.
 */

const EFSMB_JUKEBOX_URL =
  "https://www.lokiskingdom.com/";


const EFSMB_R2_BASE =
  "https://pub-4ae7f49887bc46e9a03de6e38886b609.r2.dev/";


// =========================================================
// JUKEBOX CATALOG ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleJukeboxCatalog(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {

  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url
        .searchParams
        .get(
          "visitorId"
        ) ??
      url
        .searchParams
        .get(
          "visitor_id"
        )
    );


  /*
   * The jukebox itself can technically be opened without a
   * game visitor ID.
   *
   * But inside recall thy name we want one common identity.
   */

  if (!visitorId) {

    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }


  let state =
    null;


  try {

    state =
      await loadRecallState(
        env,
        visitorId
      );


  } catch (
    error
  ) {

    console.error(
      "Jukebox state load failed:",
      error
    );
  }


  return jsonResponse(
    {
      ok:
        true,

      mode:
        "existing-efsmb-jukebox",

      title:
        "THE EFSMB JUKEBOX",

      jukeboxUrl:
        EFSMB_JUKEBOX_URL,

      r2Base:
        EFSMB_R2_BASE,

      integration: {
        catalogueOwner:
          "Loki's Kingdom",

        duplicateCatalogue:
          false,

        embedded:
          true,

        televisionContinues:
          true
      },

      currentState:
        state
          ?.jukebox ||
        createDefaultJukeboxState()
    }
  );
}


// =========================================================
// JUKEBOX STATE NORMALIZER
// =========================================================

function normalizeJukeboxState(
  value
) {

  const source =
    value &&
    typeof value ===
      "object"
      ? value
      : {};


  return {
    enabled:
      source.enabled !==
        false,

    currentAlbumId:
      normalizeString(
        source.currentAlbumId,
        "",
        500
      ) ||
      null,

    currentSongId:
      normalizeString(
        source.currentSongId,
        "",
        500
      ) ||
      null,

    currentSongTitle:
      normalizeString(
        source.currentSongTitle,
        "",
        1000
      ) ||
      null,

    playing:
      Boolean(
        source.playing
      ),

    positionSeconds:
      Math.max(
        0,
        finiteNumber(
          source.positionSeconds,
          0
        )
      ),

    volume:
      clamp(
        finiteNumber(
          source.volume,
          1
        ),
        0,
        1
      ),

    shuffle:
      Boolean(
        source.shuffle
      ),

    repeat:
      Boolean(
        source.repeat
      )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// JUKEBOX / TELEVISION AUDIO PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * JUKEBOX AUDIO DOES NOT STOP THE SHOW.
 *
 *
 * The player can choose:
 *
 * 1. TV voices only.
 *
 * 2. Music only by disabling TV VOICE.
 *
 * 3. Music + host speech simultaneously.
 *
 *
 * We do NOT automatically turn off:
 *
 *     recall thy name
 *
 * simply because a record is playing.
 *
 *
 * This matters because the intended television can be an
 * endurance experience.
 */


// =========================================================
// WHY THE CATALOGUE IS NOT COPIED INTO THIS WORKER
// =========================================================

/*
 * Loki's Kingdom's existing desktop jukebox uses:
 *
 *     musicCatalog.js
 *
 *     ↓
 *
 *     DesktopMusicApp
 *
 *     ↓
 *
 *     R2 AUDIO
 *
 *
 * The catalogue contains thousands of tracks.
 *
 *
 * COPYING THE CATALOG HERE WOULD CREATE:
 *
 * - two giant catalogues;
 * - two places that must be updated;
 * - catalogue drift;
 * - a much larger Worker;
 * - unnecessary maintenance;
 * - another place for filename mistakes.
 *
 *
 * INSTEAD:
 *
 *     RECALL THY NAME
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 *     EMBED CANONICAL JUKEBOX
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 *     LOKI'S KINGDOM
 *
 *
 * One collection.
 *
 * One actual player.
 */


// =========================================================
// EXISTING PLAYER CAPABILITIES
// =========================================================

/*
 * The canonical jukebox already provides the important
 * basic player behavior:
 *
 * - album selection;
 * - song selection;
 * - current album;
 * - now playing;
 * - HTML audio controls;
 * - previous;
 * - next;
 * - artwork;
 * - lyrics.
 *
 *
 * recall thy name therefore receives those capabilities
 * without creating a watered-down imitation.
 */


// =========================================================
// JUKEBOX DOES NOT DRIVE CONVERSATION
// =========================================================

/*
 * Playing a song does NOT automatically force:
 *
 *     "LET'S TALK ABOUT THIS SONG"
 *
 *
 * The television conversation remains autonomous.
 *
 *
 * Later, if desired, a specific engine mechanic may allow:
 *
 *     NOW PLAYING
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 *     HOSTS NOTICE SONG
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 *     OPTIONAL DISCUSSION
 *
 *
 * But that is not silently invented here.
 */


// =========================================================
// PLAYER INTERRUPTION WHILE JUKEBOX IS OPEN
// =========================================================

/*
 * The current Part 9 overlay covers the television UI while
 * open.
 *
 * RETURN TO TV:
 *
 *     immediately restores access to the audience textbox.
 *
 *
 * The show itself has continued underneath.
 *
 *
 * Therefore the jukebox is not:
 *
 *     TURN OFF THE TV.
 *
 *
 * It is merely another screen the viewer is looking at.
 */


// =========================================================
// MUSIC VS TTS
// =========================================================

/*
 * It is perfectly legal for:
 *
 *     EFSMB SONG
 *
 * and:
 *
 *     HOST TTS
 *
 * to play simultaneously.
 *
 *
 * If that sounds insane:
 *
 *     VOICE: OFF
 *
 * exists.
 *
 *
 * We do not secretly pause the music every time a host
 * speaks.
 */


// =========================================================
// MUSIC CATALOGUE UPDATE PRINCIPLE
// =========================================================

/*
 * New album added to:
 *
 *     musicCatalog.js
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * Loki's Kingdom rebuild/deploy
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * Canonical jukebox contains album
 *
 *         ↓
 *
 * recall thy name sees the updated canonical jukebox.
 *
 *
 * NO RECALL THY NAME WORKER UPDATE REQUIRED.
 */


// =========================================================
// FUTURE DIRECT-CATALOG MODE
// =========================================================

/*
 * If Loki's Kingdom later exposes:
 *
 *     /music-catalog.json
 *
 * we can replace the iframe approach with a completely
 * native dropdown inside recall thy name.
 *
 *
 * Nothing in the persistence architecture prevents this.
 *
 *
 * The present mode is intentionally:
 *
 *     USE THE PLAYER THAT ALREADY WORKS.
 */

  );
