const RECALL_V13_EXTRACTION_INTERVAL_TURNS =
  typeof MEMORY_SUMMARY_INTERVAL_TURNS === "number"
    ? MEMORY_SUMMARY_INTERVAL_TURNS
    : 6;

const RECALL_V13_EXTRACTION_TRANSCRIPT_TURNS =
  32;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_EXTRACTIONS_PER_PASS =
  12;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_PATTERNS_PER_PASS =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTRADICTIONS_PER_PASS =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_JUDGMENTS_PER_PASS =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_POSITIONS_PER_PASS =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_MEMORY_MERGE_THRESHOLD =
  0.72;

const RECALL_V13_MEMORY_RELATED_THRESHOLD =
  0.42;

const RECALL_V13_PATTERN_MIN_EVIDENCE =
  2;


// =========================================================
// SAFE MODEL JSON EXTRACTION
// =========================================================

function recallV13ExtractJsonText(
  value
) {
  let text =
    String(
      value ||
      ""
    ).trim();

  if (!text) {
    return "";
  }

  text =
    text
      .replace(
        /^```(?:json)?\s*/i,
        ""
      )
      .replace(
        /\s*```$/i,
        ""
      )
      .trim();

  const objectStart =
    text.indexOf("{");

  const arrayStart =
    text.indexOf("[");

  let start =
    -1;

  if (
    objectStart >= 0 &&
    arrayStart >= 0
  ) {
    start =
      Math.min(
        objectStart,
        arrayStart
      );
  } else if (
    objectStart >= 0
  ) {
    start =
      objectStart;
  } else if (
    arrayStart >= 0
  ) {
    start =
      arrayStart;
  }

  if (start < 0) {
    return text;
  }

  const endCharacter =
    text[start] === "["
      ? "]"
      : "}";

  const end =
    text.lastIndexOf(
      endCharacter
    );

  if (end < start) {
    return text;
  }

  return text
    .slice(
      start,
      end + 1
    )
    .trim();
}


function recallV13ParseModelJson(
  value,
  fallback = null
) {
  const extracted =
    recallV13ExtractJsonText(
      value
    );

  if (!extracted) {
    return fallback;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(
      extracted
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "V13 model JSON parse failed:",
      error
    );

    return fallback;
  }
}


// =========================================================
// STABLE KEY NORMALIZATION
// =========================================================

function recallV13NormalizeKey(
  value,
  fallback = "general"
) {
  const normalized =
    String(
      value ||
      fallback
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(
        /['’]/g,
        ""
      )
      .replace(
        /[^a-z0-9]+/g,
        "-"
      )
      .replace(
        /^-+|-+$/g,
        ""
      )
      .slice(
        0,
        240
      );

  return normalized ||
    fallback;
}


// =========================================================
// CHEAP LOCAL TEXT SIMILARITY
//
// The model performs semantic analysis.
// This local layer mainly prevents obvious duplicates.
// =========================================================

function recallV13TokenSet(
  value
) {
  const stopWords =
    new Set([
      "a",
      "an",
      "and",
      "are",
      "as",
      "at",
      "be",
      "been",
      "but",
      "by",
      "for",
      "from",
      "had",
      "has",
      "have",
      "he",
      "her",
      "him",
      "his",
      "i",
      "in",
      "is",
      "it",
      "its",
      "me",
      "my",
      "of",
      "on",
      "or",
      "she",
      "that",
      "the",
      "their",
      "them",
      "they",
      "this",
      "to",
      "was",
      "were",
      "with",
      "you",
      "your"
    ]);

  return new Set(
    String(
      value ||
      ""
    )
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(
        /[^a-z0-9\s'-]/g,
        " "
      )
      .split(
        /\s+/
      )
      .map(
        (token) =>
          token.trim()
      )
      .filter(
        (token) =>
          token.length >= 3 &&
          !stopWords.has(
            token
          )
      )
  );
}


function recallV13TextSimilarity(
  left,
  right
) {
  const a =
    recallV13TokenSet(
      left
    );

  const b =
    recallV13TokenSet(
      right
    );

  if (
    a.size === 0 ||
    b.size === 0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }

  let intersection =
    0;

  for (const token of a) {
    if (b.has(token)) {
      intersection += 1;
    }
  }

  const union =
    new Set([
      ...a,
      ...b
    ]).size;

  return union > 0
    ? intersection / union
    : 0;
}


// =========================================================
// LOAD POSSIBLE MEMORY MATCHES
// =========================================================

async function loadRecallMemoryMergeCandidatesV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    characterKey = "shared",
    memoryType = RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.OTHER,
    subjectKey = null,
    limit = 40
  } = {}
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const normalizedType =
    normalizeRecallMemoryType(
      memoryType
    );

  const normalizedSubject =
    subjectKey
      ? recallV13NormalizeKey(
          subjectKey
        )
      : null;

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_memories_v2

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
          AND (
            character_key = ?
            OR character_key = 'shared'
            OR ? = 'shared'
          )
          AND (
            memory_type = ?
            OR memory_type = 'other'
            OR ? = 'other'
          )
          AND (
            ? IS NULL
            OR subject_key = ?
          )

        ORDER BY
          is_foundational DESC,
          importance DESC,
          reinforcement_count DESC,
          last_observed_at DESC

        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          "shared",
          100
        ),
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          "shared",
          100
        ),
        normalizedType,
        normalizedType,
        normalizedSubject,
        normalizedSubject,
        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            limit,
            40
          ),
          1,
          100
        )
      )
      .all();

  return Array.isArray(
    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}


// =========================================================
// FIND BEST EXISTING MEMORY
// =========================================================

async function findBestRecallMemoryMatchV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  candidate
) {
  const rows =
    await loadRecallMemoryMergeCandidatesV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      {
        characterKey:
          candidate?.characterKey ||
          "shared",

        memoryType:
          candidate?.memoryType ||
          RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.OTHER,

        subjectKey:
          candidate?.subjectKey ||
          null,

        limit:
          50
      }
    );

  let best = null;
  let bestScore = 0;

  const candidateText =
    [
      candidate?.summary,
      candidate?.detail,
      candidate?.exactQuote
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");

  for (const row of rows) {
    const rowText =
      [
        row.summary,
        row.detail,
        row.exact_quote
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ");

    let score =
      recallV13TextSimilarity(
        candidateText,
        rowText
      );

    if (
      candidate?.subjectKey &&
      row.subject_key &&
      recallV13NormalizeKey(
        candidate.subjectKey
      ) ===
        recallV13NormalizeKey(
          row.subject_key
        )
    ) {
      score += 0.12;
    }

    if (
      normalizeRecallMemoryType(
        candidate?.memoryType
      ) ===
        normalizeRecallMemoryType(
          row.memory_type
        )
    ) {
      score += 0.08;
    }

    score =
      clamp(
        score,
        0,
        1
      );

    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      best = row;
    }
  }

  return {
    memory: best,
    score: bestScore
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MERGE INTO EXISTING MEMORY
// =========================================================

async function mergeIntoRecallMemoryV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  existing,
  incoming
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const now =
    isoNow();

  const incomingImportance =
    normalizeRecallV13Importance(
      incoming?.importance,
      25
    );

  const oldImportance =
    normalizeRecallV13Importance(
      existing?.importance,
      25
    );

  const mergedImportance =
    Math.max(
      oldImportance,
      incomingImportance
    );

  const mergedConfidence =
    normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
      Math.max(
        finiteNumber(
          existing?.confidence,
          0.75
        ),
        finiteNumber(
          incoming?.confidence,
          0.75
        )
      ) + 0.02,
      0.75
    );

  const oldTags =
    recallV13JsonParse(
      existing?.tags_json,
      []
    );

  const incomingTags =
    Array.isArray(
      incoming?.tags
    )
      ? incoming.tags
      : [];

  const mergedTags =
    [
      ...new Set([
        ...(
          Array.isArray(
            oldTags
          )
            ? oldTags
            : []
        ),
        ...incomingTags
      ])
    ].slice(
      0,
      100
    );

  const existingDetail =
    normalizeString(
      existing?.detail,
      "",
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_DETAIL_MAX_CHARACTERS
    );

  const incomingDetail =
    normalizeString(
      incoming?.detail,
      "",
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_DETAIL_MAX_CHARACTERS
    );

  const mergedDetail =
    incomingDetail.length >
      existingDetail.length
      ? incomingDetail
      : existingDetail;

  const mergedQuote =
    normalizeString(
      existing?.exact_quote,
      "",
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_QUOTE_MAX_CHARACTERS
    ) ||
    normalizeString(
      incoming?.exactQuote,
      "",
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_QUOTE_MAX_CHARACTERS
    ) ||
    null;

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_memories_v2

      SET
        importance = ?,
        confidence = ?,
        reinforcement_count =
          reinforcement_count + 1,
        detail = ?,
        exact_quote = ?,
        last_observed_at = ?,
        tags_json = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE
        id = ?
        AND visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      mergedImportance,
      mergedConfidence,
      mergedDetail || null,
      mergedQuote,
      incoming?.observedAt || now,
      recallV13JsonStringify(
        mergedTags,
        "[]"
      ),
      now,
      existing.id,
      visitorId
    )
    .run();

  return await db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT *

      FROM recall_memories_v2

      WHERE
        id = ?
        AND visitor_id = ?

      LIMIT 1
    `)
    .bind(
      existing.id,
      visitorId
    )
    .first();
}


// =========================================================
// SAVE OR REINFORCE
// =========================================================

async function saveOrReinforceRecallMemoryV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  incoming
) {
  const normalizedIncoming = {
    characterKey:
      normalizeString(
        incoming?.characterKey,
        "shared",
        100
      ),

    memoryType:
      normalizeRecallMemoryType(
        incoming?.memoryType
      ),

    subjectKey:
      incoming?.subjectKey
        ? recallV13NormalizeKey(
            incoming.subjectKey
          )
        : null,

    summary:
      normalizeString(
        incoming?.summary,
        "",
        RECALL_V13_MEMORY_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARACTERS
      ).trim(),

    detail:
      incoming?.detail ||
      null,

    exactQuote:
      incoming?.exactQuote ||
      null,

    sourceType:
      incoming?.sourceType ||
      "conversation",

    sourceId:
      incoming?.sourceId ??
      null,

    sourceEpisode:
      incoming?.sourceEpisode ??
      null,

    importance:
      normalizeRecallV13Importance(
        incoming?.importance,
        25
      ),

    confidence:
      normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
        incoming?.confidence,
        0.75
      ),

    isFoundational:
      Boolean(
        incoming?.isFoundational
      ),

    isResolved:
      Boolean(
        incoming?.isResolved
      ),

    tags:
      Array.isArray(
        incoming?.tags
      )
        ? incoming.tags
        : [],

    metadata:
      incoming?.metadata &&
      typeof incoming.metadata ===
        "object"
        ? incoming.metadata
        : {},

    observedAt:
      incoming?.observedAt ||
      isoNow()
  };

  if (!normalizedIncoming.summary) {
    return {
      action: "ignored",
      memory: null,
      matchScore: 0
    };
  }

  if (normalizedIncoming.subjectKey) {
    await touchRecallMemorySubjectV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      {
        subjectKey:
          normalizedIncoming.subjectKey,

        displayName:
          incoming?.subjectDisplayName ||
          incoming?.subjectKey ||
          null,

        subjectType:
          incoming?.subjectType ||
          "topic",

        importance:
          normalizedIncoming.importance
      }
    );
  }

  const match =
    await findBestRecallMemoryMatchV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      normalizedIncoming
    );

  if (
    match.memory &&
    match.score >=
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_MERGE_THRESHOLD
  ) {
    const memory =
      await mergeIntoRecallMemoryV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        match.memory,
        normalizedIncoming
      );

    return {
      action: "reinforced",
      memory,
      matchScore: match.score
    };
  }

  const memory =
    normalizedIncoming.isFoundational
      ? await saveFoundationalRecallMemoryV13(
          env,
          visitorId,
          normalizedIncoming
        )
      : await saveRecallMemoryV13(
          env,
          visitorId,
          normalizedIncoming
        );

  if (
    memory &&
    match.memory &&
    match.score >=
      RECALL_V13_MEMORY_RELATED_THRESHOLD
  ) {
    await linkRecallMemoriesV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      memory.id,
      match.memory.id,
      "resembles",
      {
        strength:
          match.score,

        notes:
          "Automatically linked during V13 extraction."
      }
    );
  }

  return {
    action: "created",
    memory,
    matchScore: match.score
  };
}


// =========================================================
// UPSERT PLAYER PATTERN
// =========================================================

async function upsertRecallPatternV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    characterKey = CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
    patternKey,
    description,
    evidenceDelta = 1,
    counterexampleDelta = 0,
    confidence = 0.5,
    importance = 25,
    metadata = {}
  } = {}
) {
  const normalizedKey =
    recallV13NormalizeKey(
      patternKey ||
      description ||
      "pattern"
    );

  const normalizedDescription =
    normalizeString(
      description,
      "",
      8000
    ).trim();

  if (!normalizedDescription) {
    return null;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const now =
    isoNow();

  await db
    .prepare(`
      INSERT INTO recall_patterns (
        visitor_id,
        character_key,
        pattern_key,
        description,
        evidence_count,
        counterexample_count,
        confidence,
        importance,
        first_observed_at,
        last_observed_at,
        last_confirmed_at,
        metadata_json,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )

      VALUES (
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?,
        ?
      )

      ON CONFLICT(
        visitor_id,
        character_key,
        pattern_key
      )

      DO UPDATE SET
        description =
          excluded.description,

        evidence_count =
          recall_patterns.evidence_count +
          excluded.evidence_count,

        counterexample_count =
          recall_patterns.counterexample_count +
          excluded.counterexample_count,

        confidence =
          MAX(
            recall_patterns.confidence,
            excluded.confidence
          ),

        importance =
          MAX(
            recall_patterns.importance,
            excluded.importance
          ),

        last_observed_at =
          excluded.last_observed_at,

        last_confirmed_at =
          CASE
            WHEN excluded.evidence_count > 0
              THEN excluded.last_observed_at
            ELSE recall_patterns.last_confirmed_at
          END,

        updated_at =
          excluded.updated_at
    `)
    .bind(
      visitorId,
      normalizeString(
        characterKey,
        CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
        100
      ),
      normalizedKey,
      normalizedDescription,
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          evidenceDelta,
          1
        )
      ),
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          counterexampleDelta,
          0
        )
      ),
      normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
        confidence,
        0.5
      ),
      normalizeRecallV13Importance(
        importance,
        25
      ),
      now,
      now,
      evidenceDelta > 0
        ? now
        : null,
      recallV13JsonStringify(
        metadata,
        "{}"
      ),
      now,
      now
    )
    .run();

  return await db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT *

      FROM recall_patterns

      WHERE
        visitor_id = ?
        AND character_key = ?
        AND pattern_key = ?

      LIMIT 1
    `)
    .bind(
      visitorId,
      normalizeString(
        characterKey,
        CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
        100
      ),
      normalizedKey
    )
    .first();
}


// =========================================================
// RECORD CONTRADICTION
// =========================================================

async function recordRecallContradictionV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    characterKey = CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
    earlierMemoryId = null,
    laterMemoryId = null,
    earlierClaim,
    laterClaim,
    confidence = 0.5,
    explanation = null
  } = {}
) {
  const earlier =
    normalizeString(
      earlierClaim,
      "",
      12000
    ).trim();

  const later =
    normalizeString(
      laterClaim,
      "",
      12000
    ).trim();

  if (
    !earlier ||
    !later
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const duplicate =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_contradictions

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND character_key = ?
          AND status = 'unresolved'
          AND earlier_claim = ?
          AND later_claim = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
          100
        ),
        earlier,
        later
      )
      .first();

  if (duplicate) {
    return duplicate.id;
  }

  const now =
    isoNow();

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        INSERT INTO recall_contradictions (
          visitor_id,
          character_key,
          earlier_memory_id,
          later_memory_id,
          earlier_claim,
          later_claim,
          status,
          confidence,
          explanation,
          created_at,
          updated_at,
          resolved_at
        )

        VALUES (
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          'unresolved',
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          NULL
        )
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,
          100
        ),
        earlierMemoryId !== null
          ? integerNumber(
              earlierMemoryId,
              0
            )
          : null,
        laterMemoryId !== null
          ? integerNumber(
              laterMemoryId,
              0
            )
          : null,
        earlier,
        later,
        normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
          confidence,
          0.5
        ),
        explanation
          ? normalizeString(
              explanation,
              "",
              12000
            )
          : null,
        now,
        now
      )
      .run();

  return result?.meta
    ?.last_row_id ??
    null;
}


// =========================================================
// EVOLVE NAMELESS JUDGMENT
// =========================================================

async function evolveNamelessJudgmentV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    judgmentKey,
    judgment,
    confidence = 0.5,
    importance = 25,
    supportingEvidenceDelta = 1,
    opposingEvidenceDelta = 0,
    metadata = {}
  } = {}
) {
  const key =
    recallV13NormalizeKey(
      judgmentKey ||
      judgment ||
      "judgment"
    );

  const text =
    normalizeString(
      judgment,
      "",
      12000
    ).trim();

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const existing =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_nameless_judgments

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND judgment_key = ?
          AND active = 1

        ORDER BY id DESC

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        key
      )
      .first();

  const now =
    isoNow();

  if (!existing) {
    const result =
      await db
        .prepare(`
          INSERT INTO recall_nameless_judgments (
            visitor_id,
            judgment_key,
            judgment,
            confidence,
            importance,
            supporting_evidence_count,
            opposing_evidence_count,
            first_formed_at,
            last_revised_at,
            supersedes_judgment_id,
            active,
            metadata_json,
            created_at,
            updated_at
          )

          VALUES (
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?,
            NULL,
            1,
            ?,
            ?,
            ?
          )
        `)
        .bind(
          visitorId,
          key,
          text,
          normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
            confidence,
            0.5
          ),
          normalizeRecallV13Importance(
            importance,
            25
          ),
          Math.max(
            0,
            integerNumber(
              supportingEvidenceDelta,
              1
            )
          ),
          Math.max(
            0,
            integerNumber(
              opposingEvidenceDelta,
              0
            )
          ),
          now,
          now,
          recallV13JsonStringify(
            metadata,
            "{}"
          ),
          now,
          now
        )
        .run();

    return result?.meta
      ?.last_row_id ??
      null;
  }

  const sameJudgment =
    recallV13TextSimilarity(
      existing.judgment,
      text
    ) >= 0.6;

  if (sameJudgment) {
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_nameless_judgments

        SET
          judgment = ?,

          confidence =
            MAX(
              confidence,
              ?
            ),

          importance =
            MAX(
              importance,
              ?
            ),

          supporting_evidence_count =
            supporting_evidence_count + ?,

          opposing_evidence_count =
            opposing_evidence_count + ?,

          last_revised_at = ?,

          updated_at = ?

        WHERE id = ?
      `)
      .bind(
        text,
        normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
          confidence,
          0.5
        ),
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            supportingEvidenceDelta,
            1
          )
        ),
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            opposingEvidenceDelta,
            0
          )
        ),
        now,
        now,
        existing.id
      )
      .run();

    return existing.id;
  }

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_nameless_judgments

      SET
        active = 0,
        last_revised_at = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      now,
      now,
      existing.id
    )
    .run();

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        INSERT INTO recall_nameless_judgments (
          visitor_id,
          judgment_key,
          judgment,
          confidence,
          importance,
          supporting_evidence_count,
          opposing_evidence_count,
          first_formed_at,
          last_revised_at,
          supersedes_judgment_id,
          active,
          metadata_json,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        )

        VALUES (
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          1,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?
        )
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        key,
        text,
        normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
          confidence,
          0.5
        ),
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            supportingEvidenceDelta,
            1
          )
        ),
        Math.max(
          0,
          integerNumber(
            opposingEvidenceDelta,
            0
          )
        ),
        existing.first_formed_at ||
          now,
        now,
        existing.id,
        recallV13JsonStringify(
          {
            ...metadata,
            revised: true
          },
          "{}"
        ),
        now,
        now
      )
      .run();

  return result?.meta
    ?.last_row_id ??
    null;
}


// =========================================================
// NAMELESS SELF-POSITION
// =========================================================

async function saveNamelessPositionV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    topicKey,
    positionText,
    confidence = 0.75,
    importance = 25,
    sourceConversationId = null,
    metadata = {}
  } = {}
) {
  const key =
    recallV13NormalizeKey(
      topicKey ||
      positionText ||
      "general"
    );

  const text =
    normalizeString(
      positionText,
      "",
      16000
    ).trim();

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const existing =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_nameless_positions

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND topic_key = ?
          AND active = 1

        ORDER BY id DESC

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        key
      )
      .first();

  const now =
    isoNow();

  if (
    existing &&
    recallV13TextSimilarity(
      existing.position_text,
      text
    ) >= 0.65
  ) {
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_nameless_positions

        SET
          position_text = ?,

          confidence =
            MAX(
              confidence,
              ?
            ),

          importance =
            MAX(
              importance,
              ?
            ),

          last_stated_at = ?,

          updated_at = ?

        WHERE id = ?
      `)
      .bind(
        text,
        normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
          confidence,
          0.75
        ),
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        now,
        now,
        existing.id
      )
      .run();

    return existing.id;
  }

  if (existing) {
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_nameless_positions

        SET
          active = 0,
          retracted_at = ?,
          updated_at = ?

        WHERE id = ?
      `)
      .bind(
        now,
        now,
        existing.id
      )
      .run();
  }

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        INSERT INTO recall_nameless_positions (
          visitor_id,
          topic_key,
          position_text,
          confidence,
          importance,
          source_conversation_id,
          active,
          first_stated_at,
          last_stated_at,
          retracted_at,
          metadata_json,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        )

        VALUES (
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          1,
          ?,
          ?,
          NULL,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?
        )
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        key,
        text,
        normalizeRecallMemoryConfidence(
          confidence,
          0.75
        ),
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        sourceConversationId !== null
          ? integerNumber(
              sourceConversationId,
              0
            )
          : null,
        existing?.first_stated_at ||
          now,
        now,
        recallV13JsonStringify(
          metadata,
          "{}"
        ),
        now,
        now
      )
      .run();

  return result?.meta
    ?.last_row_id ??
    null;
}


// =========================================================
// LOAD EXISTING STATE FOR MEMORY ANALYST
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV13AnalysisContext(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const [
    memoriesResult,
    patternsResult,
    contradictionsResult,
    judgments,
    positions
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.prepare(`
        SELECT
          id,
          character_key,
          memory_type,
          subject_key,
          summary,
          importance,
          confidence,
          reinforcement_count,
          is_foundational,
          last_observed_at

        FROM recall_memories_v2

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0

        ORDER BY
          is_foundational DESC,
          importance DESC,
          reinforcement_count DESC,
          last_observed_at DESC

        LIMIT 80
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .all(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT
          pattern_key,
          description,
          evidence_count,
          counterexample_count,
          confidence,
          importance

        FROM recall_patterns

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        ORDER BY
          importance DESC,
          evidence_count DESC

        LIMIT 30
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .all(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT
          id,
          character_key,
          earlier_claim,
          later_claim,
          confidence,
          explanation

        FROM recall_contradictions

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND status = 'unresolved'

        ORDER BY id DESC

        LIMIT 20
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .all(),

      loadNamelessJudgmentsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        30
      ),

      loadNamelessPositionsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        30
      )
    ]);

  return {
    memories:
      Array.isArray(
        memoriesResult?.results
      )
        ? memoriesResult.results
        : [],

    patterns:
      Array.isArray(
        patternsResult?.results
      )
        ? patternsResult.results
        : [],

    contradictions:
      Array.isArray(
        contradictionsResult?.results
      )
        ? contradictionsResult.results
        : [],

    judgments,
    positions
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MEMORY ANALYST PROMPT
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V13_MEMORY_ANALYST_PROMPT = `
You are the private continuity and memory analyst for the fictional long-running television program "recall thy name."

You are NOT a character in the show.
You never speak directly to the audience.

Your job is not to summarize everything.

Your job is to decide what should still matter weeks, months, or years later.

RULES:

1. Preserve concrete facts, events, promises, preferences, recurring arguments, emotionally important moments, names, relationships, unusual jokes, accusations, discoveries, plans, injuries, deaths, betrayals, reconciliations, unresolved questions, and changes in belief.

2. Distinguish what the player explicitly said from what Nameless inferred.

3. Never convert an inference into objective fact.

4. Repetition matters. If something already exists in memory and occurs again, describe the same underlying idea consistently so the engine can reinforce it instead of producing endless duplicates.

5. Contradictions matter, but do not manufacture them from nuance, jokes, sarcasm, changed circumstances, or legitimate changes of mind.

6. Patterns require evidence. A single occurrence is normally not a pattern.

7. Nameless judgments are subjective conclusions about the player. They may evolve as evidence accumulates.

8. Nameless must remember his own substantive arguments and positions.

9. Exact quotations are optional. Never fabricate exact wording.

10. Do not save filler, greetings, routine show mechanics, or every sentence.

11. Do not mark ordinary memories foundational.

12. Output JSON only.

RETURN EXACTLY:

{
  "memories": [
    {
      "character_key": "audience|nameless-man|host|show|shared",
      "memory_type": "fact|event|quote|belief|opinion|preference|promise|dispute|question|pattern|judgment|relationship|contradiction|self_position|document|document_insight|name_event|combat|show_event|other",
      "subject_key": "stable-topic-key-or-null",
      "subject_display_name": "optional readable subject",
      "subject_type": "person|topic|event|project|relationship|place|object|other",
      "summary": "concise durable memory",
      "detail": "optional detail",
      "exact_quote": null,
      "importance": 25,
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "tags": []
    }
  ],

  "patterns": [
    {
      "pattern_key": "stable-pattern-key",
      "description": "recurring behavior",
      "evidence_delta": 1,
      "counterexample_delta": 0,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "importance": 25
    }
  ],

  "contradictions": [
    {
      "earlier_memory_id": null,
      "later_memory_id": null,
      "earlier_claim": "earlier claim",
      "later_claim": "later conflicting claim",
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "explanation": "why they conflict"
    }
  ],

  "judgments": [
    {
      "judgment_key": "stable-judgment-key",
      "judgment": "Nameless's evidence-grounded interpretation",
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "importance": 25,
      "supporting_evidence_delta": 1,
      "opposing_evidence_delta": 0
    }
  ],

  "nameless_positions": [
    {
      "topic_key": "stable-topic-key",
      "position_text": "Nameless's substantive position",
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "importance": 25,
      "source_conversation_id": null
    }
  ]
}

IMPORTANCE:

1-20 minor
21-40 ordinary durable continuity
41-60 meaningful
61-80 major
81-95 extremely important
96-100 identity-defining or central continuity

MAXIMUM OUTPUT:

12 memories
6 patterns
6 contradictions
6 judgments
6 Nameless positions

Empty arrays are valid.
`.trim();


// =========================================================
// BUILD ANALYST INPUT
// =========================================================

function buildRecallV13MemoryAnalysisInput(
  transcript,
  existingContext
) {
  return `
RECENT VERBATIM TRANSCRIPT:

${transcript}


EXISTING ADVANCED MEMORY:

${JSON.stringify(
  existingContext,
  null,
  2
)}


Analyze the new transcript against existing memory.

Prefer reinforcement and evolution over needless duplication.

Return JSON only.
`.trim();
}


// =========================================================
// NORMALIZE ANALYST OUTPUT
// =========================================================

function normalizeRecallV13AnalystResult(
  payload
) {
  const source =
    payload &&
    typeof payload === "object"
      ? payload
      : {};

  return {
    memories:
      Array.isArray(
        source.memories
      )
        ? source.memories.slice(
            0,
            RECALL_V13_MAX_EXTRACTIONS_PER_PASS
          )
        : [],

    patterns:
      Array.isArray(
        source.patterns
      )
        ? source.patterns.slice(
            0,
            RECALL_V13_MAX_PATTERNS_PER_PASS
          )
        : [],

    contradictions:
      Array.isArray(
        source.contradictions
      )
        ? source.contradictions.slice(
            0,
            RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTRADICTIONS_PER_PASS
          )
        : [],

    judgments:
      Array.isArray(
        source.judgments
      )
        ? source.judgments.slice(
            0,
            RECALL_V13_MAX_JUDGMENTS_PER_PASS
          )
        : [],

    namelessPositions:
      Array.isArray(
        source.nameless_positions
      )
        ? source.nameless_positions.slice(
            0,
            RECALL_V13_MAX_POSITIONS_PER_PASS
          )
        : []
  };
}


// =========================================================
// APPLY ANALYSIS
// =========================================================

async function applyRecallV13AnalystResult(
  env,
  visitorId,
  analysis,
  {
    sourceEpisode = null
  } = {}
) {
  const normalized =
    normalizeRecallV13AnalystResult(
      analysis
    );

  const saved = {
    memories: [],
    patterns: [],
    contradictions: [],
    judgments: [],
    namelessPositions: []
  };

  for (
    const memory
    of normalized.memories
  ) {
    const result =
      await saveOrReinforceRecallMemoryV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          characterKey:
            memory?.character_key ||
            "shared",

          memoryType:
            memory?.memory_type ||
            RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.OTHER,

          subjectKey:
            memory?.subject_key ||
            null,

          subjectDisplayName:
            memory?.subject_display_name ||
            null,

          subjectType:
            memory?.subject_type ||
            "topic",

          summary:
            memory?.summary,

          detail:
            memory?.detail ||
            null,

          exactQuote:
            memory?.exact_quote ||
            null,

          sourceType:
            "conversation_v13",

          sourceEpisode,

          importance:
            memory?.importance,

          confidence:
            memory?.confidence,

          tags:
            Array.isArray(
              memory?.tags
            )
              ? memory.tags
              : [],

          metadata: {
            extractedBy:
              "v13-memory-analyst"
          }
        }
      );

    if (result) {
      saved.memories.push(
        result
      );
    }
  }

  for (
    const pattern
    of normalized.patterns
  ) {
    const result =
      await upsertRecallPatternV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          characterKey:
            CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,

          patternKey:
            pattern?.pattern_key,

          description:
            pattern?.description,

          evidenceDelta:
            pattern?.evidence_delta ??
            1,

          counterexampleDelta:
            pattern?.counterexample_delta ??
            0,

          confidence:
            pattern?.confidence,

          importance:
            pattern?.importance,

          metadata: {
            extractedBy:
              "v13-memory-analyst"
          }
        }
      );

    if (result) {
      saved.patterns.push(
        result
      );
    }
  }

  for (
    const contradiction
    of normalized.contradictions
  ) {
    const result =
      await recordRecallContradictionV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          characterKey:
            CHARACTER_AUDIENCE,

          earlierMemoryId:
            contradiction?.earlier_memory_id ??
            null,

          laterMemoryId:
            contradiction?.later_memory_id ??
            null,

          earlierClaim:
            contradiction?.earlier_claim,

          laterClaim:
            contradiction?.later_claim,

          confidence:
            contradiction?.confidence,

          explanation:
            contradiction?.explanation ||
            null
        }
      );

    if (result) {
      saved.contradictions.push(
        result
      );
    }
  }

  for (
    const judgment
    of normalized.judgments
  ) {
    const result =
      await evolveNamelessJudgmentV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          judgmentKey:
            judgment?.judgment_key,

          judgment:
            judgment?.judgment,

          confidence:
            judgment?.confidence,

          importance:
            judgment?.importance,

          supportingEvidenceDelta:
            judgment?.supporting_evidence_delta ??
            1,

          opposingEvidenceDelta:
            judgment?.opposing_evidence_delta ??
            0,

          metadata: {
            extractedBy:
              "v13-memory-analyst"
          }
        }
      );

    if (result) {
      saved.judgments.push(
        result
      );
    }
  }

  for (
    const position
    of normalized.namelessPositions
  ) {
    const result =
      await saveNamelessPositionV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          topicKey:
            position?.topic_key,

          positionText:
            position?.position_text,

          confidence:
            position?.confidence,

          importance:
            position?.importance,

          sourceConversationId:
            position?.source_conversation_id ??
            null,

          metadata: {
            extractedBy:
              "v13-memory-analyst"
          }
        }
      );

    if (result) {
      saved.namelessPositions.push(
        result
      );
    }
  }

  return saved;
}


// =========================================================
// RUN ADVANCED MEMORY ANALYSIS
// =========================================================

async function extractAdvancedRecallMemoriesV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state
) {
  await initializeRecallMemoryV13ForVisitor(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const recent =
    await loadRecentRecallConversation(
      env,
      visitorId,
      RECALL_V13_EXTRACTION_TRANSCRIPT_TURNS
    );

  if (recent.length < 4) {
    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: "not-enough-conversation"
    };
  }

  const transcript =
    buildRecentConversationText(
      recent
    );

  const existingContext =
    await buildRecallV13AnalysisContext(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const raw =
    await callRecallModel(
      env,
      {
        instructions:
          RECALL_V13_MEMORY_ANALYST_PROMPT,

        input:
          buildRecallV13MemoryAnalysisInput(
            transcript,
            existingContext
          ),

        webSearchEnabled:
          false
      }
    );

  const parsed =
    recallV13ParseModelJson(
      raw,
      null
    );

  if (!parsed) {
    console.error(
      "V13 memory analyst returned invalid JSON."
    );

    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: "invalid-model-json"
    };
  }

  const sourceEpisode =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        state
          ?.conversation
          ?.turnNumber,
        0
      )
    );

  const applied =
    await applyRecallV13AnalystResult(
      env,
      visitorId,
      parsed,
      {
        sourceEpisode
      }
    );

  return {
    skipped: false,

    analysis:
      normalizeRecallV13AnalystResult(
        parsed
      ),

    applied
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MARK ANALYSIS TURN
// =========================================================

async function markRecallV13AnalysisTurn(
  env,
  visitorId,
  turnNumber
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const normalizedTurn =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        turnNumber,
        0
      )
    );

  const now =
    isoNow();

  await ensureRecallMemorySystemState(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_memory_system_state

      SET
        last_memory_extraction_turn = ?,
        last_pattern_analysis_turn = ?,
        last_contradiction_analysis_turn = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      normalizedTurn,
      normalizedTurn,
      normalizedTurn,
      now,
      visitorId
    )
    .run();
}


// =========================================================
// SHOULD ANALYSIS RUN?
// =========================================================

async function shouldRunRecallV13MemoryAnalysis(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state
) {
  const turnNumber =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        state
          ?.conversation
          ?.turnNumber,
        0
      )
    );

  if (turnNumber <= 0) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    turnNumber %
      RECALL_V13_EXTRACTION_INTERVAL_TURNS !==
        0
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  await ensureRecallMemorySystemState(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const row =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT
          last_memory_extraction_turn

        FROM recall_memory_system_state

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  const lastTurn =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        row?.last_memory_extraction_turn,
        0
      )
    );

  return turnNumber >
    lastTurn;
}


// =========================================================
// PERIODIC ADVANCED UPDATE
// =========================================================

async function maybeExtractAdvancedRecallMemoriesV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state
) {
  const shouldRun =
    await shouldRunRecallV13MemoryAnalysis(
      env,
      visitorId,
      state
    );

  if (!shouldRun) {
    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: "interval-or-already-processed"
    };
  }

  const turnNumber =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        state
          ?.conversation
          ?.turnNumber,
        0
      )
    );

  await markRecallV13AnalysisTurn(
    env,
    visitorId,
    turnNumber
  );

  try {
    return await extractAdvancedRecallMemoriesV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      state
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "V13 advanced memory extraction failed:",
      error
    );

    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: "analysis-error",
      error:
        String(
          error?.message ||
          error
        )
    };
  }
}


// =========================================================
// V12 -> V13 MEMORY LIFECYCLE HOOK
//
// V12 already calls maybeExtractDurableMemories().
// Preserve V12, then execute V13.
// =========================================================

const maybeExtractDurableMemoriesV12 =
  maybeExtractDurableMemories;


maybeExtractDurableMemories =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state
  ) {
    const legacyResult =
      await maybeExtractDurableMemoriesV12(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      );

    const advancedResult =
      await maybeExtractAdvancedRecallMemoriesV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      );

    return {
      legacy:
        legacyResult,

      advanced:
        advancedResult
    };
  };

          AND evidence_count >= ?

      `)
      .bind(

        )

    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}

// =========================================================
// RESOLVE CONTRADICTION
// =========================================================

async function resolveRecallContradictionV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  contradictionId,
  {
    status = "explained",
    explanation = null
  } = {}
) {
  const allowed =
    new Set([
      "confirmed",
      "explained",
      "retracted",
      "resolved"
    ]);

  const requested =
    String(
      status
    ).toLowerCase();

  const normalizedStatus =
    allowed.has(
      requested
    )
      ? requested
      : "explained";

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const now =
    isoNow();

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_contradictions

      SET
        status = ?,
        explanation = ?,
        resolved_at = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE
        id = ?
        AND visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      normalizedStatus,
      explanation
        ? normalizeString(
            explanation,
            "",
            12000
          )
        : null,
      now,
      now,
      integerNumber(
        contradictionId,
        0
      ),
      visitorId
    )
    .run();
}


// =========================================================
// CREATE OPEN THREAD
// =========================================================

async function createRecallOpenThreadV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  {
    characterKey = CHARACTER_NAMELESS,
    threadType = "question",
    title,
    description = null,
    sourceMemoryId = null,
    importance = 25,
    metadata = {}
  } = {}
) {
  const normalizedTitle =
    normalizeString(
      title,
      "",
      2000
    ).trim();

  if (!normalizedTitle) {
    return null;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const existing =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_open_threads

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND character_key = ?
          AND status = 'open'
          AND title = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          CHARACTER_NAMELESS,
          100
        ),
        normalizedTitle
      )
      .first();

  const now =
    isoNow();

  if (existing) {
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_open_threads

        SET
          last_touched_at = ?,

          importance =
            MAX(
              importance,
              ?
            ),

          updated_at = ?

        WHERE id = ?
      `)
      .bind(
        now,
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        now,
        existing.id
      )
      .run();

    return existing.id;
  }

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        INSERT INTO recall_open_threads (
          visitor_id,
          character_key,
          thread_type,
          title,
          description,
          source_memory_id,
          importance,
          status,
          opened_at,
          last_touched_at,
          resolved_at,
          resolution,
          metadata_json,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        )

        VALUES (
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?,
          'open',
          ?,
          ?,
          NULL,
          NULL,
          ?,
          ?,
          ?
        )
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,
        normalizeString(
          characterKey,
          CHARACTER_NAMELESS,
          100
        ),
        normalizeString(
          threadType,
          "question",
          100
        ),
        normalizedTitle,
        description
          ? normalizeString(
              description,
              "",
              12000
            )
          : null,
        sourceMemoryId !== null
          ? integerNumber(
              sourceMemoryId,
              0
            )
          : null,
        normalizeRecallV13Importance(
          importance,
          25
        ),
        now,
        now,
        recallV13JsonStringify(
          metadata,
          "{}"
        ),
        now,
        now
      )
      .run();

  return result?.meta
    ?.last_row_id ??
    null;
}

  env,

        resolved_at = ?,
        resolution = ?,
        last_touched_at = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE
        id = ?
        AND visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      now,
      resolution
        ? normalizeString(
            resolution,
            "",

          )
        : null,
      now,
      now,
      integerNumber(
        threadId,
        0
      ),

    )
    .run();
}

// =========================================================

async function getRecallMemoryV13Part2Status(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  await initializeRecallMemoryV13ForVisitor(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const [
    core,
    patterns,
    contradictions,
    judgments,
    positions,
    threads
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getRecallMemoryV13Status(
        env,
        visitorId
      ),

      loadConfirmedRecallPatternsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        100
      ),

      loadRecallContradictionsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        100
      ),

      loadNamelessJudgmentsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        100
      ),

      loadNamelessPositionsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        100
      ),

      loadRecallOpenThreadsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        CHARACTER_NAMELESS,
        100
      )
    ]);

  return {
    ...core,

    confirmedPatterns:
      patterns.length,

    unresolvedContradictions:
      contradictions.length,

    activeJudgments:
      judgments.length,

    activeNamelessPositions:
      positions.length,

    openThreads:
      threads.length,

    part2Installed:
      true
  };
}
