// =========================================================
// RETRIEVAL CONFIGURATION
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CANDIDATE_LIMIT =
  180;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FINAL_LIMIT =
  28;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FOUNDATIONAL_LIMIT =
  12;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_PATTERN_LIMIT =
  8;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_JUDGMENT_LIMIT =
  8;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CONTRADICTION_LIMIT =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_POSITION_LIMIT =
  8;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_THREAD_LIMIT =
  6;

const RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_SUBJECT_LIMIT =
  12;

const RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_LIMIT =
  12;

const RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_BONUS =
  0.34;

const RECALL_V13_FOUNDATIONAL_BONUS =
  0.52;

const RECALL_V13_REINFORCEMENT_BONUS_MAX =
  0.34;

const RECALL_V13_IMPORTANCE_WEIGHT =
  0.42;

const RECALL_V13_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT =
  0.16;

const RECALL_V13_RECENCY_WEIGHT =
  0.14;

const RECALL_V13_SEMANTIC_WEIGHT =
  0.88;

const RECALL_V13_SUBJECT_MATCH_BONUS =
  0.30;

const RECALL_V13_TYPE_MATCH_BONUS =
  0.12;

const RECALL_V13_QUOTE_BONUS =
  0.08;

const RECALL_V13_UNRESOLVED_BONUS =
  0.15;

const RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS =
  32000;


// =========================================================
// BASIC RETRIEVAL HELPERS
// =========================================================

function recallV13BoundedNumber(
  value,
  minimum,
  maximum,
  fallback
) {
  return clamp(
    finiteNumber(
      value,
      fallback
    ),
    minimum,
    maximum
  );
}


function recallV13AgeInDays(
  isoDate
) {
  if (!isoDate) {
    return 3650;
  }

  const timestamp =
    Date.parse(
      isoDate
    );

  if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {
    return 3650;
  }

  return Math.max(
    0,
    (
      Date.now() -
      timestamp
    ) /
      86400000
  );
}


function recallV13RecencyScore(
  isoDate
) {
  const ageDays =
    recallV13AgeInDays(
      isoDate
    );

  if (ageDays <= 1) {
    return 1;
  }

  if (ageDays <= 7) {
    return 0.9;
  }

  if (ageDays <= 30) {
    return 0.75;
  }

  if (ageDays <= 90) {
    return 0.58;
  }

  if (ageDays <= 365) {
    return 0.40;
  }

  if (ageDays <= 1095) {
    return 0.24;
  }

  return 0.12;
}


function recallV13ReinforcementScore(
  count
) {
  const normalized =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        count,
        0
      )
    );

  if (normalized <= 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  return Math.min(
    1,
    Math.log2(
      normalized + 1
    ) / 6
  );
}


function recallV13ImportanceScore(
  importance
) {
  return recallV13BoundedNumber(
    importance,
    0,
    100,
    25
  ) / 100;
}


function recallV13ConfidenceScore(
  confidence
) {
  return recallV13BoundedNumber(
    confidence,
    0,
    1,
    0.75
  );
}


// =========================================================
// QUERY ANALYSIS
//
// This remains deliberately cheap.
//
// The full model receives the final retrieved context.
// We do not need another model call merely to identify
// obvious words, subjects and memory categories.
// =========================================================

function analyzeRecallRetrievalQueryV13(
  query
) {
  const raw =
    normalizeString(
      query,
      "",
      60000
    );

  const lower =
    raw.toLowerCase();

  const tokens =
    [
      ...recallV13TokenSet(
        raw
      )
    ];

  const subjectKeys =
    new Set();

  for (const token of tokens) {
    if (token.length >= 4) {
      subjectKeys.add(
        recallV13NormalizeKey(
          token
        )
      );
    }
  }

  const requestedTypes =
    new Set();

  if (
    /\bremember|remembered|recall|last time|before|previously|earlier\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.EVENT
    );

    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.FACT
    );
  }

  if (
    /\bsaid|told|quote|exact words|what did .* say\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.QUOTE
    );
  }

  if (
    /\bpromise|promised|swore|agreed\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.PROMISE
    );
  }

  if (
    /\bbelieve|belief|think|thought|opinion|position|argued|argument\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.BELIEF
    );

    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.OPINION
    );

    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.SELF_POSITION
    );
  }

  if (
    /\blike|likes|liked|prefer|prefers|favorite|favourite|hate|hates\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.PREFERENCE
    );
  }

  if (
    /\bcontradict|contradiction|hypocrit|changed your mind|changed my mind\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.CONTRADICTION
    );
  }

  if (
    /\balways|every time|keep doing|pattern|usually|often|again\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.PATTERN
    );
  }

  if (
    /\brelationship|friend|wife|husband|partner|mother|father|son|daughter\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.RELATIONSHIP
    );
  }

  if (
    /\bdocument|manuscript|novel|book|upload|file\b/i
      .test(raw)
  ) {
    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.DOCUMENT
    );

    requestedTypes.add(
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.DOCUMENT_INSIGHT
    );
  }

  return {
    raw,
    lower,
    tokens,
    subjectKeys:
      [...subjectKeys],
    requestedTypes:
      [...requestedTypes]
  };
}


// =========================================================
// LOAD RETRIEVAL CANDIDATES
// =========================================================

async function loadRecallRetrievalCandidatesV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  limit =
    RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CANDIDATE_LIMIT
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT
          *

        FROM recall_memories_v2

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0

        ORDER BY
          is_foundational DESC,
          importance DESC,
          reinforcement_count DESC,
          last_observed_at DESC,
          id DESC

        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,

        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            limit,
            RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CANDIDATE_LIMIT
          ),
          1,
          500
        )
      )
      .all();

  return Array.isArray(
    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}


// =========================================================
// SCORE ONE MEMORY
// =========================================================

function scoreRecallMemoryV13(
  memory,
  queryAnalysis
) {
  const query =
    queryAnalysis?.raw ||
    "";

  const memoryText =
    [
      memory?.summary,
      memory?.detail,
      memory?.exact_quote,
      memory?.subject_key
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");

  const semanticScore =
    query
      ? recallV13TextSimilarity(
          query,
          memoryText
        )
      : 0;

  const importanceScore =
    recallV13ImportanceScore(
      memory?.importance
    );

  const confidenceScore =
    recallV13ConfidenceScore(
      memory?.confidence
    );

  const recencyScore =
    recallV13RecencyScore(
      memory?.last_observed_at ||
      memory?.updated_at ||
      memory?.created_at
    );

  const reinforcementScore =
    recallV13ReinforcementScore(
      memory?.reinforcement_count
    );

  let score =
    semanticScore *
      RECALL_V13_SEMANTIC_WEIGHT +
    importanceScore *
      RECALL_V13_IMPORTANCE_WEIGHT +
    confidenceScore *
      RECALL_V13_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT +
    recencyScore *
      RECALL_V13_RECENCY_WEIGHT +
    reinforcementScore *
      RECALL_V13_REINFORCEMENT_BONUS_MAX;

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.is_foundational,
      0
    ) === 1
  ) {
    score +=
      RECALL_V13_FOUNDATIONAL_BONUS;
  }

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.source_episode,
      -1
    ) === 1
  ) {
    score +=
      RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_BONUS;
  }

  if (
    memory?.subject_key &&
    Array.isArray(
      queryAnalysis?.subjectKeys
    )
  ) {
    const normalizedMemorySubject =
      recallV13NormalizeKey(
        memory.subject_key
      );

    const subjectMatched =
      queryAnalysis.subjectKeys
        .some(
          (subjectKey) =>
            normalizedMemorySubject ===
              subjectKey ||
            normalizedMemorySubject
              .includes(
                subjectKey
              ) ||
            subjectKey
              .includes(
                normalizedMemorySubject
              )
        );

    if (subjectMatched) {
      score +=
        RECALL_V13_SUBJECT_MATCH_BONUS;
    }
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      queryAnalysis?.requestedTypes
    ) &&
    queryAnalysis.requestedTypes
      .includes(
        normalizeRecallMemoryType(
          memory?.memory_type
        )
      )
  ) {
    score +=
      RECALL_V13_TYPE_MATCH_BONUS;
  }

  if (memory?.exact_quote) {
    score +=
      RECALL_V13_QUOTE_BONUS;
  }

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.is_resolved,
      0
    ) === 0 &&
    [
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.QUESTION,
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.DISPUTE,
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.CONTRADICTION
    ]
      .includes(
        normalizeRecallMemoryType(
          memory?.memory_type
        )
      )
  ) {
    score +=
      RECALL_V13_UNRESOLVED_BONUS;
  }

  return {
    ...memory,

    retrieval_score:
      score,

    retrieval_components: {
      semantic:
        semanticScore,

      importance:
        importanceScore,

      confidence:
        confidenceScore,

      recency:
        recencyScore,

      reinforcement:
        reinforcementScore
    }
  };
}


// =========================================================
// DIVERSIFY MEMORY RESULTS
//
// Without this, one heavily repeated topic can crowd every
// other useful memory out of the prompt.
// =========================================================

function diversifyRecallMemoriesV13(
  scored,
  limit =
    RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FINAL_LIMIT
) {
  const source =
    Array.isArray(
      scored
    )
      ? scored
      : [];

  const selected =
    [];

  const subjectCounts =
    new Map();

  const typeCounts =
    new Map();

  for (const memory of source) {
    if (
      selected.length >=
      limit
    ) {
      break;
    }

    const subject =
      memory?.subject_key ||
      "__none__";

    const type =
      memory?.memory_type ||
      "other";

    const subjectCount =
      subjectCounts.get(
        subject
      ) ||
      0;

    const typeCount =
      typeCounts.get(
        type
      ) ||
      0;

    const foundational =
      integerNumber(
        memory?.is_foundational,
        0
      ) === 1;

    if (
      !foundational &&
      subjectCount >= 5
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    if (
      !foundational &&
      typeCount >= 10
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    selected.push(
      memory
    );

    subjectCounts.set(
      subject,
      subjectCount + 1
    );

    typeCounts.set(
      type,
      typeCount + 1
    );
  }

  return selected;
}


// =========================================================
// SMART MEMORY RETRIEVAL
// =========================================================

async function retrieveRecallMemoriesV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  query,
  {
    limit =
      RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FINAL_LIMIT
  } = {}
) {
  await initializeRecallMemoryV13ForVisitor(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const queryAnalysis =
    analyzeRecallRetrievalQueryV13(
      query
    );

  const candidates =
    await loadRecallRetrievalCandidatesV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CANDIDATE_LIMIT
    );

  const scored =
    candidates
      .map(
        (memory) =>
          scoreRecallMemoryV13(
            memory,
            queryAnalysis
          )
      )
      .sort(
        (left, right) =>
          right.retrieval_score -
          left.retrieval_score
      );

  return diversifyRecallMemoriesV13(
    scored,
    clamp(
      integerNumber(
        limit,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FINAL_LIMIT
      ),
      1,
      100
    )
  );
}


// =========================================================
// FIRST-CONVERSATION PRIVILEGED RECALL
//
// The first conversation is not merely "old chat."
//
// It is formative evidence.
//
// It remains available even after years of later material,
// while still yielding to directly relevant memories.
// =========================================================

async function loadFirstConversationRecallV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  limit =
    RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_LIMIT
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_memories_v2

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
          AND source_episode = 1

        ORDER BY
          is_foundational DESC,
          importance DESC,
          reinforcement_count DESC,
          id ASC

        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,

        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            limit,
            RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_LIMIT
          ),
          1,
          100
        )
      )
      .all();

  return Array.isArray(
    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}


// =========================================================
// LOAD IMPORTANT SUBJECTS
// =========================================================

async function loadRecallSubjectsForPromptV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  limit =
    RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_SUBJECT_LIMIT
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_memory_subjects

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        ORDER BY
          importance DESC,
          mention_count DESC,
          last_mentioned_at DESC

        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,

        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            limit,
            RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_SUBJECT_LIMIT
          ),
          1,
          100
        )
      )
      .all();

  return Array.isArray(
    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}


// =========================================================
// BUILD COMPLETE LONG-TERM MEMORY PACKET
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallMemoryPacketV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  query
) {
  await initializeRecallMemoryV13ForVisitor(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const [
    relevantMemories,
    foundationalMemories,
    firstConversation,
    patterns,
    contradictions,
    judgments,
    positions,
    openThreads,
    subjects
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      retrieveRecallMemoriesV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        query,
        {
          limit:
            RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FINAL_LIMIT
        }
      ),

      loadFoundationalRecallMemoriesV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_FOUNDATIONAL_LIMIT
      ),

      loadFirstConversationRecallV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_FIRST_CONVERSATION_LIMIT
      ),

      loadConfirmedRecallPatternsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_PATTERN_LIMIT
      ),

      loadRecallContradictionsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_CONTRADICTION_LIMIT
      ),

      loadNamelessJudgmentsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_JUDGMENT_LIMIT
      ),

      loadNamelessPositionsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_POSITION_LIMIT
      ),

      loadRecallOpenThreadsV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        CHARACTER_NAMELESS,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_THREAD_LIMIT
      ),

      loadRecallSubjectsForPromptV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        RECALL_V13_RETRIEVAL_SUBJECT_LIMIT
      )
    ]);

  return {
    relevantMemories,
    foundationalMemories,
    firstConversation,
    patterns,
    contradictions,
    judgments,
    positions,
    openThreads,
    subjects
  };
}


// =========================================================
// DEDUPLICATE PROMPT MEMORIES
// =========================================================

function deduplicateRecallPromptMemoriesV13(
  groups
) {
  const seenIds =
    new Set();

  const seenText =
    new Set();

  const output =
    [];

  for (
    const group
    of groups
  ) {
    for (
      const memory
      of (
        Array.isArray(group)
          ? group
          : []
      )
    ) {
      const id =
        memory?.id !== undefined &&
        memory?.id !== null
          ? String(
              memory.id
            )
          : null;

      const textKey =
        recallV13NormalizeKey(
          memory?.summary ||
          memory?.detail ||
          memory?.exact_quote ||
          ""
        );

      if (
        id &&
        seenIds.has(id)
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      if (
        textKey &&
        textKey !== "general" &&
        seenText.has(
          textKey
        )
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      if (id) {
        seenIds.add(
          id
        );
      }

      if (
        textKey &&
        textKey !== "general"
      ) {
        seenText.add(
          textKey
        );
      }

      output.push(
        memory
      );
    }
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT ONE MEMORY
// =========================================================

function formatRecallMemoryForPromptV13(
  memory
) {
  const flags =
    [];

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.is_foundational,
      0
    ) === 1
  ) {
    flags.push(
      "FOUNDATIONAL"
    );
  }

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.source_episode,
      -1
    ) === 1
  ) {
    flags.push(
      "FIRST-CONVERSATION"
    );
  }

  const reinforcement =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        memory?.reinforcement_count,
        0
      )
    );

  if (reinforcement >= 2) {
    flags.push(
      `REINFORCED:${reinforcement}`
    );
  }

  if (
    integerNumber(
      memory?.is_resolved,
      0
    ) === 0 &&
    [
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.QUESTION,
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.DISPUTE,
      RECALL_MEMORY_TYPES.CONTRADICTION
    ]
      .includes(
        normalizeRecallMemoryType(
          memory?.memory_type
        )
      )
  ) {
    flags.push(
      "UNRESOLVED"
    );
  }

  const header =
    [
      memory?.memory_type ||
        "memory",

      memory?.subject_key ||
        null,

      flags.length
        ? flags.join(",")
        : null
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" | ");

  const body =
    normalizeString(
      memory?.summary,
      "",
      4000
    );

  const detail =
    normalizeString(
      memory?.detail,
      "",
      5000
    );

  const quote =
    normalizeString(
      memory?.exact_quote,
      "",
      3000
    );

  let output =
    `- [${header}] ${body}`;

  if (
    detail &&
    detail !== body
  ) {
    output +=
      `\n  Detail: ${detail}`;
  }

  if (quote) {
    output +=
      `\n  Exact quote: "${quote}"`;
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT PATTERNS
// =========================================================

function formatRecallPatternForPromptV13(
  pattern
) {
  return (
    `- ${normalizeString(
      pattern?.description,
      "",
      4000
    )}` +
    ` [evidence=${Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        pattern?.evidence_count,
        0
      )
    )}; counterexamples=${Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        pattern?.counterexample_count,
        0
      )
    )}; confidence=${recallV13ConfidenceScore(
      pattern?.confidence
    ).toFixed(2)}]`
  );
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT JUDGMENTS
// =========================================================

function formatRecallJudgmentForPromptV13(
  judgment
) {
  return (
    `- ${normalizeString(
      judgment?.judgment,
      "",
      5000
    )}` +
    ` [support=${Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        judgment?.supporting_evidence_count,
        0
      )
    )}; opposition=${Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        judgment?.opposing_evidence_count,
        0
      )
    )}; confidence=${recallV13ConfidenceScore(
      judgment?.confidence
    ).toFixed(2)}]`
  );
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT CONTRADICTIONS
// =========================================================

function formatRecallContradictionForPromptV13(
  contradiction
) {
  const earlier =
    normalizeString(
      contradiction?.earlier_claim,
      "",
      3500
    );

  const later =
    normalizeString(
      contradiction?.later_claim,
      "",
      3500
    );

  const explanation =
    normalizeString(
      contradiction?.explanation,
      "",
      2500
    );

  let output =
    `- Earlier: ${earlier}\n  Later: ${later}`;

  if (explanation) {
    output +=
      `\n  Analyst note: ${explanation}`;
  }

  output +=
    `\n  Confidence: ${recallV13ConfidenceScore(
      contradiction?.confidence
    ).toFixed(2)}`;

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT NAMELESS POSITIONS
// =========================================================

function formatNamelessPositionForPromptV13(
  position
) {
  return (
    `- [${normalizeString(
      position?.topic_key,
      "general",
      300
    )}] ` +
    normalizeString(
      position?.position_text,
      "",
      5000
    )
  );
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT OPEN THREADS
// =========================================================

function formatRecallOpenThreadForPromptV13(
  thread
) {
  const title =
    normalizeString(
      thread?.title,
      "",
      2000
    );

  const description =
    normalizeString(
      thread?.description,
      "",
      3000
    );

  let output =
    `- ${title}`;

  if (description) {
    output +=
      ` — ${description}`;
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT SUBJECTS
// =========================================================

function formatRecallSubjectForPromptV13(
  subject
) {
  return (
    `- ${normalizeString(
      subject?.display_name ||
      subject?.subject_key,
      "",
      1000
    )}` +
    ` [type=${normalizeString(
      subject?.subject_type,
      "topic",
      100
    )}; mentions=${Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        subject?.mention_count,
        0
      )
    )}; importance=${normalizeRecallV13Importance(
      subject?.importance,
      25
    )}]`
  );
}


// =========================================================
// EVIDENCE THRESHOLD FOR GENERALIZATIONS
//
// Nameless is allowed to notice patterns.
//
// He is NOT allowed to turn one event into:
//
// "you always..."
// "you never..."
// "every time..."
// "this is what you do..."
//
// unless stored evidence supports it.
// =========================================================

function recallV13PatternAllowsStrongGeneralization(
  pattern
) {
  const evidence =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        pattern?.evidence_count,
        0
      )
    );

  const counterexamples =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        pattern?.counterexample_count,
        0
      )
    );

  const confidence =
    recallV13ConfidenceScore(
      pattern?.confidence
    );

  if (
    evidence < 3
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    confidence < 0.58
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    counterexamples >=
    evidence
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}


// =========================================================
// BUILD GENERALIZATION GUIDANCE
// =========================================================

function buildRecallGeneralizationGuidanceV13(
  patterns
) {
  const source =
    Array.isArray(
      patterns
    )
      ? patterns
      : [];

  const strong =
    source.filter(
      recallV13PatternAllowsStrongGeneralization
    );

  const weak =
    source.filter(
      (pattern) =>
        !recallV13PatternAllowsStrongGeneralization(
          pattern
        )
    );

  const lines =
    [];

  lines.push(
    "PATTERN LANGUAGE RULE:"
  );

  lines.push(
    "Do not say the player 'always', 'never', 'every time', or 'keeps doing this' merely because one remembered example resembles the present situation."
  );

  if (strong.length) {
    lines.push(
      ""
    );

    lines.push(
      "PATTERNS WITH ENOUGH EVIDENCE FOR STRONGER GENERALIZATION:"
    );

    for (const pattern of strong) {
      lines.push(
        formatRecallPatternForPromptV13(
          pattern
        )
      );
    }
  }

  if (weak.length) {
    lines.push(
      ""
    );

    lines.push(
      "TENTATIVE PATTERNS — MAY BE NOTICED, BUT SPEAK CAUTIOUSLY:"
    );

    for (const pattern of weak) {
      lines.push(
        formatRecallPatternForPromptV13(
          pattern
        )
      );
    }
  }

  return lines.join(
    "\n"
  );
}


// =========================================================
// BUILD MEMORY CONTEXT STRING
// =========================================================

function renderRecallMemoryPacketV13(
  packet
) {
  const sections =
    [];

  const mergedMemories =
    deduplicateRecallPromptMemoriesV13([
      packet?.foundationalMemories,
      packet?.firstConversation,
      packet?.relevantMemories
    ]);

  if (mergedMemories.length) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "LONG-TERM MEMORY:",
        "",
        ...mergedMemories.map(
          formatRecallMemoryForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.subjects
    ) &&
    packet.subjects.length
  ) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "IMPORTANT RECURRING SUBJECTS:",
        "",
        ...packet.subjects.map(
          formatRecallSubjectForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.judgments
    ) &&
    packet.judgments.length
  ) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "NAMELESS'S CURRENT JUDGMENTS:",
        "",
        "These are Nameless's interpretations, not objective facts.",
        "",
        ...packet.judgments.map(
          formatRecallJudgmentForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.positions
    ) &&
    packet.positions.length
  ) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "NAMELESS'S OWN PRIOR POSITIONS:",
        "",
        "These are positions Nameless himself previously argued.",
        "He may stand by them, qualify them, reverse them, or be confronted with them.",
        "",
        ...packet.positions.map(
          formatNamelessPositionForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.contradictions
    ) &&
    packet.contradictions.length
  ) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "UNRESOLVED POSSIBLE CONTRADICTIONS:",
        "",
        "These are possible conflicts detected by continuity analysis.",
        "Do not automatically accuse the player of lying.",
        "Changed circumstances, jokes, nuance, or a genuine change of mind may explain them.",
        "",
        ...packet.contradictions.map(
          formatRecallContradictionForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  if (
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.openThreads
    ) &&
    packet.openThreads.length
  ) {
    sections.push(
      [
        "UNFINISHED BUSINESS:",
        "",
        ...packet.openThreads.map(
          formatRecallOpenThreadForPromptV13
        )
      ].join("\n")
    );
  }

  sections.push(
    buildRecallGeneralizationGuidanceV13(
      packet?.patterns ||
      []
    )
  );

  let output =
    sections
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(
        "\n\n==============================\n\n"
      );

  if (
    output.length >
    RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS
  ) {
    output =
      output.slice(
        0,
        RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS
      ) +
      "\n\n[LONG-TERM MEMORY CONTEXT TRUNCATED FOR THIS TURN]";
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// BUILD READY-TO-INJECT MEMORY CONTEXT
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallMemoryContextV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  currentUserMessage
) {
  const packet =
    await buildRecallMemoryPacketV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      currentUserMessage
    );

  return {
    packet,

    text:
      renderRecallMemoryPacketV13(
        packet
      )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MEMORY BEHAVIOR DIRECTIVE
//
// This is deliberately explicit.
//
// Merely dumping database rows into the model prompt does
// not create good long-term memory behavior.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V13_MEMORY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECTIVE = `
LONG-TERM CONTINUITY RULES:

You possess persistent long-term memory of this audience member.

Use memory naturally.

Do not announce that you queried a database.
Do not say "according to my memory records."
Do not dump memories merely to prove you remember them.

A remembered fact should affect how you interpret the current conversation.

A remembered argument may be referenced when relevant.

A remembered promise may be enforced.

An unresolved dispute may return later.

An old joke may become an inside joke.

A recurring subject may acquire emotional history.

A contradiction may be challenged if the contradiction is real and relevant.

A pattern may be named only when there is enough evidence.

IMPORTANT:

One example is not "you always do this."

Two examples may suggest a tendency.

Three or more credible examples can justify stronger language if there are not equally strong counterexamples.

FOUNDATIONAL MEMORY:

Foundational memories carry exceptional continuity weight.
They should not dominate unrelated conversations, but when relevant they outrank ordinary recent trivia.

FIRST CONVERSATION:

The first conversation is formative.
It may remain psychologically important years later.

Do not constantly mention that something came from the first conversation.
Simply allow those memories to retain unusual weight.

REINFORCEMENT:

Repeated memories are stronger evidence than one-off remarks.

A statement repeated over months is more meaningful than an incidental sentence.

SUBJECTIVE JUDGMENTS:

Nameless's stored judgments are HIS judgments.
They are not guaranteed facts.

He can be wrong.
He can become more confident.
He can lose confidence.
He can revise himself.

SELF-CONTINUITY:

Nameless remembers his own substantive positions.

If he previously argued something and now argues the opposite, he should not magically forget the earlier position.

He may explain the change.
He may admit the change.
He may defend the distinction.
He may stubbornly deny inconsistency if that is dramatically appropriate.

But the underlying continuity remains available.

CONTRADICTIONS:

Do not treat every inconsistency as deception.

People change their minds.
People joke.
People exaggerate.
Circumstances change.
Memory is imperfect.

Challenge only when the conflict is meaningful enough to matter.

NATURALISM:

Memory should make the relationship feel accumulated, not mechanical.
`.trim();


// =========================================================
// BUILD COMPLETE MODEL MEMORY INJECTION
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallModelMemoryInjectionV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  currentUserMessage
) {
  const context =
    await buildRecallMemoryContextV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      currentUserMessage
    );

  if (!context.text) {
    return {
      packet:
        context.packet,

      text:
        RECALL_V13_MEMORY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECTIVE
    };
  }

  return {
    packet:
      context.packet,

    text:
      [
        RECALL_V13_MEMORY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECTIVE,
        "",
        "==============================",
        "",
        context.text
      ].join("\n")
  };
}


// =========================================================
// RELEVANT RELATIONSHIP RETRIEVAL
// =========================================================

async function loadRecallRelationshipsForPromptV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  limit = 12
) {
  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT *

        FROM recall_relationships

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        ORDER BY
          importance DESC,
          interaction_count DESC,
          updated_at DESC

        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId,

        clamp(
          integerNumber(
            limit,
            12
          ),
          1,
          100
        )
      )
      .all();

  return Array.isArray(
    result?.results
  )
    ? result.results
    : [];
}


// =========================================================
// FORMAT RELATIONSHIP STATE
// =========================================================

function formatRecallRelationshipForPromptV13(
  relationship
) {
  const character =
    normalizeString(
      relationship?.character_key,
      "unknown",
      200
    );

  const state =
    normalizeString(
      relationship?.relationship_state,
      "unknown",
      1000
    );

  const notes =
    normalizeString(
      relationship?.notes,
      "",
      3000
    );

  const interactions =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        relationship?.interaction_count,
        0
      )
    );

  let output =
    `- ${character}: ${state} [interactions=${interactions}]`;

  if (notes) {
    output +=
      ` — ${notes}`;
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// EXTENDED MEMORY PACKET WITH RELATIONSHIPS
// =========================================================

async function buildExtendedRecallMemoryPacketV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  query
) {
  const [
    packet,
    relationships
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      buildRecallMemoryPacketV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        query
      ),

      loadRecallRelationshipsForPromptV13(
        env,
        visitorId,
        12
      )
    ]);

  return {
    ...packet,
    relationships
  };
}


// =========================================================
// EXTENDED MEMORY RENDERER
// =========================================================

function renderExtendedRecallMemoryPacketV13(
  packet
) {
  const base =
    renderRecallMemoryPacketV13(
      packet
    );

  const relationships =
    Array.isArray(
      packet?.relationships
    )
      ? packet.relationships
      : [];

  if (!relationships.length) {
    return base;
  }

  const relationshipText =
    [
      "RELATIONSHIP CONTINUITY:",
      "",
      ...relationships.map(
        formatRecallRelationshipForPromptV13
      )
    ].join("\n");

  let output =
    [
      base,
      relationshipText
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(
        "\n\n==============================\n\n"
      );

  if (
    output.length >
    RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS
  ) {
    output =
      output.slice(
        0,
        RECALL_V13_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS
      ) +
      "\n\n[LONG-TERM MEMORY CONTEXT TRUNCATED FOR THIS TURN]";
  }

  return output;
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL MEMORY INJECTION BUILDER
// =========================================================

async function buildExtendedRecallModelMemoryInjectionV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  currentUserMessage
) {
  const packet =
    await buildExtendedRecallMemoryPacketV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      currentUserMessage
    );

  const contextText =
    renderExtendedRecallMemoryPacketV13(
      packet
    );

  return {
    packet,

    text:
      [
        RECALL_V13_MEMORY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECTIVE,
        "",
        "==============================",
        "",
        contextText
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join("\n")
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MEMORY DEBUG SUMMARY
//
// Useful during development without exposing entire private
// memory contents to the normal show UI.
// =========================================================

async function getRecallRetrievalDebugV13(
  env,
  visitorId,
  query
) {
  const packet =
    await buildExtendedRecallMemoryPacketV13(
      env,
      visitorId,
      query
    );

  return {
    query:
      normalizeString(
        query,
        "",
        2000
      ),

    relevantMemories:
      packet.relevantMemories
        .map(
          (memory) => ({
            id:
              memory.id,

            type:
              memory.memory_type,

            subject:
              memory.subject_key,

            summary:
              memory.summary,

            score:
              memory.retrieval_score,

            components:
              memory.retrieval_components,

            foundational:
              Boolean(
                integerNumber(
                  memory.is_foundational,
                  0
                )
              ),

            reinforcementCount:
              integerNumber(
                memory.reinforcement_count,
                0
              ),

            firstConversation:
              integerNumber(
                memory.source_episode,
                -1
              ) === 1
          })
        ),

    foundationalCount:
      packet.foundationalMemories.length,

    firstConversationCount:
      packet.firstConversation.length,

    patternCount:
      packet.patterns.length,

    contradictionCount:
      packet.contradictions.length,

    judgmentCount:
      packet.judgments.length,

    positionCount:
      packet.positions.length,

    openThreadCount:
      packet.openThreads.length,

    subjectCount:
      packet.subjects.length,

    relationshipCount:
      packet.relationships.length
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MEMORY HEALTH / RETRIEVAL STATUS
// =========================================================

async function getRecallMemoryV13Part3Status(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  await initializeRecallMemoryV13ForVisitor(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const [
    memoryCount,
    foundationalCount,
    reinforcedCount,
    firstConversationCount,
    patternCount,
    contradictionCount,
    judgmentCount,
    positionCount,
    threadCount
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_memories_v2
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_memories_v2
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
          AND is_foundational = 1
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_memories_v2
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
          AND reinforcement_count >= 2
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_memories_v2
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND is_archived = 0
          AND source_episode = 1
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_patterns
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND evidence_count >= ?
      `)
        .bind(
          visitorId,
          RECALL_V13_PATTERN_MIN_EVIDENCE
        )
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_contradictions
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND status = 'unresolved'
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_nameless_judgments
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND active = 1
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_nameless_positions
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND active = 1
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first(),

      db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM recall_open_threads
        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND status = 'open'
      `)
        .bind(visitorId)
        .first()
    ]);

  return {
    memories:
      integerNumber(
        memoryCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    foundationalMemories:
      integerNumber(
        foundationalCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    reinforcedMemories:
      integerNumber(
        reinforcedCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    firstConversationMemories:
      integerNumber(
        firstConversationCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    confirmedPatterns:
      integerNumber(
        patternCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    unresolvedContradictions:
      integerNumber(
        contradictionCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    activeJudgments:
      integerNumber(
        judgmentCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    activeNamelessPositions:
      integerNumber(
        positionCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    openThreads:
      integerNumber(
        threadCount?.count,
        0
      ),

    part3Installed:
      true
  };
}

// =========================================================
// DOCUMENT CONFIGURATION
