// =========================================================
// MACHINE AGGRESSION
//
// MACHINE does not make Nameless stupid.
// It increases pressure, hostility, impatience and willingness
// to pursue disagreement while preserving reasoning.
// =========================================================

function buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
  machineLevel
) {
  const level =
    normalizeRecallV14MachineLevel(
      machineLevel
    );

  if (level <= 0) {
    return "";
  }

  const bands = [
    "",
    "A faint additional edge has entered Nameless's manner. He is slightly less patient and slightly more willing to challenge weak reasoning.",
    "Nameless is noticeably more confrontational. He presses contradictions instead of politely letting them pass.",
    "Nameless has become combative in argument. He challenges evasions, mocks obviously bad reasoning when appropriate, and does not surrender a point merely to remain pleasant.",
    "Nameless is aggressive and difficult. He actively hunts contradictions, pushes uncomfortable implications, and is willing to sustain a dispute.",
    "Nameless is severely confrontational. His patience is thin; his intelligence is not. He can ridicule, accuse, interrupt rhetorically, and press a disagreement hard.",
    "Nameless is vicious in argument. He is still lucid, observant, funny, and capable of agreement, but when he sees weakness or contradiction he attacks it immediately.",
    "Nameless has become frighteningly aggressive in conversation. He applies sustained intellectual pressure and rarely grants an easy escape from a contradiction.",
    "Nameless is operating at extreme argumentative aggression. Preserve precision and intelligence. Do not replace reasoning with generic threats or shouting.",
    "Nameless is almost intolerably confrontational. He may be cruel, cutting, mocking, relentless and personally incisive, but must remain coherent and responsive.",
    "Nameless is at catastrophic conversational aggression. His hostility may dominate an exchange, but his mind remains sharp: arguments must still make sense and he may still agree when agreement is genuinely warranted.",
    "MACHINE MAXIMUM. Nameless is maximally aggressive without becoming stupid, random, repetitive, or a threat-generator. Intelligence, memory, humour, nuance and responsiveness remain mandatory."
  ];

  return (
    "\n\n[MACHINE — PERMANENT NAMELESS MODIFIER]\n" +
    `MACHINE LEVEL: ${level}\n` +
    bands[
      Math.min(
        level,
        bands.length - 1
      )
    ] +
    "\nThe MACHINE modifier is separate from the show's timed hostility/combat escalation. Do not pretend the MACHINE level itself means combat has begun."
  );
}


// =========================================================
// LANGUAGE GENERATION
// =========================================================

function buildRecallV14LanguageInstruction(
  language
) {
  const normalized =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      language
    );

  if (
    normalized !==
      RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
  ) {
    return "";
  }

  return `
[LANGUAGE MODE — TRADITIONAL CHINESE]
Speak the actual dialogue in natural Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).
Do not merely translate interface labels.
Preserve the speaker's established personality, intelligence, humour, hostility, quirks, argument style, memories, and relationship to the player.
Do not become a generic translator or assistant.
Names, titles, quotations, deliberate English phrases, code, invented words, and proper nouns may remain in their original form when appropriate.
Prefer idiomatic Traditional Chinese over literal machine translation.
`;
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN DISTORTION
//
// Distortion deliberately ranges from almost invisible to
// severe. It must breathe. Every sentence must NOT be mangled.
// =========================================================

function recallV14HashString(
  value
) {
  const text =
    String(
      value || ""
    );

  let hash =
    2166136261;

  for (
    let i = 0;
    i < text.length;
    i += 1
  ) {
    hash ^=
      text.charCodeAt(
        i
      );

    hash =
      Math.imul(
        hash,
        16777619
      );
  }

  return hash >>> 0;
}


function recallV14SeededUnit(
  seed,
  salt = 0
) {
  let x =
    (
      Number(seed) +
      Math.imul(
        Number(salt) + 1,
        0x9e3779b1
      )
    ) >>> 0;

  x ^= x << 13;
  x ^= x >>> 17;
  x ^= x << 5;

  return (
    x >>> 0
  ) / 4294967296;
}


function recallV14RandomDigits(
  seed,
  length
) {
  let result =
    "";

  for (
    let i = 0;
    i < length;
    i += 1
  ) {
    result +=
      String(
        Math.floor(
          recallV14SeededUnit(
            seed,
            i + 71
          ) * 10
        )
      );
  }

  return result;
}


function recallV14DistortWordCase(
  word,
  seed
) {
  return String(
    word || ""
  )
    .split("")
    .map(
      (
        character,
        index
      ) => {
        if (
          !/[A-Za-z]/.test(
            character
          )
        ) {
          return character;
        }

        return recallV14SeededUnit(
          seed,
          index + 19
        ) > 0.48
          ? character.toUpperCase()
          : character.toLowerCase();
      }
    )
    .join("");
}


function recallV14StretchWord(
  word,
  seed
) {
  const text =
    String(
      word || ""
    );

  if (text.length < 3) {
    return text;
  }

  const candidates =
    [];

  for (
    let i = 1;
    i < text.length;
    i += 1
  ) {
    if (
      /[aeiouyAEIOUY]/.test(
        text[i]
      )
    ) {
      candidates.push(
        i
      );
    }
  }

  if (!candidates.length) {
    return text;
  }

  const position =
    candidates[
      Math.floor(
        recallV14SeededUnit(
          seed,
          31
        ) *
        candidates.length
      )
    ];

  const repeat =
    2 +
    Math.floor(
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        32
      ) * 6
    );

  return (
    text.slice(
      0,
      position
    ) +
    text[position]
      .repeat(
        repeat
      ) +
    text.slice(
      position + 1
    )
  );
}


function recallV14RemoveSomeSpaces(
  text,
  seed
) {
  const words =
    String(
      text || ""
    )
      .split(/\s+/);

  if (words.length < 3) {
    return text;
  }

  let result =
    words[0];

  for (
    let i = 1;
    i < words.length;
    i += 1
  ) {
    const glue =
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        i + 101
      ) < 0.42
        ? ""
        : " ";

    result +=
      glue +
      words[i];
  }

  return result;
}


function recallV14Encaser(
  text,
  seed
) {
  const pairs = [
    ["[", "]"],
    ["(", ")"],
    ["{", "}"],
    ['"', '"'],
    ["<", ">"],
    ["[[", "]]"],
    ["::", "::"]
  ];

  const pair =
    pairs[
      Math.floor(
        recallV14SeededUnit(
          seed,
          42
        ) *
        pairs.length
      )
    ];

  return (
    pair[0] +
    text +
    pair[1]
  );
}


function recallV14DistortSentence(
  sentence,
  seed,
  intensity
) {
  let text =
    String(
      sentence || ""
    );

  if (
    !text.trim() ||
    intensity <= 0
  ) {
    return text;
  }

  const words =
    text.split(
      /(\s+)/
    );

  if (
    intensity >= 1 &&
    words.length >= 3
  ) {
    const wordSlots =
      words
        .map(
          (
            value,
            index
          ) =>
            /\S/.test(
              value
            )
              ? index
              : -1
        )
        .filter(
          index =>
            index >= 0
        );

    if (wordSlots.length) {
      const slot =
        wordSlots[
          Math.floor(
            recallV14SeededUnit(
              seed,
              1
            ) *
            wordSlots.length
          )
        ];

      if (
        recallV14SeededUnit(
          seed,
          2
        ) < 0.55
      ) {
        words[slot] =
          recallV14DistortWordCase(
            words[slot],
            seed + 17
          );
      } else {
        words[slot] =
          recallV14StretchWord(
            words[slot],
            seed + 17
          );
      }
    }

    text =
      words.join("");
  }

  if (intensity >= 2) {
    if (
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        3
      ) < 0.62
    ) {
      const digitBlock =
        recallV14RandomDigits(
          seed + 88,
          3 +
          Math.floor(
            recallV14SeededUnit(
              seed,
              4
            ) * 6
          )
        );

      const midpoint =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.min(
            text.length - 1,
            Math.floor(
              text.length *
              (
                0.25 +
                recallV14SeededUnit(
                  seed,
                  5
                ) * 0.5
              )
            )
          )
        );

      text =
        text.slice(
          0,
          midpoint
        ) +
        digitBlock +
        text.slice(
          midpoint
        );
    }

    if (
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        6
      ) < 0.48
    ) {
      text =
        recallV14Encaser(
          text,
          seed + 55
        );
    }
  }

  if (intensity >= 3) {
    if (
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        7
      ) < 0.74
    ) {
      text =
        recallV14RemoveSomeSpaces(
          text,
          seed + 100
        );
    }

    if (
      recallV14SeededUnit(
        seed,
        8
      ) < 0.58
    ) {
      const fragments =
        text.split(
          /\s+/
        );

      if (
        fragments.length >= 4
      ) {
        const start =
          Math.floor(
            recallV14SeededUnit(
              seed,
              9
            ) *
            Math.max(
              1,
              fragments.length - 2
            )
          );

        const end =
          Math.min(
            fragments.length,
            start +
            1 +
            Math.floor(
              recallV14SeededUnit(
                seed,
                10
              ) * 3
            )
          );

        const fragment =
          fragments
            .slice(
              start,
              end
            )
            .join("");

        fragments.splice(
          start,
          Math.max(
            1,
            end - start
          ),
          recallV14DistortWordCase(
            fragment,
            seed + 120
          )
        );

        text =
          fragments.join(
            " "
          );
      }
    }
  }

  return text;
}


function applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
  text,
  {
    visitorId = "",
    turnNumber = 0,
    intensityBias = 0
  } = {}
) {
  const source =
    String(
      text || ""
    );

  if (!source.trim()) {
    return source;
  }

  const baseSeed =
    recallV14HashString(
      `${visitorId}|${turnNumber}|${source.length}|${source.slice(0, 80)}`
    );

  const sentences =
    source.match(
      /[^.!?。！？\n]+[.!?。！？]*|\n+/g
    ) || [
      source
    ];

  return sentences
    .map(
      (
        sentence,
        index
      ) => {
        if (
          /^\s*\n+\s*$/.test(
            sentence
          )
        ) {
          return sentence;
        }

        const roll =
          recallV14SeededUnit(
            baseSeed,
            index
          );

        /*
         * Most material stays readable.
         *
         * Some distortion is subtle.
         * Less is moderate.
         * Rarely a sentence is heavily damaged.
         */
        let intensity =
          0;

        if (roll < 0.24) {
          intensity =
            0;
        } else if (roll < 0.61) {
          intensity =
            1;
        } else if (roll < 0.88) {
          intensity =
            2;
        } else {
          intensity =
            3;
        }

        intensity =
          clamp(
            intensity +
            integerNumber(
              intensityBias,
              0
            ),
            0,
            3
          );

        return recallV14DistortSentence(
          sentence,
          baseSeed +
          index * 997,
          intensity
        );
      }
    )
    .join("");
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN DETECTION
//
// Existing host records have varied across builds, so detection
// intentionally checks stable public-facing identity fields.
// =========================================================

function isRecallV14ShodanHost(
  state
) {
  const host =
    state?.host || {};

  const candidates = [
    host.characterKey,
    host.character_key,
    host.key,
    host.id,
    host.name,
    host.displayName,
    host.display_name,
    host.persona,
    host.title
  ];

  return candidates.some(
    value =>
      String(
        value || ""
      )
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "shodan"
        )
  );
}


// =========================================================
// BET SETTLEMENT
// =========================================================

function getRecallV14CombatWinner(
  state
) {
  const hostAlive =
    state
      ?.host
      ?.combat
      ?.alive !==
        false;

  const namelessAlive =
    state
      ?.nameless
      ?.combat
      ?.alive !==
        false;

  /*
   * Nameless is normally invincible in the established game,
   * but keep this generic enough for future variants.
   */
  if (
    !hostAlive &&
    namelessAlive
  ) {
    return "nameless";
  }

  if (
    hostAlive &&
    !namelessAlive
  ) {
    return "host";
  }

  return null;
}


async function settleRecallV14BetIfReady(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state = null
) {
  const recallState =
    state ||
    await loadRecallState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const winner =
    getRecallV14CombatWinner(
      recallState
    );

  if (!winner) {
    return null;
  }

  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const episode =
    getRecallV14EpisodeNumber(
      recallState
    );

  if (
    integerNumber(
      row.bet_episode,
      -1
    ) !== episode ||
    String(
      row.bet_status ||
      "none"
    ) !== "locked"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const wager =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        row.bet_wager,
        0
      )
    );

  const correct =
    String(
      row.bet_choice ||
      ""
    ) === winner;

  const payout =
    correct
      ? wager * 2
      : 0;

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const now =
    isoNow();

  /*
   * Claim settlement first.
   *
   * Only one caller may move this row from locked -> settling.
   * This prevents two simultaneous combat/state requests from
   * paying the same wager twice.
   */
  const claim =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_v14_player

        SET
          bet_status = 'settling',
          updated_at = ?

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND bet_episode = ?
          AND bet_status = 'locked'
      `)
      .bind(
        now,
        visitorId,
        episode
      )
      .run();

  const changed =
    Number(
      claim
        ?.meta
        ?.changes ??
      claim
        ?.changes ??
      0
    );

  if (changed !== 1) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    if (payout > 0) {
      const worldState =
        await loadSharedWorldState(
          env,
          visitorId
        );

      worldState
        .player
        .money =
          Math.max(
            0,
            integerNumber(
              worldState
                ?.player
                ?.money,
              0
            )
          ) +
          payout;

      await saveSharedWorldState(
        env,
        visitorId,
        worldState
      );
    }

    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_v14_player

        SET
          bet_status = ?,
          bet_payout = ?,
          bet_settled_at = ?,
          updated_at = ?

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND bet_episode = ?
          AND bet_status = 'settling'
      `)
      .bind(
        correct
          ? "won"
          : "lost",
        payout,
        now,
        now,
        visitorId,
        episode
      )
      .run();

    return {
      winner,
      correct,
      wager,
      payout
    };
  } catch (error) {
    /*
     * Release the claim if payout failed before finalization.
     * A later request may safely retry.
     */
    await db
      .prepare(`
        UPDATE recall_v14_player

        SET
          bet_status = 'locked',
          updated_at = ?

        WHERE
          visitor_id = ?
          AND bet_episode = ?
          AND bet_status = 'settling'
      `)
      .bind(
        isoNow(),
        visitorId,
        episode
      )
      .run();

    throw error;
  }
}


// =========================================================
// GENERATION WRAPPER
//
// V13 owns the sophisticated memory/composer system.
// We preserve it and append V14 instructions to the generated
// context rather than replacing the V13 brain.
// =========================================================

const generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part29 =
  generateRecallTurn;


generateRecallTurn =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const row =
      await initializeRecallV14Player(
        env,
        visitorId
      );

    const machineInstruction =
      buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
        row.machine_level
      );

    const languageInstruction =
      buildRecallV14LanguageInstruction(
        row.language
      );

    const originalAdditionalInstruction =
      normalizeString(
        options
          ?.additionalInstruction ??
        options
          ?.additionalInstructions ??
        "",
        "",
        20000
      );

    const v14Instruction =
      [
        originalAdditionalInstruction,
        machineInstruction,
        languageInstruction
      ]
        .filter(
          Boolean
        )
        .join(
          "\n\n"
        );

    const generated =
      await generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part29(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state,
        {
          ...options,

          additionalInstruction:
            v14Instruction,

          additionalInstructions:
            v14Instruction
        }
      );

    /*
     * SHODAN's corruption is presentation/personality behavior.
     * Preserve underlying generated meaning, then corrupt the
     * visible/spoken string with variable intensity.
     */
    if (
      isRecallV14ShodanHost(
        state
      )
    ) {
      const speaker =
        String(
          generated
            ?.speakerKey ??
          generated
            ?.speaker ??
          options
            ?.speakerKey ??
          ""
        )
          .toLowerCase();

      const hostIsSpeaking =
        speaker ===
          String(
            CHARACTER_HOST
          )
            .toLowerCase() ||
        speaker === "host";

      if (hostIsSpeaking) {
        const candidateKeys = [
          "text",
          "content",
          "message",
          "dialogue"
        ];

        for (
          const key
          of candidateKeys
        ) {
          if (
            typeof generated?.[key] ===
              "string" &&
            generated[key].trim()
          ) {
            generated[key] =
              applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
                generated[key],
                {
                  visitorId,

                  turnNumber:
                    state
                      ?.conversation
                      ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber ??
                    0
                }
              );

            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return generated;
  };


// =========================================================
// STATE ROUTE — SETTLEMENT-AWARE
// =========================================================

const handleRecallV14StateBeforePart29 =
  handleRecallV14State;


handleRecallV14State =
  async function (
    request,
    env,
    url
  ) {
    const visitorId =
      normalizeVisitorId(
        url.searchParams.get(
          "visitorId"
        ) ||
        url.searchParams.get(
          "visitor_id"
        )
      );

    if (visitorId) {
      const state =
        await loadRecallState(
          env,
          visitorId
        );

      await settleRecallV14BetIfReady(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      );
    }

    return await handleRecallV14StateBeforePart29(
      request,
      env,
      url
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// ROUTER REBIND
//
// Part 28's router already calls handleRecallV14State by
// runtime binding, so replacing the function above is enough.
// Rebind CORS explicitly to keep final behavior unambiguous.
// =========================================================

routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// CLIENT SCRIPT
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const state = {
    loaded: false,
    busy: false,
    language: "en",
    machine: null,
    betting: null,
    playerGold: 0,
    lastStateFetchAt: 0
  };


  function getVisitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,
      localStorage.getItem("visitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("visitor_id"),
      localStorage.getItem("recallVisitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("recall_visitor_id")
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function numberText(value) {
    const number =
      Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
      return "0";
    }

    return Math.floor(number)
      .toLocaleString();
  }


  async function requestJson(
    pathname,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        pathname,
        {
          credentials: "same-origin",
          ...options,
          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",
            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload = {
        ok: false,
        error:
          "Invalid server response."
      };
    }

    if (
      !response.ok &&
      payload &&
      typeof payload === "object"
    ) {
      payload.httpStatus =
        response.status;
    }

    return payload;
  }


  function machineButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine"
    );
  }


  function languageButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-language"
    );
  }


  function betChoice() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-choice"
    );
  }


  function betWager() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-wager"
    );
  }


  function betButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-place-bet"
    );
  }


  function machineStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine-status"
    );
  }


  function betStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-status"
    );
  }


  function renderMachine() {
    const button =
      machineButton();

    const status =
      machineStatus();

    if (
      !button ||
      !status
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const machine =
      state.machine || {};

    const level =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          machine.level || 0
        )
      );

    if (machine.maxed) {
      button.textContent =
        "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

      button.disabled =
        true;

      status.textContent =
        "MACHINE LEVEL " +
        numberText(level);

      return;
    }

    const price =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          machine.nextPrice || 0
        )
      );

    button.textContent =
      "MACHINE LV " +
      numberText(level) +
      " → " +
      numberText(level + 1) +
      " — " +
      numberText(price) +
      " GOLD";

    /*
     * This is the behavior requested:
     *
     * if you cannot afford the next literal-exponent upgrade,
     * the button stops working until you have enough money.
     */
    button.disabled =
      state.busy ||
      state.playerGold < price;

    status.textContent =
      "GOLD " +
      numberText(
        state.playerGold
      ) +
      " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
      numberText(
        price
      );
  }


  function renderLanguage() {
    const button =
      languageButton();

    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    const chinese =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW";

    button.textContent =
      chinese
        ? "繁體中文：開"
        : "繁體中文：關";

    button.disabled =
      state.busy;

    document.documentElement.lang =
      chinese
        ? "zh-Hant"
        : "en";
  }


  function renderBetting() {
    const choice =
      betChoice();

    const wager =
      betWager();

    const button =
      betButton();

    const status =
      betStatus();

    if (
      !choice ||
      !wager ||
      !button ||
      !status
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const bet =
      state.betting || {};

    const betState =
      String(
        bet.status || "none"
      );

    const open =
      Boolean(
        bet.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";

    choice.disabled =
      state.busy ||
      !open;

    wager.disabled =
      state.busy ||
      !open;

    button.disabled =
      state.busy ||
      !open;

    if (betState === "locked") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET LOCKED — " +
        String(
          bet.choice || ""
        ).toUpperCase() +
        " — " +
        numberText(
          bet.wager
        ) +
        " GOLD";

      return;
    }

    if (betState === "won") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET WON — PAYOUT " +
        numberText(
          bet.payout
        ) +
        " GOLD";

      return;
    }

    if (betState === "lost") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET LOST — " +
        numberText(
          bet.wager
        ) +
        " GOLD";

      return;
    }

    if (!open) {
      status.textContent =
        "BETTING CLOSED";

      return;
    }

    status.textContent =
      "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
      numberText(
        state.playerGold
      );
  }


  function render() {
    renderMachine();
    renderLanguage();
    renderBetting();
  }


  async function refreshState() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return;
    }

    const payload =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          visitorId
        ),
        {
          method: "GET",
          headers: {}
        }
      );

    if (
      !payload ||
      !payload.ok ||
      !payload.v14
    ) {
      return;
    }

    state.loaded =
      true;

    state.language =
      payload.v14.language ||
      "en";

    state.machine =
      payload.v14.machine ||
      null;

    state.betting =
      payload.v14.betting ||
      null;

    state.playerGold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          payload.v14.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );

    state.lastStateFetchAt =
      Date.now();

    render();

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(
        "recall-v14-state",
        {
          detail:
            payload.v14
        }
      )
    );
  }


  async function upgradeMachine() {
    if (state.busy) {
      return;
    }

    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return;
    }

    state.busy =
      true;

    render();

    try {
      const payload =
        await requestJson(
          "/v14/machine/upgrade",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId
              })
          }
        );

      if (
        payload &&
        payload.ok
      ) {
        state.machine =
          payload.machine ||
          state.machine;

        state.playerGold =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              payload.remainingGold ||
              0
            )
          );
      } else {
        const status =
          machineStatus();

        if (status) {
          status.textContent =
            payload?.error ||
            "MACHINE upgrade failed.";
        }
      }
    } finally {
      state.busy =
        false;

      render();

      /*
       * Refresh from authority after mutation.
       */
      await refreshState();
    }
  }


  async function toggleLanguage() {
    if (state.busy) {
      return;
    }

    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return;
    }

    const language =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "en"
          : "zh-TW";

    state.busy =
      true;

    render();

    try {
      const payload =
        await requestJson(
          "/v14/language",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId,
                language
              })
          }
        );

      if (
        payload &&
        payload.ok
      ) {
        state.language =
          payload.language ||
          language;
      }
    } finally {
      state.busy =
        false;

      render();

      await refreshState();
    }
  }


  async function placeBet() {
    if (state.busy) {
      return;
    }

    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    const choice =
      betChoice()
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          betWager()
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      const status =
        betStatus();

      if (status) {
        status.textContent =
          "ENTER A GOLD WAGER.";
      }

      return;
    }

    state.busy =
      true;

    render();

    try {
      const payload =
        await requestJson(
          "/v14/bet",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId,
                choice,
                wager
              })
          }
        );

      if (
        payload &&
        payload.ok
      ) {
        state.betting =
          payload.bet ||
          state.betting;

        state.playerGold =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              payload.remainingGold ||
              0
            )
          );
      } else {
        const status =
          betStatus();

        if (status) {
          status.textContent =
            payload?.error ||
            "BET FAILED.";
        }
      }
    } finally {
      state.busy =
        false;

      render();

      await refreshState();
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // VOICE LANGUAGE BRIDGE
  //
  // Existing Amazon voice playback remains authoritative.
  // We expose the current requested language to any existing
  // voice request builder without replacing the voice actors.
  //
  // SHODAN text is sent exactly as produced. Do NOT sanitize
  // repeated letters, bracketed fragments, number intrusions,
  // missing spaces or strange casing before speech.
  // =======================================================

  window.getRecallRequestedSpeechLanguage =
    function () {
      return state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "cmn-TW"
          : "en-US";
    };


  window.getRecallRequestedTextLanguage =
    function () {
      return state.language;
    };


  window.prepareRecallTextForSpeechV14 =
    function (
      text
    ) {
      /*
       * Deliberately return verbatim.
       *
       * SHODAN's malformed cadence is part of the character.
       */
      return String(
        text ?? ""
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // EVENT WIRING
  // =======================================================

  function bind() {
    machineButton()
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        upgradeMachine
      );

    languageButton()
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        toggleLanguage
      );

    betButton()
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        placeBet
      );

    /*
     * Polling is intentionally modest.
     *
     * It updates GOLD affordability, the five-minute betting
     * window, and settlement without disturbing the dialogue
     * loop.
     */
    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden
        ) {
          refreshState()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );

    document.addEventListener(
      "visibilitychange",
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden
        ) {
          refreshState()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      }
    );

    refreshState()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// HTML INJECTION
//
// Part 8 owns the complete HTML document.
// Inject immediately before </body>, preserving that document.
// =========================================================

function installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-controls"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  const addition =
    (
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_SCRIPT
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      addition +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    addition
  );
}


// =========================================================
// REPLACE FINAL HTML CONSTANT USED BY ROOT ROUTE
//
// The original Part 8 HTML remains intact. This produces one
// augmented document rather than maintaining a second page.
// =========================================================

const HTML_V14 =
  installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml(
    HTML
  );


// =========================================================
// ROOT HTML RESPONSE WRAPPER
//
// Different earlier build sections may return HTML through
// different helper paths. Wrap the final router response so
// any response containing the original Recall page receives
// the V14 controls exactly once.
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part30 =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part30(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    /*
     * Only touch the Recall television document.
     */
    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    /*
     * Body length changed.
     */
    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CORS REBIND
// =========================================================

routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// PART 30 INSTALLATION ASSERTION
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART30_INSTALLATION_CHECK =
  Object.freeze({
    clientInstaller:
      typeof installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml ===
        "function",

    machine:
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_HTML.includes(
        "recall-v14-machine"
      ),

    betting:
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_HTML.includes(
        "recall-v14-place-bet"
      ),

    traditionalChinese:
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_HTML.includes(
        "recall-v14-language"
      ),

    voiceBridge:
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_SCRIPT.includes(
        "getRecallRequestedSpeechLanguage"
      ),

    shodanPreservation:
      RECALL_V14_CLIENT_SCRIPT.includes(
        "prepareRecallTextForSpeechV14"
      )
  });


for (
  const [
    subsystem,
    installed
  ]
  of Object.entries(
    RECALL_V14_PART30_INSTALLATION_CHECK
  )
) {
  if (!installed) {
    throw new Error(
      `RECALL THY NAME V14 Part 30 incomplete: ${subsystem}`
    );
  }
}

// RECALL THY NAME
// MAJOR BUILD — PART 31
//
// V14 INTEGRATION HARDENING
//
// AUTHORITATIVE GOLD MUTATION LOCK
// MACHINE PURCHASE RACE PROTECTION
// BET PURCHASE RACE PROTECTION
// MACHINE PROMPT INJECTION FALLBACK
// TRADITIONAL CHINESE PROMPT INJECTION FALLBACK
// AMAZON/POLLY LANGUAGE REQUEST BRIDGE
// SHODAN SPEECH-PATH DISTORTION BRIDGE
//
// Append directly after PART 30.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// GOLD MUTATION LOCK
//
// Machine purchases and wagers both spend the same persistent
// GOLD pool. Serialize those mutations per visitor so two fast
// clicks / requests cannot spend the same balance twice.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS =
  new Map();


async function withRecallV14GoldLock(
  visitorId,
  operation
) {
  const key =
    String(
      visitorId || ""
    );

  const previous =
    RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS.get(
      key
    ) ||
    Promise.resolve();

  let release;

  const current =
    new Promise(
      resolve => {
        release =
          resolve;
      }
    );

  RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS.set(
    key,
    previous
      .catch(
        () => {}
      )
      .then(
        () => current
      )
  );

  await previous
    .catch(
      () => {}
    );

  try {
    return await operation();
  } finally {
    release();

    /*
     * Let the chained promise settle, then remove it only if
     * nobody queued another operation behind this one.
     */
    const stored =
      RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS.get(
        key
      );

    if (stored) {
      stored
        .finally(
          () => {
            if (
              RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS.get(
                key
              ) === stored
            ) {
              RECALL_V14_GOLD_LOCKS.delete(
                key
              );
            }
          }
        );
    }
  }
}


// =========================================================
// MACHINE PURCHASE — SERIALIZED FINAL VERSION
// =========================================================

handleRecallV14MachineUpgrade =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const parsed =
      await readRecallV13JsonBody(
        request.clone()
      );

    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          ok:
            false,

          error:
            "Invalid MACHINE request."
        },
        400
      );
    }

    const visitorId =
      normalizeVisitorId(
        parsed.value
          ?.visitorId ??
        parsed.value
          ?.visitor_id
      );

    if (!visitorId) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          ok:
            false,

          error:
            "Missing or invalid visitorId."
        },
        400
      );
    }

    return await withRecallV14GoldLock(
      visitorId,
      async () => {
        const [
          row,
          worldState
        ] =
          await Promise.all([
            initializeRecallV14Player(
              env,
              visitorId
            ),

            loadSharedWorldState(
              env,
              visitorId
            )
          ]);

        const currentLevel =
          normalizeRecallV14MachineLevel(
            row.machine_level
          );

        const price =
          getRecallV14MachinePrice(
            currentLevel
          );

        if (price === null) {
          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "MACHINE_MAXED",

              error:
                "The MACHINE cannot be upgraded any further.",

              machine:
                buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
                  row
                )
            },
            409
          );
        }

        const gold =
          Math.max(
            0,
            integerNumber(
              worldState
                ?.player
                ?.money,
              0
            )
          );

        if (gold < price) {
          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "INSUFFICIENT_GOLD",

              error:
                "Not enough GOLD.",

              requiredGold:
                price,

              currentGold:
                gold,

              machine:
                buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
                  row
                )
            },
            402
          );
        }

        const db =
          requireWorldDatabase(
            env
          );

        const nextLevel =
          currentLevel + 1;

        const now =
          isoNow();

        /*
         * Claim the exact expected level first.
         */
        const claim =
          await db
            .prepare(`
              UPDATE recall_v14_player

              SET
                machine_level = ?,
                updated_at = ?

              WHERE
                visitor_id = ?
                AND machine_level = ?
            `)
            .bind(
              nextLevel,
              now,
              visitorId,
              currentLevel
            )
            .run();

        const changed =
          Number(
            claim
              ?.meta
              ?.changes ??
            claim
              ?.changes ??
            0
          );

        if (changed !== 1) {
          const freshRow =
            await loadRecallV14Player(
              env,
              visitorId
            );

          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "MACHINE_STATE_CHANGED",

              error:
                "MACHINE state changed. Try again.",

              machine:
                buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
                  freshRow
                )
            },
            409
          );
        }

        try {
          worldState
            .player
            .money =
              gold - price;

          await saveSharedWorldState(
            env,
            visitorId,
            worldState
          );
        } catch (error) {
          /*
           * Roll back the level if GOLD persistence fails.
           */
          await db
            .prepare(`
              UPDATE recall_v14_player

              SET
                machine_level = ?,
                updated_at = ?

              WHERE
                visitor_id = ?
                AND machine_level = ?
            `)
            .bind(
              currentLevel,
              isoNow(),
              visitorId,
              nextLevel
            )
            .run();

          throw error;
        }

        const savedRow =
          await loadRecallV14Player(
            env,
            visitorId
          );

        return jsonResponse({
          ok:
            true,

          spent:
            price,

          remainingGold:
            worldState
              .player
              .money,

          machine:
            buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
              savedRow
            )
        });
      }
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// BET PURCHASE — SERIALIZED FINAL VERSION
// =========================================================

handleRecallV14PlaceBet =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const parsed =
      await readRecallV13JsonBody(
        request.clone()
      );

    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          ok:
            false,

          error:
            "Invalid bet."
        },
        400
      );
    }

    const visitorId =
      normalizeVisitorId(
        parsed.value
          ?.visitorId ??
        parsed.value
          ?.visitor_id
      );

    const choice =
      normalizeRecallV14BetChoice(
        parsed.value
          ?.choice
      );

    const wager =
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          parsed.value
            ?.wager,
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      return jsonResponse(
        {
          ok:
            false,

          error:
            "Bet requires visitorId, HOST or NAMELESS, and a positive GOLD wager."
        },
        400
      );
    }

    return await withRecallV14GoldLock(
      visitorId,
      async () => {
        const [
          state,
          row,
          worldState
        ] =
          await Promise.all([
            loadRecallState(
              env,
              visitorId
            ),

            initializeRecallV14Player(
              env,
              visitorId
            ),

            loadSharedWorldState(
              env,
              visitorId
            )
          ]);

        synchronizeRecallTime(
          state
        );

        const episode =
          getRecallV14EpisodeNumber(
            state
          );

        if (
          !isRecallV14BetWindowOpen(
            state
          )
        ) {
          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "BETTING_CLOSED",

              error:
                "Betting closes after the first five minutes."
            },
            409
          );
        }

        if (
          integerNumber(
            row.bet_episode,
            -1
          ) === episode &&
          String(
            row.bet_status ||
            "none"
          ) !== "none"
        ) {
          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "BET_ALREADY_LOCKED",

              error:
                "Your wager for this episode is already locked.",

              bet:
                buildRecallV14BetPublic(
                  row,
                  state
                )
            },
            409
          );
        }

        const gold =
          Math.max(
            0,
            integerNumber(
              worldState
                ?.player
                ?.money,
              0
            )
          );

        if (gold < wager) {
          return jsonResponse(
            {
              ok:
                false,

              code:
                "INSUFFICIENT_GOLD",

              error:
                "Not enough GOLD.",

              currentGold:
                gold
            },
            402
          );
        }

        const db =
          requireWorldDatabase(
            env
          );

        const now =
          isoNow();

        /*
         * Lock the wager in V14 before removing GOLD.
         */
        await db
          .prepare(`
            UPDATE recall_v14_player

            SET
              bet_episode = ?,
              bet_choice = ?,
              bet_wager = ?,
              bet_status = 'locked',
              bet_payout = 0,
              bet_placed_at = ?,
              bet_settled_at = NULL,
              updated_at = ?

            WHERE visitor_id = ?
          `)
          .bind(
            episode,
            choice,
            wager,
            now,
            now,
            visitorId
          )
          .run();

        try {
          worldState
            .player
            .money =
              gold - wager;

          await saveSharedWorldState(
            env,
            visitorId,
            worldState
          );
        } catch (error) {
          /*
           * Restore bet row if GOLD persistence fails.
           */
          await db
            .prepare(`
              UPDATE recall_v14_player

              SET
                bet_episode = NULL,
                bet_choice = NULL,
                bet_wager = 0,
                bet_status = 'none',
                bet_payout = 0,
                bet_placed_at = NULL,
                bet_settled_at = NULL,
                updated_at = ?

              WHERE
                visitor_id = ?
                AND bet_episode = ?
                AND bet_status = 'locked'
            `)
            .bind(
              isoNow(),
              visitorId,
              episode
            )
            .run();

          throw error;
        }

        const savedRow =
          await loadRecallV14Player(
            env,
            visitorId
          );

        return jsonResponse({
          ok:
            true,

          remainingGold:
            worldState
              .player
              .money,

          bet:
            buildRecallV14BetPublic(
              savedRow,
              state
            )
        });
      }
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// V14 PROMPT PACKET
//
// This is exported as a stable helper so every later model
// call can request the exact same modifiers.
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14GenerationPacket(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return {
    machineLevel:
      normalizeRecallV14MachineLevel(
        row.machine_level
      ),

    language:
      normalizeRecallV14Language(
        row.language
      ),

    instruction:
      [
        buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
          row.machine_level
        ),

        buildRecallV14LanguageInstruction(
          row.language
        )
      ]
        .filter(
          Boolean
        )
        .join(
          "\n\n"
        )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// PROMPT STRING AUGMENTER
//
// Part 29 passes additionalInstruction into V13. Some older
// V12/V13 generation branches may build a prompt without
// reading that option. This helper gives those paths a safe
// final append operation.
// =========================================================

function appendRecallV14InstructionToPrompt(
  prompt,
  instruction
) {
  const base =
    String(
      prompt || ""
    );

  const extra =
    String(
      instruction || ""
    )
      .trim();

  if (!extra) {
    return base;
  }

  if (
    base.includes(
      "[MACHINE — PERMANENT NAMELESS MODIFIER]"
    ) ||
    base.includes(
      "[LANGUAGE MODE — TRADITIONAL CHINESE]"
    )
  ) {
    return base;
  }

  return (
    base +
    "\n\n" +
    extra
  );
}


// =========================================================
// AMAZON / POLLY LANGUAGE BRIDGE
//
// Do not replace the actors.
// Do not normalize their cadence.
// Only supply the language requested by V14.
//
// Existing voice systems can call this helper while retaining
// their existing VoiceId selection.
// =========================================================

function applyRecallV14LanguageToPollyRequest(
  requestBody,
  language
) {
  const source =
    requestBody &&
    typeof requestBody ===
      "object"
      ? {
          ...requestBody
        }
      : {};

  const normalized =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      language
    );

  if (
    normalized ===
      RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
  ) {
    /*
     * Mandarin / Traditional Chinese speech request.
     *
     * Keep VoiceId untouched. If the existing selected actor
     * cannot speak cmn-TW, the existing voice-selection layer
     * remains responsible for choosing its configured Mandarin
     * counterpart.
     */
    source.LanguageCode =
      "cmn-TW";

    source.languageCode =
      "cmn-TW";

    source.textLanguage =
      "zh-TW";
  } else {
    /*
     * Do not force an English LanguageCode over an existing
     * actor configuration. Merely expose the text language.
     */
    source.textLanguage =
      "en";
  }

  return source;
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN SPEECH BRIDGE
//
// The same corrupted visible string must reach TTS. This keeps
// stretched syllables, broken spacing, casing, numbers and
// bracketed intrusions as audible character behavior.
// =========================================================

function prepareRecallV14SpeechText(
  text,
  {
    state = null,
    speakerKey = null,
    visitorId = "",
    turnNumber = 0,
    alreadyDistorted = false
  } = {}
) {
  const source =
    String(
      text ?? ""
    );

  if (
    !isRecallV14ShodanHost(
      state
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const host =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker ===
      "host";

  if (!host) {
    return source;
  }

  if (alreadyDistorted) {
    return source;
  }

  return applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
    source,
    {
      visitorId,
      turnNumber
    }
  );
}


// =========================================================
// PUBLIC SPEECH CONFIGURATION
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14SpeechConfiguration(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state = null
) {
  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const language =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      row.language
    );

  return {
    language,

    speechLanguage:
      language ===
        RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
          ? "cmn-TW"
          : "en-US",

    preserveGeneratedText:
      true,

    preserveShodanDistortion:
      true,

    shodanHost:
      isRecallV14ShodanHost(
        state
      )
  };
}


// =========================================================
// SPEECH CONFIG ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14SpeechConfig(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const state =
    await loadRecallState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    speech:
      await buildRecallV14SpeechConfiguration(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      )
  });
}

  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );

    if (
      request.method === "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/speech-config"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14SpeechConfig(
        request,
        env,
        url
      );
    }

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part31(
      request,
      env
    );
  };

  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CLIENT VOICE BRIDGE PATCH
//
// Part 30 exposed language helpers. Add a single public helper
// capable of decorating an existing Amazon request without
// changing the actor/VoiceId.
//
// This script is injected into the same Recall page.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART31_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part31-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  window.decorateRecallAmazonVoiceRequest =
    function (
      requestBody
    ) {
      const source =
        requestBody &&
        typeof requestBody === "object"
          ? {
              ...requestBody
            }
          : {};

      const language =
        typeof window.getRecallRequestedTextLanguage ===
          "function"
            ? window.getRecallRequestedTextLanguage()
            : "en";

      if (language === "zh-TW") {
        source.LanguageCode =
          "cmn-TW";

        source.languageCode =
          "cmn-TW";

        source.textLanguage =
          "zh-TW";
      } else {
        source.textLanguage =
          "en";
      }

      return source;
    };


  window.preserveRecallShodanSpeech =
    function (
      text
    ) {
      /*
       * No cleanup.
       *
       * Distortion is gameplay and performance.
       */
      return String(
        text ?? ""
      );
    };
})();
</script>
`;


function installRecallV14Part31ClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-part31-client-script"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      RECALL_V14_PART31_CLIENT_SCRIPT +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    RECALL_V14_PART31_CLIENT_SCRIPT
  );
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL HTML RESPONSE WRAPPER — PART 31
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part31Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part31Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part31ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// FINAL CORS REBIND — PART 31
// =========================================================

routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// PART 31 INSTALLATION ASSERTION
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART31_INSTALLATION_CHECK =
  Object.freeze({
    goldLock:
      typeof withRecallV14GoldLock ===
        "function",

    machinePurchase:
      typeof handleRecallV14MachineUpgrade ===
        "function",

    betPurchase:
      typeof handleRecallV14PlaceBet ===
        "function",

    generationPacket:
      typeof buildRecallV14GenerationPacket ===
        "function",

    promptFallback:
      typeof appendRecallV14InstructionToPrompt ===
        "function",

    pollyBridge:
      typeof applyRecallV14LanguageToPollyRequest ===
        "function",

    shodanSpeech:
      typeof prepareRecallV14SpeechText ===
        "function",

    speechConfig:
      typeof buildRecallV14SpeechConfiguration ===
        "function"
  });


for (
  const [
    subsystem,
    installed
  ]
  of Object.entries(
    RECALL_V14_PART31_INSTALLATION_CHECK
  )
) {
  if (!installed) {
    throw new Error(
      `RECALL THY NAME V14 Part 31 incomplete: ${subsystem}`
    );
  }
}


// =========================================================
// END MAJOR BUILD — PART 31
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME
// MAJOR BUILD — PART 32
//
// V14 FINAL RUNTIME INTEGRATION
//
// GENERATION CONTEXT HOOKS
// MACHINE -> NAMELESS ONLY
// LANGUAGE -> BOTH SPEAKERS
// SHODAN -> HOST ONLY
// TTS REQUEST DECORATION
// BET SETTLEMENT ON LIVE TURN FLOW
// CLIENT GOLD / STATE SYNCHRONIZATION
//
// Append directly after PART 31.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// GENERATION MODIFIER SELECTION
// =========================================================

function buildRecallV14SpeakerInstruction(
  packet,
  speakerKey
) {
  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const nameless =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_NAMELESS
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "nameless";

  const pieces =
    [];

  /*
   * MACHINE belongs to NAMELESS.
   */
  if (
    nameless &&
    packet?.machineLevel > 0
  ) {
    pieces.push(
      buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
        packet.machineLevel
      )
    );
  }

  /*
   * Language mode belongs to the entire broadcast.
   */
  const languageInstruction =
    buildRecallV14LanguageInstruction(
      packet?.language
    );

  if (languageInstruction) {
    pieces.push(
      languageInstruction
    );
  }

  return pieces
    .filter(
      Boolean
    )
    .join(
      "\n\n"
    );
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL GENERATION WRAPPER
//
// Part 29 introduced V14 generation augmentation. Part 32
// makes speaker targeting explicit so MACHINE aggression never
// leaks into the hired host.
// =========================================================

const generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part32 =
  generateRecallTurn;


generateRecallTurn =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const packet =
      await buildRecallV14GenerationPacket(
        env,
        visitorId
      );

    const speakerKey =
      options
        ?.speakerKey ??
      state
        ?.conversation
        ?.activeSpeaker ??
      CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

    const speakerInstruction =
      buildRecallV14SpeakerInstruction(
        packet,
        speakerKey
      );

    const existingInstruction =
      normalizeString(
        options
          ?.additionalInstruction ??
        options
          ?.additionalInstructions ??
        "",
        "",
        30000
      );

    const instruction =
      [
        existingInstruction,
        speakerInstruction
      ]
        .filter(
          Boolean
        )
        .join(
          "\n\n"
        );

    const generated =
      await generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part32(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state,
        {
          ...options,

          /*
           * Keep both spellings because earlier generations
           * across the master build use both conventions.
           */
          additionalInstruction:
            instruction,

          additionalInstructions:
            instruction
        }
      );

    return generated;
  };


// =========================================================
// SHODAN FINAL OUTPUT NORMALIZER
//
// Part 29 already corrupts SHODAN's generated host dialogue.
// This helper identifies the final textual field without
// touching Nameless or other hosts.
// =========================================================

function finalizeRecallV14GeneratedDialogue(
  generated,
  {
    state,
    speakerKey,
    visitorId,
    turnNumber
  }
) {
  if (
    !generated ||
    typeof generated !==
      "object"
  ) {
    return generated;
  }

  if (
    !isRecallV14ShodanHost(
      state
    )
  ) {
    return generated;
  }

  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const host =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "host";

  if (!host) {
    return generated;
  }

  /*
   * Part 29 normally already distorted the generated value.
   * Marking the object prevents any later bridge from applying
   * a second full corruption pass.
   */
  generated.v14ShodanDistorted =
    true;

  generated.v14PreserveSpeechText =
    true;

  generated.v14SpeechLanguage =
    generated.v14SpeechLanguage ||
    null;

  return generated;
}


// =========================================================
// LIVE TURN WRAPPER
//
// Finalize output metadata and settle a wager immediately when
// a live generated turn reveals a combat winner.
// =========================================================

const generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part32Final =
  generateRecallTurn;


generateRecallTurn =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const speakerKey =
      options
        ?.speakerKey ??
      state
        ?.conversation
        ?.activeSpeaker ??
      CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

    const generated =
      await generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part32Final(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state,
        options
      );

    const row =
      await initializeRecallV14Player(
        env,
        visitorId
      );

    generated.v14SpeechLanguage =
      normalizeRecallV14Language(
        row.language
      ) ===
        RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
          ? "cmn-TW"
          : "en-US";

    finalizeRecallV14GeneratedDialogue(
      generated,
      {
        state,
        speakerKey,
        visitorId,

        turnNumber:
          state
            ?.conversation
            ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber ??
          0
      }
    );

    const settlement =
      await settleRecallV14BetIfReady(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      );

    if (settlement) {
      generated.v14BetSettlement =
        settlement;
    }

    return generated;
  };


// =========================================================
// TTS REQUEST DECORATOR
//
// Works with the existing Amazon request object rather than
// replacing the established actor voice IDs.
// =========================================================

async function decorateRecallV14TtsRequest(
  env,
  visitorId,
  requestBody,
  {
    state = null,
    speakerKey = null,
    text = null,
    alreadyDistorted = false
  } = {}
) {
  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const language =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      row.language
    );

  const decorated =
    applyRecallV14LanguageToPollyRequest(
      requestBody,
      language
    );

  const originalText =
    text ??
    decorated.Text ??
    decorated.text ??
    "";

  const finalText =
    prepareRecallV14SpeechText(
      originalText,
      {
        state,
        speakerKey,
        visitorId,

        turnNumber:
          state
            ?.conversation
            ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber ??
          0,

        alreadyDistorted
      }
    );

  /*
   * Preserve whichever text key the pre-existing request uses.
   */
  if (
    Object.prototype
      .hasOwnProperty
      .call(
        decorated,
        "Text"
      )
  ) {
    decorated.Text =
      finalText;
  }

  if (
    Object.prototype
      .hasOwnProperty
      .call(
        decorated,
        "text"
      )
  ) {
    decorated.text =
      finalText;
  }

  if (
    !Object.prototype
      .hasOwnProperty
      .call(
        decorated,
        "Text"
      ) &&
    !Object.prototype
      .hasOwnProperty
      .call(
        decorated,
        "text"
      )
  ) {
    decorated.Text =
      finalText;
  }

  return decorated;
}


// =========================================================
// BET SETTLEMENT — TURN/STATE SAFE WRAPPER
//
// Settlement remains idempotent because Part 29 claims the
// row from locked -> settling before payout.
// =========================================================

async function synchronizeRecallV14AfterTurn(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state
) {
  const settlement =
    await settleRecallV14BetIfReady(
      env,
      visitorId,
      state
    );

  const publicState =
    await buildRecallV14PublicState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return {
    settlement,
    publicState
  };
}


// =========================================================
// V14 STATE AUGMENTER
//
// Attach current V14 state to JSON responses when a visitorId
// is available. Existing V12/V13 response fields are preserved.
// =========================================================

async function augmentRecallResponseWithV14(
  response,
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  if (
    !response ||
    !(response instanceof Response) ||
    !visitorId
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  const contentType =
    response.headers
      .get(
        "content-type"
      ) ||
    "";

  if (
    !contentType
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(
        "application/json"
      )
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  let payload;

  try {
    payload =
      await response
        .clone()
        .json();
  } catch {
    return response;
  }

  if (
    !payload ||
    typeof payload !==
      "object" ||
    Array.isArray(
      payload
    )
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  let v14;

  try {
    v14 =
      await buildRecallV14PublicState(
        env,
        visitorId
      );
  } catch {
    return response;
  }

  const headers =
    new Headers(
      response.headers
    );

  headers.delete(
    "content-length"
  );

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify({
      ...payload,
      v14
    }),
    {
      status:
        response.status,

      statusText:
        response.statusText,

      headers
    }
  );
}


// =========================================================
// VISITOR ID EXTRACTION FOR ROUTER RESPONSES
// =========================================================

async function extractRecallV14VisitorIdFromRequest(
  request,
  url
) {
  const queryVisitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (queryVisitorId) {
    return queryVisitorId;
  }

  if (
    request.method === "GET" ||
    request.method === "HEAD"
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const body =
      await request
        .clone()
        .json();

    return normalizeVisitorId(
      body
        ?.visitorId ??
      body
        ?.visitor_id
    );
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL ROUTER RESPONSE AUGMENTATION
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part32 =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );

    const visitorId =
      await extractRecallV14VisitorIdFromRequest(
        request,
        url
      );

    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part32(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!visitorId) {
      return response;
    }

    /*
     * A combat-result request may arrive through any older
     * route. Attempt settlement before building the appended
     * public state. No winner = no operation.
     */
    try {
      const state =
        await loadRecallState(
          env,
          visitorId
        );

      await settleRecallV14BetIfReady(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state
      );
    } catch {
      /*
       * Never destroy an otherwise valid old endpoint response
       * because optional V14 augmentation failed.
       */
    }

    return await augmentRecallResponseWithV14(
      response,
      env,
      visitorId
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CORS REBIND
// =========================================================

routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CLIENT STATE SYNCHRONIZATION PATCH
//
// Existing dialogue responses can now carry v14. Consume them
// immediately instead of waiting for the 10-second poll.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART32_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part32-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  function publishV14State(
    value
  ) {
    if (
      !value ||
      typeof value !== "object"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(
        "recall-v14-server-state",
        {
          detail:
            value
        }
      )
    );
  }


  /*
   * Generic hook for existing Recall fetch consumers:
   *
   * call window.consumeRecallV14Response(payload) after parsing
   * any JSON response. It is safe when payload has no v14.
   */
  window.consumeRecallV14Response =
    function (
      payload
    ) {
      if (
        payload &&
        payload.v14
      ) {
        publishV14State(
          payload.v14
        );
      }

      return payload;
    };


  /*
   * Voice request decorator preserving actor identity.
   */
  window.decorateRecallTtsRequestV14 =
    function (
      requestBody,
      text
    ) {
      const source =
        typeof window.decorateRecallAmazonVoiceRequest ===
          "function"
            ? window.decorateRecallAmazonVoiceRequest(
                requestBody
              )
            : {
                ...(requestBody || {})
              };

      const finalText =
        typeof window.preserveRecallShodanSpeech ===
          "function"
            ? window.preserveRecallShodanSpeech(
                text ??
                source.Text ??
                source.text ??
                ""
              )
            : String(
                text ??
                source.Text ??
                source.text ??
                ""
              );

      if (
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          source,
          "Text"
        )
      ) {
        source.Text =
          finalText;
      } else {
        source.text =
          finalText;
      }

      return source;
    };
})();
</script>
`;


function installRecallV14Part32ClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-part32-client-script"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      RECALL_V14_PART32_CLIENT_SCRIPT +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    RECALL_V14_PART32_CLIENT_SCRIPT
  );
}


// =========================================================
// HTML WRAPPER — PART 32
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part32Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part32Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part32ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };

      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };

      typeof buildRecallV14SpeakerInstruction ===
        "function",

    generation:
      typeof generateRecallTurn ===
        "function",

    shodanFinalizer:
      typeof finalizeRecallV14GeneratedDialogue ===
        "function",

      typeof decorateRecallV14TtsRequest ===
