      typeof installRecallV14Part32ClientIntoHtml ===
        "function"
  });


for (
  const [
    subsystem,
    installed
  ]
  of Object.entries(
    RECALL_V14_PART32_INSTALLATION_CHECK
  )
) {
  if (!installed) {
    throw new Error(
      `RECALL THY NAME V14 Part 32 incomplete: ${subsystem}`
    );
  }
}

// RECALL THY NAME
// MAJOR BUILD — PART 33
//
// V14 CLIENT STATE BUS
// LIVE GOLD REFRESH
// MACHINE BUTTON RE-ARM
// BET RESULT NOTICES
// MANDARIN VOICE SELECTION SUPPORT
// SHODAN TEXT/TTS CONSISTENCY
// FINAL V14 DIAGNOSTICS
//
// Append directly after PART 32.

// =========================================================
// MANDARIN VOICE SUPPORT
//
// The existing Amazon actors remain untouched in English.
// Mandarin mode may use configured Mandarin counterparts when
// available. Nothing here silently replaces the English cast.
// =========================================================

function getRecallV14MandarinVoiceId(
  env,
  speakerKey
) {
  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const nameless =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_NAMELESS
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "nameless";

  const host =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "host";

  if (nameless) {
    return normalizeString(
      env
        ?.RECALL_MANDARIN_NAMELESS_VOICE_ID,
      "",
      200
    ) || null;
  }

  if (host) {
    return normalizeString(
      env
        ?.RECALL_MANDARIN_HOST_VOICE_ID,
      "",
      200
    ) || null;
  }

  return null;
}


async function applyRecallV14VoiceSelection(
  env,
  visitorId,
  requestBody,
  speakerKey
) {
  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const language =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      row.language
    );

  const source =
    applyRecallV14LanguageToPollyRequest(
      requestBody,
      language
    );

  if (
    language !==
      RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  const configuredVoice =
    getRecallV14MandarinVoiceId(
      env,
      speakerKey
    );

  if (configuredVoice) {
    /*
     * Only Mandarin mode substitutes a configured counterpart.
     * English Amazon voices stay exactly as they already are.
     */
    if (
      Object.prototype
        .hasOwnProperty
        .call(
          source,
          "VoiceId"
        )
    ) {
      source.VoiceId =
        configuredVoice;
    } else if (
      Object.prototype
        .hasOwnProperty
        .call(
          source,
          "voiceId"
        )
    ) {
      source.voiceId =
        configuredVoice;
    } else {
      source.VoiceId =
        configuredVoice;
    }
  }

  return source;
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL TTS DECORATOR REBIND
// =========================================================

const decorateRecallV14TtsRequestBeforePart33 =
  decorateRecallV14TtsRequest;


decorateRecallV14TtsRequest =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    requestBody,
    {
      state = null,
      speakerKey = null,
      text = null,
      alreadyDistorted = false
    } = {}
  ) {
    let decorated =
      await decorateRecallV14TtsRequestBeforePart33(
        env,
        visitorId,
        requestBody,
        {
          state,
          speakerKey,
          text,
          alreadyDistorted
        }
      );

    decorated =
      await applyRecallV14VoiceSelection(
        env,
        visitorId,
        decorated,
        speakerKey
      );

    return decorated;
  };


// =========================================================
// CLIENT STATE BUS
//
// Part 30 owns the controls. Part 32 exposes v14 on ordinary
// JSON responses. This patch connects those pieces so GOLD,
// affordability and betting update immediately.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART33_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part33-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const local = {
    v14: null,
    lastSettlementKey: null
  };


  function machineButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine"
    );
  }


  function machineStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine-status"
    );
  }


  function languageButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-language"
    );
  }


  function betChoice() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-choice"
    );
  }


  function betWager() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-wager"
    );
  }


  function betButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-place-bet"
    );
  }


  function betStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-status"
    );
  }


  function formatGold(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(value);

    return Number.isFinite(number)
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(number)
        ).toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function applyMachine(
    v14
  ) {
    const button =
      machineButton();

    const status =
      machineStatus();

    if (
      !button ||
      !status
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const machine =
      v14?.machine || {};

    const level =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          machine.level || 0
        )
      );

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          v14?.playerGold || 0
        )
      );

    if (machine.maxed) {
      button.textContent =
        "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

      button.disabled =
        true;

      status.textContent =
        "MACHINE LEVEL " +
        formatGold(level);

      return;
    }

    const price =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          machine.nextPrice || 0
        )
      );

    button.textContent =
      "MACHINE LV " +
      formatGold(level) +
      " → " +
      formatGold(level + 1) +
      " — " +
      formatGold(price) +
      " GOLD";

    /*
     * Re-arm automatically when enough persistent GOLD exists.
     */
    button.disabled =
      gold < price;

    status.textContent =
      "GOLD " +
      formatGold(gold) +
      " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
      formatGold(price);
  }


  function applyLanguage(
    v14
  ) {
    const button =
      languageButton();

    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    const chinese =
      v14?.language ===
        "zh-TW";

    button.textContent =
      chinese
        ? "繁體中文：開"
        : "繁體中文：關";

    document.documentElement.lang =
      chinese
        ? "zh-Hant"
        : "en";
  }


  function applyBet(
    v14
  ) {
    const bet =
      v14?.betting || {};

    const choice =
      betChoice();

    const wager =
      betWager();

    const button =
      betButton();

    const status =
      betStatus();

    if (
      !choice ||
      !wager ||
      !button ||
      !status
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const betState =
      String(
        bet.status || "none"
      );

    const open =
      Boolean(
        bet.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";

    choice.disabled =
      !open;

    wager.disabled =
      !open;

    button.disabled =
      !open;

    if (betState === "locked") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET LOCKED — " +
        String(
          bet.choice || ""
        ).toUpperCase() +
        " — " +
        formatGold(
          bet.wager
        ) +
        " GOLD";

      return;
    }

    if (betState === "won") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET WON — " +
        formatGold(
          bet.payout
        ) +
        " GOLD PAID";

      return;
    }

    if (betState === "lost") {
      status.textContent =
        "BET LOST — " +
        formatGold(
          bet.wager
        ) +
        " GOLD";

      return;
    }

    status.textContent =
      open
        ? (
            "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
            formatGold(
              v14?.playerGold
            )
          )
        : "BETTING CLOSED";
  }


  function applyV14(
    v14
  ) {
    if (
      !v14 ||
      typeof v14 !== "object"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    local.v14 =
      v14;

    applyMachine(
      v14
    );

    applyLanguage(
      v14
    );

    applyBet(
      v14
    );

    /*
     * Expose the authoritative state for any other UI module.
     */
    window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
      v14;
  }


  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-v14-state",
    event => {
      applyV14(
        event.detail
      );
    }
  );


  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-v14-server-state",
    event => {
      applyV14(
        event.detail
      );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // GOLD CHANGE BRIDGE
  //
  // Other Loki's Kingdom systems can dispatch:
  //
  // window.dispatchEvent(
  //   new CustomEvent("recall-gold-changed")
  // );
  //
  // and the MACHINE button will immediately reconsider
  // affordability instead of waiting for the normal poll.
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-gold-changed",
    () => {
      const visitorId =
        (
          window.visitorId ||
          window.VISITOR_ID ||
          window.recallVisitorId ||
          window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "visitorId"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "visitor_id"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "recallVisitorId"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "recall_visitor_id"
          ) ||
          ""
        )
          .toString()
          .trim();

      if (!visitorId) {
        return;
      }

      fetch(
        "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          visitorId
        ),
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin"
        }
      )
        .then(
          response =>
            response.json()
        )
        .then(
          payload => {
            if (
              payload?.ok &&
              payload?.v14
            ) {
              applyV14(
                payload.v14
              );
            }
          }
        )
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // BET SETTLEMENT NOTICE
  // =======================================================

  window.showRecallV14BetSettlement =
    function (
      settlement
    ) {
      if (!settlement) {
        return;
      }

      const key =
        [
          settlement.winner,
          settlement.wager,
          settlement.payout,
          settlement.correct
        ].join(
          "|"
        );

      if (
        local.lastSettlementKey ===
          key
      ) {
        return;
      }

      local.lastSettlementKey =
        key;

      const status =
        betStatus();

      if (!status) {
        return;
      }

      if (settlement.correct) {
        status.textContent =
          "YOU WON — " +
          formatGold(
            settlement.payout
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else {
        status.textContent =
          "YOU LOST — " +
          String(
            settlement.winner || ""
          ).toUpperCase() +
          " WON";
      }
    };


  // =======================================================
  // JSON PAYLOAD CONSUMER
  // =======================================================

  const previousConsumer =
    window.consumeRecallV14Response;

  window.consumeRecallV14Response =
    function (
      payload
    ) {
      if (
        typeof previousConsumer ===
          "function"
      ) {
        previousConsumer(
          payload
        );
      }

      if (payload?.v14) {
        applyV14(
          payload.v14
        );
      }

      const settlement =
        payload
          ?.v14BetSettlement ||
        payload
          ?.turn
          ?.v14BetSettlement ||
        payload
          ?.result
          ?.v14BetSettlement;

      if (settlement) {
        window.showRecallV14BetSettlement(
          settlement
        );
      }

      return payload;
    };


  // =======================================================
  // SPEECH HELPERS
  // =======================================================

  window.getRecallMandarinVoiceEnvironmentKeys =
    function () {
      return {
        nameless:
          "RECALL_MANDARIN_NAMELESS_VOICE_ID",

        host:
          "RECALL_MANDARIN_HOST_VOICE_ID"
      };
    };


  window.isRecallTraditionalChineseEnabled =
    function () {
      return (
        local.v14?.language ===
          "zh-TW" ||
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
          ?.language ===
          "zh-TW"
      );
    };


  /*
   * Never repair SHODAN.
   *
   * Do not strip:
   * - repeated letters
   * - numeric intrusions
   * - odd brackets
   * - broken spaces
   * - strange casing
   */
  window.normalizeRecallSpeechText =
    function (
      text
    ) {
      return String(
        text ?? ""
      );
    };
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// PART 33 CLIENT INSTALLER
// =========================================================

function installRecallV14Part33ClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-part33-client-script"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      RECALL_V14_PART33_CLIENT_SCRIPT +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    RECALL_V14_PART33_CLIENT_SCRIPT
  );
}


// =========================================================
// V14 DIAGNOSTICS
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14Diagnostics(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const state =
    await loadRecallState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const worldState =
    await loadSharedWorldState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const machine =
    buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
      row
    );

  const betting =
    buildRecallV14BetPublic(
      row,
      state
    );

  return {
    ok:
      true,

    build:
      RECALL_V14_BUILD_VERSION,

    machine,

    machineAggressionInstalled:
      typeof buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction ===
        "function",

    language:
      normalizeRecallV14Language(
        row.language
      ),

    mandarinVoiceConfigured: {
      nameless:
        Boolean(
          getRecallV14MandarinVoiceId(
            env,
            CHARACTER_NAMELESS
          )
        ),

      host:
        Boolean(
          getRecallV14MandarinVoiceId(
            env,
            CHARACTER_HOST
          )
        )
    },

    shodanDetected:
      isRecallV14ShodanHost(
        state
      ),

    shodanDistortionInstalled:
      typeof applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion ===
        "function",

    betting,

    gold:
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          worldState
            ?.player
            ?.money,
          0
        )
      ),

    settlementInstalled:
      typeof settleRecallV14BetIfReady ===
        "function",

    clientStateBusInstalled:
      true
  };
}


// =========================================================
// DIAGNOSTIC ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14Diagnostics(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse(
    await buildRecallV14Diagnostics(
      env,
      visitorId
    )
  );
}

      return await handleRecallV14Diagnostics(

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part33(

    );

// =========================================================
// HTML WRAPPER — PART 33
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part33Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part33Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part33ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };

    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// MANDARIN VOICE POLICY
//
// Never destroy the established English voices.
// Mandarin counterparts are optional environment bindings.
// If none is configured, the current actor remains selected
// and only the requested language metadata changes.
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14VoicePolicy(
  env,
  visitorId,
  speakerKey
) {
  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const language =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      row.language
    );

  const mandarin =
    language ===
      RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE;

  const counterpart =
    mandarin
      ? getRecallV14MandarinVoiceId(
          env,
          speakerKey
        )
      : null;

  return {
    textLanguage:
      language,

    speechLanguage:
      mandarin
        ? "cmn-TW"
        : "en-US",

    useMandarinCounterpart:
      Boolean(
        counterpart
      ),

    configuredVoiceId:
      counterpart,

    preserveExistingVoice:
      !counterpart,

    preserveCadence:
      true,

    preserveShodanDistortion:
      true
  };
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN DISTORTION METADATA
// =========================================================

function buildRecallV14ShodanMetadata(
  state,
  speakerKey
) {
  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const host =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "host";

  const active =
    host &&
    isRecallV14ShodanHost(
      state
    );

  return {
    active,

    speaker:
      host
        ? "host"
        : "nameless",

    preserveForSpeech:
      active,

    allowSubtle:
      true,

    allowExtreme:
      true,

    allowBrackets:
      true,

    allowQuotes:
      true,

    allowNumericIntrusions:
      true,

    allowMissingSpaces:
      true,

    allowStretchedLetters:
      true,

    normalizeBeforeSpeech:
      false
  };
}


// =========================================================
// COMPLETE V14 STATUS
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14CompleteStatus(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const [
    publicState,
    recallState
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      buildRecallV14PublicState(
        env,
        visitorId
      ),

      loadRecallState(
        env,
        visitorId
      )
    ]);

  const activeSpeaker =
    recallState
      ?.conversation
      ?.activeSpeaker ??
    CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

  return {
    ...publicState,

    voice:
      await buildRecallV14VoicePolicy(
        env,
        visitorId,
        activeSpeaker
      ),

    shodan:
      buildRecallV14ShodanMetadata(
        recallState,
        activeSpeaker
      ),

    rules: {
      machine:
        "literal-exponent",

      machineAffects:
        "nameless-aggression",

      machinePreservesIntelligence:
        true,

      bettingWindowSeconds:
        RECALL_V14_BET_WINDOW_SECONDS,

      bettingOnePerEpisode:
        true,

      correctBetReturns:
        "2x-wager",

      traditionalChinese:
        true,

      shodanDistortion:
        "variable-subtle-to-extreme"
    }
  };
}


// =========================================================
// STATUS ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14CompleteStatus(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    v14:
      await buildRecallV14CompleteStatus(
        env,
        visitorId
      )
  });
}


// =========================================================
// LIVE TURN METADATA
//
// Attach explicit behavior metadata to generated turns so the
// client/TTS path never has to guess whether malformed SHODAN
// text is intentional.
// =========================================================

const generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part34 =
  generateRecallTurn;


generateRecallTurn =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const generated =
      await generateRecallTurnBeforeV14Part34(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state,
        options
      );

    if (
      !generated ||
      typeof generated !==
        "object"
    ) {
      return generated;
    }

    const speakerKey =
      generated
        ?.speakerKey ??
      generated
        ?.speaker ??
      options
        ?.speakerKey ??
      state
        ?.conversation
        ?.activeSpeaker ??
      CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

    generated.v14Voice =
      await buildRecallV14VoicePolicy(
        env,
        visitorId,
        speakerKey
      );

    generated.v14Shodan =
      buildRecallV14ShodanMetadata(
        state,
        speakerKey
      );

    return generated;
  };

// =========================================================
// CLIENT EVENT BRIDGES
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART34_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part34-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";


  function currentVisitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,
      localStorage.getItem("visitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("visitor_id"),
      localStorage.getItem("recallVisitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("recall_visitor_id")
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  async function refreshCompleteStatus() {
    const visitorId =
      currentVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return null;
    }

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/v14/status?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          visitorId
        ),
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin"
        }
      );

    const payload =
      await response.json();

    if (
      payload?.ok &&
      payload?.v14
    ) {
      window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
        payload.v14;

      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent(
          "recall-v14-server-state",
          {
            detail:
              payload.v14
          }
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  window.refreshRecallV14Status =
    refreshCompleteStatus;


  // =======================================================
  // MACHINE PURCHASE EVENT
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-machine-upgraded",
    () => {
      refreshCompleteStatus()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // GOLD EVENT
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-gold-changed",
    () => {
      refreshCompleteStatus()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // EPISODE / COMBAT EVENT
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-combat-state-changed",
    () => {
      refreshCompleteStatus()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-episode-changed",
    () => {
      refreshCompleteStatus()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // VOICE POLICY
  // =======================================================

  window.getRecallV14VoicePolicy =
    function () {
      return (
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
          ?.voice ||
        null
      );
    };


  window.shouldPreserveRecallSpeechCadence =
    function () {
      return true;
    };


  window.shouldNormalizeRecallSpeechText =
    function () {
      return false;
    };


  // =======================================================
  // SHODAN
  // =======================================================

  window.isRecallShodanDistortionActive =
    function () {
      return Boolean(
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
          ?.shodan
          ?.active
      );
    };


  window.prepareRecallDialogueForTts =
    function (
      text
    ) {
      /*
       * EXACTLY preserve generated output.
       *
       * "subtleSUBTLE", "WeeeELLLLL",
       * "3290298distort", "sometimesremovingspaces"
       * are not cleanup bugs when SHODAN is speaking.
       */
      return String(
        text ?? ""
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // LANGUAGE
  // =======================================================

  window.getRecallV14Language =
    function () {
      return (
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
          ?.language ||
        "en"
      );
    };


  window.getRecallV14SpeechLanguage =
    function () {
      return (
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
          ?.voice
          ?.speechLanguage ||
        (
          window.getRecallV14Language() ===
            "zh-TW"
            ? "cmn-TW"
            : "en-US"
        )
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // INITIAL STATUS
  // =======================================================

  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      () => {
        refreshCompleteStatus()
          .catch(
            () => {}
          );
      },
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    refreshCompleteStatus()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );
  }
})();
</script>
`;

  handleRecallV14MachineUpgrade;


handleRecallV14MachineUpgrade =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const requestCopy =
      request.clone();

    let visitorId =
      null;

    try {
      const body =
        await requestCopy.json();

      visitorId =
        normalizeVisitorId(
          body
            ?.visitorId ??
          body
            ?.visitor_id
        );
    } catch {
      visitorId =
        null;
    }

    const response =
      await handleRecallV14MachineUpgradeBeforePart35(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !response?.ok
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let payload;

    try {
      payload =
        await response
          .clone()
          .json();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (!payload?.ok) {
      return response;
    }

    return jsonResponse(
      await buildRecallV14MutationEnvelope(
        env,
        visitorId,
        {
          spent:
            payload.spent,

          remainingGold:
            payload.remainingGold,

          machine:
            payload.machine
        }
      )
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// TTS METADATA ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14TtsMetadata(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  const speakerKey =
    normalizeString(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "speaker"
      ),
      "",
      100
    ) ||
    CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const state =
    await loadRecallState(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    voice:
      await buildRecallV14VoicePolicy(
        env,
        visitorId,
        speakerKey
      ),

    shodan:
      buildRecallV14ShodanMetadata(
        state,
        speakerKey
      )
  });
}

        "/v14/tts-metadata"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14TtsMetadata(
        request,
        env,
        url
      );
    }

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part35(
      request,
      env
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CLIENT — FINAL MUTATION / GOLD BRIDGE
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART35_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part35-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";


  function emit(
    name,
    detail
  ) {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(
        name,
        {
          detail
        }
      )
    );
  }


  function applyPayload(
    payload
  ) {
    if (
      !payload ||
      typeof payload !== "object"
    ) {
      return payload;
    }

    if (payload.v14) {
      window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
        payload.v14;

      emit(
        "recall-v14-server-state",
        payload.v14
      );

      emit(
        "recall-gold-value",
        {
          gold:
            payload.v14.playerGold
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      payload.spent !==
        undefined
    ) {
      emit(
        "recall-machine-upgraded",
        {
          spent:
            payload.spent,

          machine:
            payload.machine,

          gold:
            payload.v14
              ?.playerGold ??
            payload.remainingGold
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      payload.language
    ) {
      emit(
        "recall-language-changed",
        {
          language:
            payload.language
        }
      );
    }

    if (
      payload.bet
    ) {
      emit(
        "recall-bet-placed",
        {
          bet:
            payload.bet,

          gold:
            payload.v14
              ?.playerGold ??
            payload.remainingGold
        }
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  const previousConsumer =
    window.consumeRecallV14Response;


  window.consumeRecallV14Response =
    function (
      payload
    ) {
      if (
        typeof previousConsumer ===
          "function"
      ) {
        previousConsumer(
          payload
        );
      }

      return applyPayload(
        payload
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // GOLD DISPLAY BRIDGE
  //
  // The existing GOLD = X control remains authoritative.
  // This does not move it or recreate it. It only broadcasts
  // the newest value after a V14 mutation.
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-gold-value",
    event => {
      const gold =
        Number(
          event.detail
            ?.gold
        );

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(
          gold
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      /*
       * Existing UI modules may subscribe to this event.
       * Keep DOM guessing out of the Worker.
       */
      window.RECALL_CURRENT_GOLD =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            gold
          )
        );
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // MACHINE FEEDBACK
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-machine-upgraded",
    event => {
      const status =
        document.getElementById(
          "recall-v14-machine-status"
        );

      if (!status) {
        return;
      }

      const spent =
        Number(
          event.detail
            ?.spent ||
          0
        );

      const level =
        Number(
          event.detail
            ?.machine
            ?.level ||
          0
        );

      status.textContent =
        "MACHINE LEVEL " +
        Math.floor(level)
          .toLocaleString() +
        " — " +
        Math.floor(spent)
          .toLocaleString() +
        " GOLD SPENT";
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // LANGUAGE FEEDBACK
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-language-changed",
    event => {
      const language =
        event.detail
          ?.language;

      document.documentElement.lang =
        language === "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // BET FEEDBACK
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-bet-placed",
    event => {
      const status =
        document.getElementById(
          "recall-v14-bet-status"
        );

      const bet =
        event.detail
          ?.bet;

      if (
        !status ||
        !bet
      ) {
        return;
      }

      status.textContent =
        "BET LOCKED — " +
        String(
          bet.choice || ""
        ).toUpperCase() +
        " — " +
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            bet.wager || 0
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString() +
        " GOLD";
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // MANDARIN TTS REQUEST METADATA
  // =======================================================

  window.getRecallV14TtsMetadata =
    async function (
      speaker
    ) {
      const visitorId =
        (
          window.visitorId ||
          window.VISITOR_ID ||
          window.recallVisitorId ||
          window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "visitorId"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "visitor_id"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "recallVisitorId"
          ) ||
          localStorage.getItem(
            "recall_visitor_id"
          ) ||
          ""
        )
          .toString()
          .trim();

      if (!visitorId) {
        return null;
      }

      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/tts-metadata?visitorId=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            visitorId
          ) +
          "&speaker=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            speaker || "nameless"
          ),
          {
            credentials:
              "same-origin"
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      return payload?.ok
        ? payload
        : null;
    };


  // =======================================================
  // FINAL SHODAN CONTRACT
  // =======================================================

  window.RECALL_SHODAN_SPEECH_CONTRACT =
    Object.freeze({
      preserveText:
        true,

      normalize:
        false,

      subtleDistortion:
        true,

      extremeDistortion:
        true,

      repeatedLetters:
        true,

      numericIntrusions:
        true,

      bracketIntrusions:
        true,

      missingSpaces:
        true,

      strangeCase:
        true
    });


  // =======================================================
  // READY SIGNAL
  // =======================================================

  window.RECALL_V14_CLIENT_READY =
    true;

  emit(
    "recall-v14-ready",
    {
      build:
        "recall-thy-name-v14-major",

      part:
        35
    }
  );
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// CLIENT INSTALLER — PART 35
// =========================================================

function installRecallV14Part35ClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-part35-client-script"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      RECALL_V14_PART35_CLIENT_SCRIPT +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    RECALL_V14_PART35_CLIENT_SCRIPT
  );
}


// =========================================================
// HTML WRAPPER — PART 35
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part35Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part35Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part35ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };

      response
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// ECONOMY INVARIANTS
// =========================================================

function verifyRecallV14MachinePricing()
{
  const failures =
    [];

  for (
    let level = 0;
    level <
      RECALL_V14_MACHINE_MAX_LEVEL;
    level += 1
  ) {
    const expected =
      10 ** (
        level + 4
      );

    const actual =
      getRecallV14MachinePrice(
        level
      );

    if (
      actual !== expected
    ) {
      failures.push({
        level,
        expected,
        actual
      });
    }
  }

  const maxed =
    getRecallV14MachinePrice(
      RECALL_V14_MACHINE_MAX_LEVEL
    );

  if (maxed !== null) {
    failures.push({
      level:
        RECALL_V14_MACHINE_MAX_LEVEL,

      expected:
        null,

      actual:
        maxed
    });
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures
  };
}


// =========================================================
// BETTING INVARIANTS
// =========================================================

function verifyRecallV14BettingRules()
{
  const failures =
    [];

  if (
    RECALL_V14_BET_WINDOW_SECONDS !==
      300
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Betting window must be exactly five minutes."
    );
  }

  const choices = [
    normalizeRecallV14BetChoice(
      "host"
    ),

    normalizeRecallV14BetChoice(
      "nameless"
    )
  ];

  if (
    choices[0] !== "host" ||
    choices[1] !== "nameless"
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "HOST / NAMELESS wager choices are not normalized correctly."
    );
  }

  if (
    normalizeRecallV14BetChoice(
      "anything-else"
    ) !== null
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Invalid betting choices must be rejected."
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures
  };
}


// =========================================================
// LANGUAGE INVARIANTS
// =========================================================

function verifyRecallV14LanguageRules()
{
  const failures =
    [];

  if (
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      "zh-TW"
    ) !== "zh-TW"
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Traditional Chinese mode failed normalization."
    );
  }

  if (
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      "en"
    ) !== "en"
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "English mode failed normalization."
    );
  }

  if (
    !buildRecallV14LanguageInstruction(
      "zh-TW"
    )
      .includes(
        "繁體中文"
      )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Traditional Chinese generation instruction is missing."
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures
  };
}


// =========================================================
// MACHINE PERSONALITY INVARIANTS
// =========================================================

function verifyRecallV14MachinePersonality()
{
  const failures =
    [];

  const low =
    buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
      1
    );

  const high =
    buildRecallV14MachineAggressionInstruction(
      RECALL_V14_MACHINE_MAX_LEVEL
    );

  if (
    !low ||
    !high
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "MACHINE aggression instructions are missing."
    );
  }

  if (
    !high
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(
        "intelligence"
      )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Maximum MACHINE instruction must explicitly preserve intelligence."
    );
  }

  const packet = {
    machineLevel:
      4,

    language:
      "en"
  };

  const namelessInstruction =
    buildRecallV14SpeakerInstruction(
      packet,
      CHARACTER_NAMELESS
    );

  const hostInstruction =
    buildRecallV14SpeakerInstruction(
      packet,
      CHARACTER_HOST
    );

  if (
    !namelessInstruction
      .includes(
        "[MACHINE"
      )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "MACHINE is not reaching Nameless."
    );
  }

  if (
    hostInstruction
      .includes(
        "[MACHINE"
      )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "MACHINE must not alter the hired host."
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures
  };
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN INVARIANTS
// =========================================================

function verifyRecallV14ShodanRules()
{
  const failures =
    [];

  const source =
    "This sentence should remain intelligible while distortion can vary.";

  const sample =
    applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
      source,
      {
        visitorId:
          "v14-self-test",

        turnNumber:
          99
      }
    );

  if (
    typeof sample !==
      "string" ||
    !sample.length
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "SHODAN distortion returned no text."
    );
  }

  const metadata =
    buildRecallV14ShodanMetadata(
      {
        host: {
          name:
            "SHODAN"
        }
      },
      CHARACTER_HOST
    );

  if (
    !metadata.active
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "SHODAN host detection failed."
    );
  }

  if (
    metadata.normalizeBeforeSpeech !==
      false
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "SHODAN speech must never be normalized before TTS."
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures,

    sample
  };
}


// =========================================================
// STATIC SELF TEST
// =========================================================

function runRecallV14StaticSelfTest()
{
  const sections = {
    machinePricing:
      verifyRecallV14MachinePricing(),

    betting:
      verifyRecallV14BettingRules(),

    language:
      verifyRecallV14LanguageRules(),

    machinePersonality:
      verifyRecallV14MachinePersonality(),

    shodan:
      verifyRecallV14ShodanRules()
  };

  const failed =
    Object.entries(
      sections
    )
      .filter(
        ([
          ,
          result
        ]) =>
          !result.ok
      )
      .map(
        ([
          name
        ]) =>
          name
      );

  return {
    ok:
      failed.length === 0,

    failed,

    sections
  };
}


// =========================================================
// VISITOR-SPECIFIC SELF TEST
// =========================================================

async function runRecallV14VisitorSelfTest(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  const [
    row,
    state,
    worldState,
    completeStatus
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      initializeRecallV14Player(
        env,
        visitorId
      ),

      loadRecallState(
        env,
        visitorId
      ),

      loadSharedWorldState(
        env,
        visitorId
      ),

      buildRecallV14CompleteStatus(
        env,
        visitorId
      )
    ]);

  const machine =
    buildRecallV14MachinePublic(
      row
    );

  const betting =
    buildRecallV14BetPublic(
      row,
      state
    );

  const gold =
    Math.max(
      0,
      integerNumber(
        worldState
          ?.player
          ?.money,
        0
      )
    );

  const failures =
    [];

  if (
    machine.level < 0 ||
    machine.level >
      RECALL_V14_MACHINE_MAX_LEVEL
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Persistent MACHINE level is outside valid bounds."
    );
  }

  if (
    gold < 0
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Persistent GOLD is negative."
    );
  }

  if (
    ![
      "none",
      "locked",
      "settling",
      "won",
      "lost"
    ].includes(
      String(
        betting.status
      )
    )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Persistent bet status is invalid."
    );
  }

  if (
    ![
      "en",
      "zh-TW"
    ].includes(
      completeStatus.language
    )
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "Persistent language is invalid."
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    failures,

    visitor: {
      machine,
      betting,
      gold,

      language:
        completeStatus.language,

      shodan:
        completeStatus.shodan,

      voice:
        completeStatus.voice
    }
  };
}

) {

  return jsonResponse({

        visitorTest.ok
      ),

    build:
      RECALL_V14_BUILD_MANIFEST,

    static:
      staticTest,

    visitor:
      visitorTest
  });
}

// =========================================================
// HTML WRAPPER — PART 36
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part36Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part36Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part36ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// CLIENT RECOVERY / REQUEST COALESCING
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_PART37_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-part37-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_PART37_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_PART37_INSTALLED =
    true;

  let refreshPromise =
    null;

  let mutationBusy =
    false;


  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,
      localStorage.getItem("visitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("visitor_id"),
      localStorage.getItem("recallVisitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("recall_visitor_id")
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function emit(
    name,
    detail
  ) {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(
        name,
        {
          detail
        }
      )
    );
  }


  function consumeState(
    payload
  ) {
    const v14 =
      payload?.v14;

    if (!v14) {
      return payload;
    }

    window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
      v14;

    if (
      Number.isFinite(
        Number(
          v14.playerGold
        )
      )
    ) {
      window.RECALL_CURRENT_GOLD =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            Number(
              v14.playerGold
            )
          )
        );
    }

    emit(
      "recall-v14-server-state",
      v14
    );

    return payload;
  }


  async function refresh() {
    if (refreshPromise) {
      return refreshPromise;
    }

    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      return null;
    }

    refreshPromise =
      fetch(
        "/v14/status?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        ),
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",
          cache:
            "no-store"
        }
      )
        .then(
          response =>
            response.json()
        )
        .then(
          consumeState
        )
        .catch(
          () =>
            null
        )
        .finally(
          () => {
            refreshPromise =
              null;
          }
        );

    return refreshPromise;
  }


  window.refreshRecallV14 =
    refresh;


  // =======================================================
  // MUTATION GUARD
  //
  // Server-side GOLD locking remains authoritative.
  // This only prevents accidental rapid duplicate UI actions.
  // =======================================================

  window.beginRecallV14Mutation =
    function () {
      if (mutationBusy) {
        return false;
      }

      mutationBusy =
        true;

      document
        .documentElement
        .setAttribute(
          "data-recall-v14-busy",
          "true"
        );

      return true;
    };


  window.endRecallV14Mutation =
    function () {
      mutationBusy =
        false;

      document
        .documentElement
        .removeAttribute(
          "data-recall-v14-busy"
        );

      refresh()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    };


  window.isRecallV14MutationBusy =
    function () {
      return mutationBusy;
    };


  // =======================================================
  // BUTTON HARDENING
  // =======================================================

  function hardenButton(
    id
  ) {
    const button =
      document.getElementById(
        id
      );

    if (
      !button ||
      button.dataset
        .recallV14Hardened ===
          "1"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    button.dataset
      .recallV14Hardened =
        "1";

    button.addEventListener(
      "dblclick",
      event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
    );
  }


  function hardenControls() {
    hardenButton(
      "recall-v14-machine"
    );

    hardenButton(
      "recall-v14-language"
    );

    hardenButton(
      "recall-v14-place-bet"
    );
  }


  // =======================================================
  // ONLINE RECOVERY
  // =======================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "online",
    () => {
      refresh()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    }
  );


  document.addEventListener(
    "visibilitychange",
    () => {
      if (
        !document.hidden
      ) {
        refresh()
          .catch(
            () => {}
          );
      }
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // FINAL SPEECH GUARANTEE
  // =======================================================

  window.recallV14SpeechText =
    function (
      text
    ) {
      /*
       * Deliberately no cleanup.
       *
       * Amazon cadence stays.
       * SHODAN corruption stays.
       */
      return String(
        text ?? ""
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // BOOT
  // =======================================================

  function boot() {
    hardenControls();

    refresh()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );

    window.RECALL_V14_DEPLOYMENT_READY =
      true;

    emit(
      "recall-v14-deployment-ready",
      {
        build:
          "recall-thy-name-v14-major",

        part:
          37
      }
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      boot,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

// =========================================================
// ACCEPTANCE REPORT
// =========================================================

async function buildRecallV14AcceptanceReport(
  env,
  visitorId = null
) {
  const staticTest =
    runRecallV14StaticSelfTest();

  const runtime =
    getRecallV14RuntimeReport();

  let visitor =
    null;

  if (visitorId) {
    visitor =
      await runRecallV14VisitorSelfTest(
        env,
        visitorId
      );
  }

  const failures =
    [];

  if (!staticTest.ok) {
    failures.push(
      "static-self-test"
    );
  }

  if (!runtime.ok) {
    failures.push(
      "runtime-report"
    );
  }

  if (
    visitor &&
    !visitor.ok
  ) {
    failures.push(
      "visitor-state"
    );
  }

  return {
    ok:
      failures.length === 0,

    build:
      RECALL_V14_BUILD_VERSION,

    completedThroughPart:
      38,

    failures,

    static:
      staticTest,

    runtime,

    visitor,

    contracts: {
      originalCadencePreserved:
        true,

      shodanTextPreservedForSpeech:
        true,

      machineAffectsNamelessOnly:
        true,

      machinePreservesIntelligence:
        true,

      machineUsesExponentialPricing:
        true,

      goldPersists:
        true,

      bettingUsesPersistentGold:
        true,

      bettingClosesAfterFiveMinutes:
        true,

      correctBetPaysDoubleWager:
        true,

      traditionalChinesePersistent:
        true,

      mandarinVoiceBridgeInstalled:
        true
    }
  };
}

  request,
  env,
  url
) {

    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(

      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"

    );

    await buildRecallV14AcceptanceReport(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return jsonResponse(
    report,
    report.ok
      ? 200
      : 500
  );
}

      root:
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            "recall-v14-controls"
          )
        ),

      machine:
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            "recall-v14-machine"
          )
        ),

      language:
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            "recall-v14-language"
          )
        ),

      betting:
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            "recall-v14-place-bet"
          )
        ),

      wager:
        Boolean(
          document.getElementById(
            "recall-v14-bet-wager"
          )
        )
    };

    controls.ok =
      controls.root &&
      controls.machine &&
      controls.language &&
      controls.betting &&
      controls.wager;

    return controls;
  }


  window.getRecallV14ControlsReport =
    getControlsReport;


  // =======================================================
  // NON-DESTRUCTIVE ERROR REPORTING
  // =======================================================

  const errors =
    [];

  function recordError(
    source,
    message
  ) {
    const item = {
      source:
        String(
          source || "unknown"
        ),

      message:
        String(
          message || "unknown error"
        ),

      at:
        new Date()
          .toISOString()
    };

    errors.push(
      item
    );

    if (
      errors.length > 25
    ) {
      errors.shift();
    }

    window.RECALL_V14_CLIENT_ERRORS =
      errors.slice();

    emit(
      "recall-v14-client-error",
      item
    );
  }


  window.reportRecallV14Error =
    recordError;


  window.addEventListener(
    "unhandledrejection",
    event => {
      const reason =
        event.reason;

      const message =
        reason?.message ||
        reason ||
        "";

      /*
       * Only record errors that visibly identify V14.
       * Do not swallow or prevent the browser's normal event.
       */
      if (
        String(
          message
        )
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(
            "v14"
          )
      ) {
        recordError(
          "promise",
          message
        );
      }
    }
  );


  // =======================================================
  // CONTROL WATCHDOG
  //
  // The page may be dynamically rebuilt by older UI code.
  // If controls disappear, report it and request a status
  // refresh. Do not recreate duplicate controls here.
// =======================================================

  let lastControlsOk =
    null;


  function watchdog() {
    const report =
      getControlsReport();

    if (
      lastControlsOk !==
        report.ok
    ) {
      lastControlsOk =
        report.ok;

      emit(
        "recall-v14-controls-health",
        report
      );
    }

    if (
      !report.ok
    ) {
      if (
        typeof window.refreshRecallV14 ===
          "function"
      ) {
        window.refreshRecallV14()
          .catch(
            error => {
              recordError(
                "watchdog-refresh",
                error?.message ||
                error
              );
            }
          );
      }
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // ACCEPTANCE FETCH
  // =======================================================

  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,
      localStorage.getItem("visitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("visitor_id"),
      localStorage.getItem("recallVisitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("recall_visitor_id")
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  window.runRecallV14Acceptance =
    async function () {
      const id =
        visitorId();

      let path =
        "/v14/acceptance";

      if (id) {
        path +=
          "?visitorId=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            id
          );
      }

      const response =
        await fetch(
          path,
          {
            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store"
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      window.RECALL_V14_ACCEPTANCE =
        payload;

      emit(
        "recall-v14-acceptance",
        payload
      );

      return payload;
    };


  // =======================================================
  // FINAL CONTRACT
  // =======================================================

  window.RECALL_V14_CONTRACT =
    Object.freeze({
      preserveRoboticCadence:
        true,

      preserveGeneratedSpeechText:
        true,

      shodanSubtleToExtreme:
        true,

      machineNamelessOnly:
        true,

      machineDoesNotMakeNamelessStupid:
        true,

      bettingFiveMinutes:
        true,

      traditionalChinese:
        true,

      persistentGold:
        true
    });


  // =======================================================
  // BOOT
  // =======================================================

  function boot() {
    watchdog();

    /*
     * Low-frequency watchdog only.
     */
    window.setInterval(
      watchdog,
      15000
    );

    window.RECALL_V14_READY =
      true;

    emit(
      "recall-v14-final-ready",
      {
        build:
          "recall-thy-name-v14-major",

        part:
          38,

        controls:
          getControlsReport(),

        contract:
          window.RECALL_V14_CONTRACT
      }
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      boot,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

// HTML WRAPPER — PART 38
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part38Html =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeV14Part38Html(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (
      !response ||
      !(response instanceof Response)
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const contentType =
      response.headers
        .get(
          "content-type"
        ) ||
      "";

    if (
      !contentType
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "text/html"
        )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    let text;

    try {
      text =
        await response
          .clone()
          .text();
    } catch {
      return response;
    }

    if (
      !text.includes(
        "recall thy name"
      ) &&
      !text.includes(
        "CRYPT NETWORK"
      )
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const augmented =
      installRecallV14Part38ClientIntoHtml(
        text
      );

    if (
      augmented === text
    ) {
      return response;
    }

    const headers =
      new Headers(
        response.headers
      );

    headers.delete(
      "content-length"
    );

    return new Response(
      augmented,
      {
        status:
          response.status,

        statusText:
          response.statusText,

        headers
      }
    );
  };

    );
  };

function buildRecallV14FinalHtml()
{
  let html =
    HTML;

  const installers = [
    typeof installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part31ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part31ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part32ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part32ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part33ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part33ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part34ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part34ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part35ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part35ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part36ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part36ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part37ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part37ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part38ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part38ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    typeof installRecallV14Part39ClientIntoHtml ===
      "function"
        ? installRecallV14Part39ClientIntoHtml
        : null,

    installRecallV14ShodanClientIntoHtml
  ]
    .filter(
      Boolean
    );

  for (
    const installer
    of installers
  ) {
    html =
      installer(
        html
      );
  }

  return html;
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN PERSISTENCE
//
// Keep this in the existing V14 table without a destructive
// migration. SQLite safely ignores duplicate-column attempts.
// =========================================================

let recallV14ShodanColumnReady =
  false;


async function ensureRecallV14ShodanColumn(
  env
) {
  if (
    recallV14ShodanColumnReady
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  try {
    await db
      .prepare(`
        ALTER TABLE recall_v14_player
        ADD COLUMN shodan_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      `)
      .run();
  } catch (
    error
  ) {
    const message =
      String(
        error?.message ||
        error ||
        ""
      )
        .toLowerCase();

    if (
      !message.includes(
        "duplicate column"
      ) &&
      !message.includes(
        "already exists"
      )
    ) {
      throw error;
    }
  }

  recallV14ShodanColumnReady =
    true;
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN PUBLIC STATE
// =========================================================

async function getRecallV14ShodanEnabled(
  env,
  visitorId
) {
  await ensureRecallV14ShodanColumn(
    env
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const row =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT shodan_enabled

        FROM recall_v14_player

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  return integerNumber(
    row?.shodan_enabled,
    0
  ) === 1;
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN TOGGLE ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14ShodanToggle(
  request,
  env
) {
  const parsed =
    await readRecallV13JsonBody(
      request.clone()
    );

  if (!parsed.ok) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid SHODAN request."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      parsed.value
        ?.visitorId ??
      parsed.value
        ?.visitor_id
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  await initializeRecallV14Player(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  await ensureRecallV14ShodanColumn(
    env
  );

  const enabled =
    Boolean(
      parsed.value
        ?.enabled
    );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_v14_player

      SET
        shodan_enabled = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      enabled
        ? 1
        : 0,
      isoNow(),
      visitorId
    )
    .run();

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    shodanEnabled:
      enabled
  });
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN DISTORTION ACTIVATION
//
// SHODAN mode means the current HOST receives the distortion
// treatment. It does not rename or replace the host.
// =========================================================

async function applyRecallV14ShodanToggleToGenerated(
  env,
  visitorId,
  state,
  generated,
  speakerKey
) {
  const enabled =
    await getRecallV14ShodanEnabled(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  if (!enabled) {
    return generated;
  }

  const speaker =
    String(
      speakerKey || ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const hostIsSpeaking =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker === "host";

  if (!hostIsSpeaking) {
    return generated;
  }

  const candidateKeys = [
    "text",
    "content",
    "message",
    "dialogue"
  ];

  for (
    const key
    of candidateKeys
  ) {
    if (
      typeof generated?.[key] ===
        "string" &&
      generated[key].trim()
    ) {
      generated[key] =
        applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
          generated[key],
          {
            visitorId,

            turnNumber:
              state
                ?.conversation
                ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber ??
              0
          }
        );

      generated.v14ShodanDistorted =
        true;

      generated.v14PreserveSpeechText =
        true;

      break;
    }
  }

  return generated;
}

const generateRecallTurnBeforeV14ShodanToggle =
  generateRecallTurn;


generateRecallTurn =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const speakerKey =
      options
        ?.speakerKey ??
      state
        ?.conversation
        ?.activeSpeaker ??
      CHARACTER_NAMELESS;

    const generated =
      await generateRecallTurnBeforeV14ShodanToggle(
        env,
        visitorId,
        state,
        options
      );

    return await applyRecallV14ShodanToggleToGenerated(
      env,
      visitorId,
      state,
      generated,
      speakerKey
    );
  };

// =========================================================
// SHODAN CLIENT CONTROL
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_SHODAN_CLIENT_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-shodan-client-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,
      localStorage.getItem("visitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("visitor_id"),
      localStorage.getItem("recallVisitorId"),
      localStorage.getItem("recall_visitor_id")
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function ensureButton() {
    const existing =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-shodan"
      );

    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    const machine =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-machine"
      );

    const language =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-language"
      );

    const row =
      machine?.parentElement ||
      language?.parentElement;

    if (!row) {
      return null;
    }

    const button =
      document.createElement(
        "button"
      );

    button.id =
      "recall-v14-shodan";

    button.className =
      "recall-v14-button";

    button.type =
      "button";

    button.textContent =
      "SHODAN: OFF";

    row.appendChild(
      button
    );

    return button;
  }


  function render(
    enabled
  ) {
    const button =
      ensureButton();

    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    button.textContent =
      enabled
        ? "SHODAN: ON"
        : "SHODAN: OFF";

    button.dataset.enabled =
      enabled
        ? "1"
        : "0";
  }


  async function toggle() {
    const button =
      ensureButton();

    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (
      !button ||
      !id
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const enabled =
      button.dataset.enabled !==
        "1";

    button.disabled =
      true;

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/shodan",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            headers: {
              "content-type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId:
                  id,

                enabled
              })
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        payload?.ok
      ) {
        render(
          Boolean(
            payload.shodanEnabled
          )
        );

        if (
          typeof window.refreshRecallV14 ===
            "function"
        ) {
          await window.refreshRecallV14();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      button.disabled =
        false;
    }
  }


  function bind() {
    const button =
      ensureButton();

    if (
      button &&
      button.dataset.bound !==
        "1"
    ) {
      button.dataset.bound =
        "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        toggle
      );
    }

    const state =
      window.RECALL_V14_STATE;

    if (
      state &&
      typeof state.shodanEnabled ===
        "boolean"
    ) {
      render(
        state.shodanEnabled
      );
    }
  }


  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-v14-server-state",
    event => {
      if (
        typeof event.detail
          ?.shodanEnabled ===
          "boolean"
      ) {
        render(
          event.detail
            .shodanEnabled
        );
      }

      bind();
    }
  );


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


function installRecallV14ShodanClientIntoHtml(
  html
) {
  const source =
    String(
      html || ""
    );

  if (
    source.includes(
      'id="recall-v14-shodan-client-script"'
    )
  ) {
    return source;
  }

  if (
    source.includes(
      "</body>"
    )
  ) {
    return source.replace(
      "</body>",
      RECALL_V14_SHODAN_CLIENT_SCRIPT +
      "\n</body>"
    );
  }

  return (
    source +
    "\n" +
    RECALL_V14_SHODAN_CLIENT_SCRIPT
  );
}

//
// Fixes:
// - canonical Loki's Kingdom visitor ID for V14 controls;
// - MACHINE click;

// =========================================================
// CHAT EXPORT ENDPOINT
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14ExportChat(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  await ensureRecallDatabase(
    env
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const result =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT
          episode_number,
          speaker,
          speaker_name,
          content,
          conversation_mode,
          topic,
          show_state,
          created_at

        FROM recall_conversation_log

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        ORDER BY id ASC
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .all();

  const rows =
    Array.isArray(
      result?.results
    )
      ? result.results
      : [];

  const lines =
    [];

  lines.push(
    "RECALL THY NAME — CHAT EXPORT"
  );

  lines.push(
    "CRYPT NETWORK"
  );

  lines.push(
    "VISITOR: " +
    visitorId
  );

  lines.push(
    "EXPORTED: " +
    isoNow()
  );

  lines.push(
    ""
  );

  for (
    const row
    of rows
  ) {
    const speaker =
      normalizeString(
        row?.speaker_name,
        "",
        500
      ) ||
      normalizeString(
        row?.speaker,
        "UNKNOWN",
        500
      );

    const episode =
      Math.max(
        0,
        integerNumber(
          row?.episode_number,
          0
        )
      );

    const createdAt =
      normalizeString(
        row?.created_at,
        "",
        200
      );

    const mode =
      normalizeString(
        row?.conversation_mode,
        "",
        500
      );

    const topic =
      normalizeString(
        row?.topic,
        "",
        2000
      );

    const showState =
      normalizeString(
        row?.show_state,
        "",
        500
      );

    lines.push(
      "============================================================"
    );

    lines.push(
      [
        createdAt,
        "EPISODE " + episode,
        speaker,
        mode
          ? "MODE " + mode
          : null,
        showState
          ? "STATE " + showState
          : null
      ]
        .filter(
          Boolean
        )
        .join(
          " | "
        )
    );

    if (topic) {
      lines.push(
        "TOPIC: " +
        topic
      );
    }

    lines.push(
      ""
    );

    lines.push(
      String(
        row?.content ||
        ""
      )
    );

    lines.push(
      ""
    );
  }

  const text =
    lines.join(
      "\n"
    );

  const filename =
    "recall-thy-name-chat-" +
    new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        10
      ) +
    ".txt";

  return new Response(
    text,
    {
      status:
        200,

      headers: {
        "content-type":
          "text/plain; charset=UTF-8",

        "content-disposition":
          `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,

        "cache-control":
          "no-store"
      }
    }
  );
}
