// =========================================================
// CLIENT CONTROL REPAIR
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_CONTROL_REPAIR_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-control-repair-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_CONTROL_REPAIR_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_CONTROL_REPAIR_INSTALLED =
    true;


  // =======================================================
  // CANONICAL VISITOR ID
  //
  // The original Recall UI actually stores identity under:
  //
  // lokis-kingdom-visitor-id
  //
  // The first V14 client omitted this exact key.
  // =======================================================

  function getCanonicalVisitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,

      localStorage.getItem(
        "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitor_id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recallVisitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recall_visitor_id"
      )
    ];

    for (
      const value
      of candidates
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  window.getRecallV14CanonicalVisitorId =
    getCanonicalVisitorId;


  async function fetchJson(
    pathname,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        pathname,
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload = {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid server response."
      };
    }

    return {
      response,
      payload
    };
  }


  function machineButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine"
    );
  }


  function languageButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-language"
    );
  }


  function shodanButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-shodan"
    );
  }


  function betButton() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-place-bet"
    );
  }


  function betChoice() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-choice"
    );
  }


  function betWager() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-wager"
    );
  }


  function betStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-bet-status"
    );
  }


  function machineStatus() {
    return document.getElementById(
      "recall-v14-machine-status"
    );
  }


  function formatNumber(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    return Number.isFinite(
      number
    )
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            number
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function showError(
    element,
    message
  ) {
    if (element) {
      element.textContent =
        String(
          message ||
          "REQUEST FAILED."
        );
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // AUTHORITATIVE STATE
  // =======================================================

  let currentState =
    null;


  async function refreshRepairState() {
    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      showError(
        machineStatus(),
        "VISITOR ID NOT FOUND."
      );

      showError(
        betStatus(),
        "VISITOR ID NOT FOUND."
      );

      return null;
    }

    const {
      response,
      payload
    } =
      await fetchJson(
        "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          visitorId
        ),
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok ||
      !payload?.v14
    ) {
      showError(
        machineStatus(),
        payload?.error ||
        "V14 STATE FAILED."
      );

      return null;
    }

    currentState =
      payload.v14;

    window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
      currentState;

    renderRepairState(
      currentState
    );

    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(
        "recall-v14-server-state",
        {
          detail:
            currentState
        }
      )
    );

    return currentState;
  }


  window.refreshRecallV14Repair =
    refreshRepairState;


  function renderRepairState(
    v14
  ) {
    const machine =
      v14?.machine ||
      {};

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          v14?.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );

    const machineBtn =
      machineButton();

    const machineLabel =
      machineStatus();

    if (
      machineBtn &&
      machineLabel
    ) {
      if (
        machine.maxed
      ) {
        machineBtn.textContent =
          "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

        machineBtn.disabled =
          true;

        machineLabel.textContent =
          "MACHINE LEVEL " +
          formatNumber(
            machine.level
          );
      } else {
        const price =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              machine.nextPrice ||
              0
            )
          );

        machineBtn.textContent =
          "MACHINE LV " +
          formatNumber(
            machine.level
          ) +
          " → " +
          formatNumber(
            Number(
              machine.level ||
              0
            ) + 1
          ) +
          " — " +
          formatNumber(
            price
          ) +
          " GOLD";

        machineBtn.disabled =
          gold < price;

        machineLabel.textContent =
          "GOLD " +
          formatNumber(
            gold
          ) +
          " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
          formatNumber(
            price
          );
      }
    }

    const languageBtn =
      languageButton();

    if (
      languageBtn
    ) {
      languageBtn.disabled =
        false;

      languageBtn.textContent =
        v14?.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "繁體中文：開"
            : "繁體中文：關";
    }

    const shodanBtn =
      shodanButton();

    if (
      shodanBtn
    ) {
      const enabled =
        Boolean(
          v14
            ?.shodanEnabled
        );

      shodanBtn.disabled =
        false;

      shodanBtn.dataset.enabled =
        enabled
          ? "1"
          : "0";

      shodanBtn.textContent =
        enabled
          ? "SHODAN: ON"
          : "SHODAN: OFF";
    }

    const betting =
      v14?.betting ||
      {};

    const status =
      betStatus();

    const betBtn =
      betButton();

    const wager =
      betWager();

    const choice =
      betChoice();

    const betState =
      String(
        betting.status ||
        "none"
      );

    const open =
      Boolean(
        betting.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";

    if (betBtn) {
      betBtn.disabled =
        !open;
    }

    if (wager) {
      wager.disabled =
        !open;
    }

    if (choice) {
      choice.disabled =
        !open;
    }

    if (status) {
      if (
        betState ===
          "locked"
      ) {
        status.textContent =
          "BET LOCKED — " +
          String(
            betting.choice ||
            ""
          )
            .toUpperCase() +
          " — " +
          formatNumber(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "won"
      ) {
        status.textContent =
          "BET WON — " +
          formatNumber(
            betting.payout
          ) +
          " GOLD PAID";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "lost"
      ) {
        status.textContent =
          "BET LOST — " +
          formatNumber(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (open) {
        status.textContent =
          "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
          formatNumber(
            gold
          );
      } else {
        status.textContent =
          "BETTING CLOSED";
      }
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // MACHINE
  // =======================================================

  async function repairMachineClick(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const button =
      machineButton();

    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    if (
      !button ||
      !visitorId
    ) {
      return;
    }

    button.disabled =
      true;

    const {
      response,
      payload
    } =
      await fetchJson(
        "/v14/machine/upgrade",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId
            })
        }
      );

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      showError(
        machineStatus(),
        payload?.error ||
        "MACHINE UPGRADE FAILED."
      );
    }

    await refreshRepairState();
  }


  // =======================================================
  // LANGUAGE
  // =======================================================

  async function repairLanguageClick(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return;
    }

    const nextLanguage =
      currentState
        ?.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "en"
            : "zh-TW";

    const {
      response,
      payload
    } =
      await fetchJson(
        "/v14/language",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId,
              language:
                nextLanguage
            })
        }
      );

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      return;
    }

    await refreshRepairState();
  }


  // =======================================================
  // SHODAN
  // =======================================================

  async function repairShodanClick(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    const button =
      shodanButton();

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !button
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const enabled =
      button.dataset.enabled !==
        "1";

    button.disabled =
      true;

    const {
      response,
      payload
    } =
      await fetchJson(
        "/v14/shodan",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId,
              enabled
            })
        }
      );

    if (
      response.ok &&
      payload?.ok
    ) {
      button.dataset.enabled =
        payload.shodanEnabled
          ? "1"
          : "0";
    }

    await refreshRepairState();
  }


  // =======================================================
  // BET
  // =======================================================

  async function repairBetClick(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    const choice =
      betChoice()
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          betWager()
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      showError(
        betStatus(),
        "ENTER A GOLD WAGER."
      );

      return;
    }

    const {
      response,
      payload
    } =
      await fetchJson(
        "/v14/bet",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId,
              choice,
              wager
            })
        }
      );

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      showError(
        betStatus(),
        payload?.error ||
        "BET FAILED."
      );

      return;
    }

    /*
     * Immediate visible confirmation.
     */
    showError(
      betStatus(),
      "BET LOCKED — " +
      String(
        choice
      )
        .toUpperCase() +
      " — " +
      formatNumber(
        wager
      ) +
      " GOLD"
    );

    await refreshRepairState();
  }


  // =======================================================
  // EXPORT CHAT BUTTON
  // =======================================================

  function ensureExportButton() {
    let button =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-export-chat"
      );

    if (button) {
      return button;
    }

    const root =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-controls"
      );

    if (!root) {
      return null;
    }

    const row =
      document.createElement(
        "div"
      );

    row.className =
      "recall-v14-row";

    button =
      document.createElement(
        "button"
      );

    button.id =
      "recall-v14-export-chat";

    button.type =
      "button";

    button.className =
      "recall-v14-button";

    button.textContent =
      "EXPORT CHAT";

    row.appendChild(
      button
    );

    root.appendChild(
      row
    );

    return button;
  }


  function exportChat(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const visitorId =
      getCanonicalVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      return;
    }

    window.location.href =
      "/v14/export-chat?visitorId=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        visitorId
      );
  }


  // =======================================================
  // BIND
  //
  // Capture phase lets this repair own the buttons before the
  // older V14 handlers that use the wrong visitor key.
  // =======================================================

  function bindRepairControls() {
    const controls = [
      [
        machineButton(),
        repairMachineClick
      ],

      [
        languageButton(),
        repairLanguageClick
      ],

      [
        shodanButton(),
        repairShodanClick
      ],

      [
        betButton(),
        repairBetClick
      ],

      [
        ensureExportButton(),
        exportChat
      ]
    ];

    for (
      const [
        button,
        handler
      ]
      of controls
    ) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .v14RepairBound ===
            "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .v14RepairBound =
          "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        handler,
        true
      );
    }
  }


  function boot() {
    bindRepairControls();

    refreshRepairState()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );

    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        bindRepairControls();

        if (
          !document.hidden
        ) {
          refreshRepairState()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      boot,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE END OF THE WORKER.

// Changes:
// - Mandarin control becomes a clean two-state button:
//     MANDARIN -> ENGLISH -> MANDARIN
// - removes older conflicting click handlers by replacing
//   the language button node at boot;
// - uses the canonical Loki's Kingdom visitor identity;
// - SHODAN starts at PERSONA LEVEL 1 whenever enabled;
// - Level 1 adds a visible distortion bias;
// - leaves room for later SHODAN persona upgrades.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// SHODAN PERSONA LEVEL
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL =
  1;


function normalizeRecallV14ShodanPersonaLevel(
  value
) {
  return Math.max(
    RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL,
    Math.min(
      10,
      integerNumber(
        value,
        RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL
      )
    )
  );
}


// =========================================================
// SHODAN PUBLIC STATE — LEVEL 1
//
// For this version the persona level is fixed at 1.
// A future upgrade system can persist and increase it.
// =========================================================

const buildRecallV14PublicStateBeforeShodanLevel1 =
  buildRecallV14PublicState;


buildRecallV14PublicState =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId
  ) {
    const base =
      await buildRecallV14PublicStateBeforeShodanLevel1(
        env,
        visitorId
      );

    return {
      ...base,

      shodanLevel:
        RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL
    };
  };


// =========================================================
// SHODAN LEVEL 1 DISTORTION
//
// Level 1 deliberately makes the corruption visible while
// preserving the subtle-to-extreme variation already designed.
// =========================================================

applyRecallV14ShodanToggleToGenerated =
  async function (
    env,
    visitorId,
    state,
    generated,
    speakerKey
  ) {
    const enabled =
      await getRecallV14ShodanEnabled(
        env,
        visitorId
      );

    if (!enabled) {
      return generated;
    }

    const speaker =
      String(
        speakerKey || ""
      )
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();

    const hostIsSpeaking =
      speaker ===
        String(
          CHARACTER_HOST
        )
          .toLowerCase() ||
      speaker === "host";

    if (!hostIsSpeaking) {
      return generated;
    }

    const level =
      RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL;

    const candidateKeys = [
      "text",
      "content",
      "message",
      "dialogue"
    ];

    for (
      const key
      of candidateKeys
    ) {
      if (
        typeof generated?.[key] ===
          "string" &&
        generated[key].trim()
      ) {
        generated[key] =
          applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
            generated[key],
            {
              visitorId,

              turnNumber:
                state
                  ?.conversation
                  ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber ??
                0,

              /*
               * PERSONA LEVEL 1:
               * nudge the distortion upward one band so it
               * is visibly present without making every line
               * unreadable.
               */
              intensityBias:
                level
            }
          );

        generated.v14ShodanDistorted =
          true;

        generated.v14ShodanLevel =
          level;

        generated.v14PreserveSpeechText =
          true;

        break;
      }
    }

    return generated;
  };


// =========================================================
// MANDARIN BUTTON CLIENT PATCH
//
// Replacing the DOM node removes every previous language-button
// click listener. This avoids the older V14 handlers fighting
// each other.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_MANDARIN_BUTTON_FIX_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-mandarin-button-fix-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_MANDARIN_BUTTON_FIX_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_MANDARIN_BUTTON_FIX_INSTALLED =
    true;


  function getVisitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,

      localStorage.getItem(
        "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitor_id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recallVisitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recall_visitor_id"
      )
    ];

    for (
      const value
      of candidates
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  let activeLanguage =
    "en";

  let languageButton =
    null;


  function setButtonLabel() {
    if (!languageButton) {
      return;
    }

    /*
     * The label shows what clicking will switch TO.
     *
     * English mode -> MANDARIN
     * Mandarin mode -> ENGLISH
     */
    languageButton.textContent =
      activeLanguage ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "ENGLISH"
          : "MANDARIN";

    languageButton.dataset.language =
      activeLanguage;

    languageButton.disabled =
      false;
  }


  async function readLanguage() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      setButtonLabel();
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            visitorId
          ),
          {
            method:
              "GET",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store"
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        response.ok &&
        payload?.ok &&
        payload?.v14
      ) {
        activeLanguage =
          payload.v14.language ===
            "zh-TW"
              ? "zh-TW"
              : "en";

        window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
          {
            ...(window.RECALL_V14_STATE || {}),
            ...payload.v14
          };
      }
    } catch {
      /*
       * Keep current local language if the refresh fails.
       */
    }

    setButtonLabel();
  }


  async function toggleLanguage(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      !languageButton
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const nextLanguage =
      activeLanguage ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "en"
          : "zh-TW";

    languageButton.disabled =
      true;

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/language",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store",

            headers: {
              "content-type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId,
                language:
                  nextLanguage
              })
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        response.ok &&
        payload?.ok
      ) {
        activeLanguage =
          payload.language ===
            "zh-TW"
              ? "zh-TW"
              : nextLanguage;

        document.documentElement.lang =
          activeLanguage ===
            "zh-TW"
              ? "zh-Hant"
              : "en";

        window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
          {
            ...(window.RECALL_V14_STATE || {}),
            language:
              activeLanguage
          };

        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent(
            "recall-language-changed",
            {
              detail: {
                language:
                  activeLanguage
              }
            }
          )
        );

        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent(
            "recall-v14-server-state",
            {
              detail:
                window.RECALL_V14_STATE
            }
          )
        );
      }
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "MANDARIN toggle failed:",
        error
      );
    } finally {
      setButtonLabel();
    }
  }


  function replaceLanguageButton() {
    const oldButton =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-language"
      );

    if (!oldButton) {
      return false;
    }

    /*
     * Clone without listeners.
     */
    const cleanButton =
      oldButton.cloneNode(
        true
      );

    cleanButton.id =
      "recall-v14-language";

    cleanButton.type =
      "button";

    oldButton.replaceWith(
      cleanButton
    );

    languageButton =
      cleanButton;

    languageButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      toggleLanguage,
      true
    );

    setButtonLabel();

    return true;
  }


  function updateShodanLabel(
    state
  ) {
    const button =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-shodan"
      );

    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    const enabled =
      Boolean(
        state
          ?.shodanEnabled
      );

    const level =
      Number(
        state
          ?.shodanLevel ||
        1
      );

    button.textContent =
      enabled
        ? (
            "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
            Math.max(
              1,
              Math.floor(
                level
              )
            )
          )
        : "SHODAN: OFF";
  }


  window.addEventListener(
    "recall-v14-server-state",
    event => {
      if (
        event.detail
          ?.language
      ) {
        activeLanguage =
          event.detail.language ===
            "zh-TW"
              ? "zh-TW"
              : "en";

        setButtonLabel();
      }

      updateShodanLabel(
        event.detail
      );
    }
  );


  function boot() {
    if (
      !replaceLanguageButton()
    ) {
      /*
       * Controls may be injected a moment later.
       */
      window.setTimeout(
        boot,
        250
      );

      return;
    }

    readLanguage()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );

    if (
      window.RECALL_V14_STATE
    ) {
      updateShodanLabel(
        window.RECALL_V14_STATE
      );
    }
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      boot,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

// =========================================================
// LANGUAGE TOGGLE — SERVER AUTHORITATIVE
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14LanguageToggle(
  request,
  env
) {
  const parsed =
    await readRecallV13JsonBody(
      request.clone()
    );

  if (!parsed.ok) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid language toggle request."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      parsed.value
        ?.visitorId ??
      parsed.value
        ?.visitor_id
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  await initializeRecallV14Player(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const current =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT language

        FROM recall_v14_player

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  const currentLanguage =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      current?.language
    );

  const nextLanguage =
    currentLanguage ===
      RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
        ? RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_ENGLISH
        : RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE;

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_v14_player

      SET
        language = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      nextLanguage,
      isoNow(),
      visitorId
    )
    .run();

  const saved =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT language

        FROM recall_v14_player

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  const language =
    normalizeRecallV14Language(
      saved?.language
    );

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    language,

    buttonLabel:
      language ===
        RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TRADITIONAL_CHINESE
          ? "ENGLISH"
          : "MANDARIN"
  });
}


// =========================================================
// LANGUAGE TOGGLE ROUTE
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeLanguageToggleRepair =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/language-toggle"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14LanguageToggle(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeLanguageToggleRepair(
      request,
      env
    );
  };


routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// CLEAN LANGUAGE BUTTON CLIENT
//
// This runs AFTER every older client script.
// It replaces the button node, removing every previous click
// handler and every inherited data-* binding marker.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE_REPAIR_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-language-toggle-repair-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE_REPAIR_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_LANGUAGE_TOGGLE_REPAIR_INSTALLED =
    true;


  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,

      localStorage.getItem(
        "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitor_id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recallVisitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recall_visitor_id"
      )
    ];

    for (
      const value
      of candidates
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  let button =
    null;

  let language =
    "en";


  function label() {
    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    button.textContent =
      language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "ENGLISH"
          : "MANDARIN";

    button.disabled =
      false;
  }


  async function readState() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      label();
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            id
          ),
          {
            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store"
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        response.ok &&
        payload?.ok &&
        payload?.v14
      ) {
        language =
          payload.v14.language ===
            "zh-TW"
              ? "zh-TW"
              : "en";

        window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
          {
            ...(window.RECALL_V14_STATE || {}),
            ...payload.v14
          };
      }
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "Language state read failed:",
        error
      );
    }

    label();
  }


  async function click(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (
      !id ||
      !button
    ) {
      return;
    }

    button.disabled =
      true;

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/language-toggle",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store",

            headers: {
              "content-type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId:
                  id
              })
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        !payload?.ok
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          payload?.error ||
          "Language toggle failed."
        );
      }

      language =
        payload.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-TW"
            : "en";

      window.RECALL_V14_STATE =
        {
          ...(window.RECALL_V14_STATE || {}),
          language
        };

      document.documentElement.lang =
        language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-Hant"
            : "en";

      label();

      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent(
          "recall-language-changed",
          {
            detail: {
              language
            }
          }
        )
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "Language toggle failed:",
        error
      );

      label();
    }
  }


  function install() {
    const old =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-language"
      );

    if (!old) {
      window.setTimeout(
        install,
        200
      );

      return;
    }

    const clean =
      document.createElement(
        "button"
      );

    clean.id =
      "recall-v14-language";

    clean.className =
      old.className ||
      "recall-v14-button";

    clean.type =
      "button";

    clean.textContent =
      "MANDARIN";

    old.replaceWith(
      clean
    );

    button =
      clean;

    button.addEventListener(
      "click",
      click,
      true
    );

    readState()
      .catch(
        () => {}
      );

    /*
     * Older V14 timers may still try to rewrite this button.
     * Reassert only the label. They cannot restore their old
     * click handler because this is a new DOM node.
     */
    window.setInterval(
      label,
      1000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      install,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    install();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

// =========================================================
// END LANGUAGE TOGGLE + V13 TABLE REPAIR
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME — FINAL ISOLATED LANGUAGE + SHODAN CONTROLS
//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE END OF THE WORKER.
//
// PURPOSE:
// Older V14 scripts keep polling and rewriting the original
// #recall-v14-language and #recall-v14-shodan buttons.
// This patch removes those contested nodes and creates NEW,
// uniquely-named controls that no older timer knows about.
//
// FINAL LABEL RULE:
//   English mode              -> ENGLISH
//   Traditional Chinese mode  -> 繁體中文
//
// SHODAN:
//   OFF -> SHODAN: OFF
//   ON  -> SHODAN: ON — LV 1
//
// No polling loop is allowed to rewrite these final controls.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// FINAL SHODAN ATOMIC TOGGLE
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14FinalShodanToggle(
  request,
  env
) {
  const parsed =
    await readRecallV13JsonBody(
      request.clone()
    );

  if (!parsed.ok) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid SHODAN toggle request."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      parsed.value
        ?.visitorId ??
      parsed.value
        ?.visitor_id
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  await initializeRecallV14Player(
    env,
    visitorId
  );

  await ensureRecallV14ShodanColumn(
    env
  );

  const db =
    requireWorldDatabase(
      env
    );

  const current =
    await db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT shodan_enabled

        FROM recall_v14_player

        WHERE visitor_id = ?

        LIMIT 1
      `)
      .bind(
        visitorId
      )
      .first();

  const nextEnabled =
    integerNumber(
      current?.shodan_enabled,
      0
    ) !== 1;

  await db
    .prepare(`
      UPDATE recall_v14_player

      SET
        shodan_enabled = ?,
        updated_at = ?

      WHERE visitor_id = ?
    `)
    .bind(
      nextEnabled
        ? 1
        : 0,
      isoNow(),
      visitorId
    )
    .run();

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    shodanEnabled:
      nextEnabled,

    shodanLevel:
      RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL
  });
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL CONTROL STATE
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14FinalControlState(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    normalizeVisitorId(
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Missing or invalid visitorId."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const shodanEnabled =
    await getRecallV14ShodanEnabled(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    language:
      normalizeRecallV14Language(
        row.language
      ),

    shodanEnabled,

    shodanLevel:
      RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL
  });
}


// =========================================================
// FINAL CONTROL ROUTES
// =========================================================

const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeFinalControlIsolation =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/final-shodan-toggle"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14FinalShodanToggle(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/final-control-state"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14FinalControlState(
        request,
        env,
        url
      );
    }

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeFinalControlIsolation(
      request,
      env
    );
  };


routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// FINAL ISOLATED CLIENT
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_FINAL_ISOLATED_CONTROLS_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-final-isolated-controls-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_FINAL_ISOLATED_CONTROLS_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_FINAL_ISOLATED_CONTROLS_INSTALLED =
    true;


  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,

      localStorage.getItem(
        "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitor_id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recallVisitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recall_visitor_id"
      )
    ];

    for (
      const value
      of candidates
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  let language =
    "en";

  let shodanEnabled =
    false;

  let languageButton =
    null;

  let shodanButton =
    null;


  // =======================================================
  // REMOVE THE CONTESTED BUTTONS
  //
  // Older scripts can continue polling all they want.
  // Their IDs no longer exist.
  // =======================================================

  function createCleanControls() {
    const oldLanguage =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-language"
      );

    const oldShodan =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-shodan"
      );

    const row =
      oldLanguage
        ?.parentElement ||
      oldShodan
        ?.parentElement ||
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-machine"
      )
        ?.parentElement;

    if (!row) {
      return false;
    }

    if (oldLanguage) {
      oldLanguage.remove();
    }

    if (oldShodan) {
      oldShodan.remove();
    }

    languageButton =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-language-final"
      );

    if (!languageButton) {
      languageButton =
        document.createElement(
          "button"
        );

      languageButton.id =
        "recall-v14-language-final";

      languageButton.className =
        "recall-v14-button";

      languageButton.type =
        "button";

      row.appendChild(
        languageButton
      );
    }

    shodanButton =
      document.getElementById(
        "recall-v14-shodan-final"
      );

    if (!shodanButton) {
      shodanButton =
        document.createElement(
          "button"
        );

      shodanButton.id =
        "recall-v14-shodan-final";

      shodanButton.className =
        "recall-v14-button";

      shodanButton.type =
        "button";

      row.appendChild(
        shodanButton
      );
    }

    return true;
  }


  function render() {
    if (languageButton) {
      languageButton.textContent =
        language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "繁體中文"
            : "ENGLISH";

      languageButton.disabled =
        false;
    }

    if (shodanButton) {
      shodanButton.textContent =
        shodanEnabled
          ? "SHODAN: ON — LV 1"
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodanButton.disabled =
        false;
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // SERVER STATE — ONLY ON BOOT / AFTER A CLICK
  //
  // NO 1-SECOND OR 10-SECOND LABEL POLLING.
  // =======================================================

  async function readState() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      render();
      return;
    }

    const response =
      await fetch(
        "/v14/final-control-state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        ),
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store"
        }
      );

    const payload =
      await response.json();

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        "Final control state failed."
      );
    }

    language =
      payload.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        payload.shodanEnabled
      );

    render();
  }


  // =======================================================
  // LANGUAGE
  //
  // Uses the already-installed atomic /v14/language-toggle.
  // =======================================================

  async function toggleLanguage(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (
      !id ||
      !languageButton
    ) {
      return;
    }

    languageButton.disabled =
      true;

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/language-toggle",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store",

            headers: {
              "content-type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId:
                  id
              })
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        !payload?.ok
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          payload?.error ||
          "Language toggle failed."
        );
      }

      language =
        payload.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-TW"
            : "en";

      document.documentElement.lang =
        language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-Hant"
            : "en";

      render();

      console.log(
        "RECALL LANGUAGE:",
        language
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "RECALL LANGUAGE TOGGLE ERROR:",
        error
      );

      await readState()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    } finally {
      render();
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // SHODAN
  // =======================================================

  async function toggleShodan(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (
      !id ||
      !shodanButton
    ) {
      return;
    }

    shodanButton.disabled =
      true;

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          "/v14/final-shodan-toggle",
          {
            method:
              "POST",

            credentials:
              "same-origin",

            cache:
              "no-store",

            headers: {
              "content-type":
                "application/json"
            },

            body:
              JSON.stringify({
                visitorId:
                  id
              })
          }
        );

      const payload =
        await response.json();

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        !payload?.ok
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          payload?.error ||
          "SHODAN toggle failed."
        );
      }

      shodanEnabled =
        Boolean(
          payload.shodanEnabled
        );

      render();

      console.log(
        "RECALL SHODAN:",
        shodanEnabled
          ? "ON — LV 1"
          : "OFF"
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "RECALL SHODAN TOGGLE ERROR:",
        error
      );

      await readState()
        .catch(
          () => {}
        );
    } finally {
      render();
    }
  }


  function bind() {
    if (
      !createCleanControls()
    ) {
      window.setTimeout(
        bind,
        200
      );

      return;
    }

    languageButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      toggleLanguage,
      true
    );

    shodanButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      toggleShodan,
      true
    );

    render();

    readState()
      .catch(
        error => {
          console.error(
            "RECALL FINAL CONTROL STATE ERROR:",
            error
          );
        }
      );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;

  );
}

// =========================================================
// CLEAN V14 PANEL CLIENT
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-clean-panel-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_INSTALLED =
    true;

  let state = {
    language:
      "en",

    shodanEnabled:
      false,

    shodanLevel:
      1,

    machine:
      null,

    betting:
      null,

    playerGold:
      0
  };

  let busy =
    false;


  function visitorId() {
    const candidates = [
      localStorage.getItem(
        "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"
      ),

      window.visitorId,
      window.VISITOR_ID,
      window.recallVisitorId,
      window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID,

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "visitor_id"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recallVisitorId"
      ),

      localStorage.getItem(
        "recall_visitor_id"
      )
    ];

    for (
      const value
      of candidates
    ) {
      if (
        typeof value === "string" &&
        value.trim()
      ) {
        return value.trim();
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function el(
    id
  ) {
    return document.getElementById(
      id
    );
  }


  function numberText(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(
        number
      )
    ) {
      return "0";
    }

    return Math.max(
      0,
      Math.floor(
        number
      )
    )
      .toLocaleString();
  }


  function errorText(
    message = ""
  ) {
    const node =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-error"
      );

    if (node) {
      node.textContent =
        String(
          message || ""
        );
    }
  }


  async function requestJson(
    pathname,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        pathname,
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload = {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Invalid server response."
      };
    }

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        (
          "Request failed: " +
          response.status
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  function render() {
    const machineButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine"
      );

    const machineStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine-status"
      );

    const languageButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodanButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const betChoice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      );

    const betWager =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
      );

    const betButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet"
      );

    const betStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-status"
      );

    /*
     * LANGUAGE BUTTON SHOWS THE DESTINATION LANGUAGE.
     *
     * Current English:
     *   button says 繁體中文
     *
     * Current Traditional Chinese:
     *   button says ENGLISH
     */
    if (languageButton) {
      languageButton.textContent =
        state.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "ENGLISH"
            : "繁體中文";

      languageButton.disabled =
        busy;
    }

    if (shodanButton) {
      shodanButton.textContent =
        state.shodanEnabled
          ? (
              "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
              numberText(
                state.shodanLevel ||
                1
              )
            )
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodanButton.disabled =
        busy;
    }

    const machine =
      state.machine ||
      {};

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          state.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      machineButton &&
      machineStatus
    ) {
      if (
        machine.maxed
      ) {
        machineButton.textContent =
          "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

        machineButton.disabled =
          true;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "MACHINE LEVEL " +
          numberText(
            machine.level
          );
      } else {
        const price =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              machine.nextPrice ||
              0
            )
          );

        machineButton.textContent =
          "MACHINE LV " +
          numberText(
            machine.level
          ) +
          " → " +
          numberText(
            Number(
              machine.level ||
              0
            ) + 1
          ) +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            price
          ) +
          " GOLD";

        machineButton.disabled =
          busy ||
          gold < price;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          ) +
          " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
          numberText(
            price
          );
      }
    }

    const betting =
      state.betting ||
      {};

    const betState =
      String(
        betting.status ||
        "none"
      );

    const bettingOpen =
      Boolean(
        betting.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";

    if (betChoice) {
      betChoice.disabled =
        busy ||
        !bettingOpen;
    }

    if (betWager) {
      betWager.disabled =
        busy ||
        !bettingOpen;
    }

    if (betButton) {
      betButton.disabled =
        busy ||
        !bettingOpen;
    }

    if (betStatus) {
      if (
        betState ===
          "locked"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOCKED — " +
          String(
            betting.choice ||
            ""
          )
            .toUpperCase() +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "won"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET WON — " +
          numberText(
            betting.payout
          ) +
          " GOLD PAID";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "lost"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOST — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (
        bettingOpen
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          );
      } else {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING CLOSED";
      }
    }
  }


  async function refresh() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );
    }

    /*
     * V14 STATE:
     * machine, betting, gold, language
     */
    const v14 =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        ),
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    if (v14?.v14) {
      state = {
        ...state,
        ...v14.v14
      };
    }

    /*
     * FINAL CONTROL STATE:
     * authoritative language + SHODAN
     */
    const control =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/final-control-state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        ),
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    state.language =
      control.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    state.shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        control.shodanEnabled
      );

    state.shodanLevel =
      Math.max(
        1,
        Number(
          control.shodanLevel ||
          1
        )
      );

    window.RECALL_V14_CLEAN_STATE =
      {
        ...state
      };

    render();
  }


  async function runMutation(
    operation
  ) {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }

    busy =
      true;

    errorText(
      ""
    );

    render();

    try {
      await operation();

      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      errorText(
        error?.message ||
        error ||
        "Request failed."
      );

      console.error(
        "RECALL V14 CONTROL ERROR:",
        error
      );
    } finally {
      busy =
        false;

      render();
    }
  }


  async function toggleLanguage() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/language-toggle",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId:
                id
            })
        }
      );

    state.language =
      payload.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    document.documentElement.lang =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
  }


  async function toggleShodan() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/final-shodan-toggle",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId:
                id
            })
        }
      );

    state.shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        payload.shodanEnabled
      );

    state.shodanLevel =
      Math.max(
        1,
        Number(
          payload.shodanLevel ||
          1
        )
      );
  }


  async function upgradeMachine() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );
    }

    await requestJson(
      "/v14/machine/upgrade",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            visitorId:
              id
          })
      }
    );
  }


  async function placeBet() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );
    }

    const choice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      )
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          el(
            "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
          )
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Enter a GOLD wager."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await requestJson(
        "/v14/bet",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId:
                id,

              choice,

              wager
            })
        }
      );

    if (payload?.bet) {
      state.betting =
        payload.bet;
    }

    if (
      Number.isFinite(
        Number(
          payload?.remainingGold
        )
      )
    ) {
      state.playerGold =
        Number(
          payload.remainingGold
        );
    }
  }


  function exportChat() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      errorText(
        "Visitor ID not found."
      );

      return;
    }

    window.location.href =
      "/v14/export-chat?visitorId=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        id
      );
  }


  function bind() {
    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-language"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          runMutation(
            toggleLanguage
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          runMutation(
            toggleShodan
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-machine"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          runMutation(
            upgradeMachine
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-bet"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          runMutation(
            placeBet
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-export"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        exportChat
      );

    refresh()
      .catch(
        error => {
          errorText(
            error?.message ||
            error ||
            "State load failed."
          );

          console.error(
            "RECALL V14 STATE ERROR:",
            error
          );
        }
      );

    /*
     * STATE REFRESH ONLY.
     *
     * There are no competing scripts in this clean page.
     * Refreshing every 10 seconds is therefore safe and useful
     * for GOLD, MACHINE affordability and bet settlement.
     */
    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden &&
          !busy
        ) {
          refresh()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// CLEAN FINAL HTML ASSEMBLER
//
// CRITICAL:
// Start from the ORIGINAL HTML constant.
// DO NOT call any previous V14 installer.
// =========================================================

buildRecallV14FinalHtml =
  function ()
  {
    const source =
      String(
        HTML ||
        ""
      );

    const addition =
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_SCRIPT;

    if (
      source.includes(
        "</body>"
      )
    ) {
      return source.replace(
        "</body>",
        addition +
        "\n</body>"
      );
    }

    return (
      source +
      "\n" +
      addition
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// END CLEAN V14 CONTROL PANEL REPLACEMENT
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME — AUTHORITATIVE VISITOR CONTROL FIX
//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE VERY END OF THE WORKER.
//
// ROOT CAUSE:
// The television itself already has a canonical shared visitor
// identity. The V14 control panel was trying to rediscover and
// resend that identity independently.
//
// FIX:
// - server resolves the authoritative visitor ID from the
//   shared Loki's Kingdom cookie first;
// - body/query visitorId remains a fallback;
// - all clean V14 buttons use one /v14/control/* API;
// - final page is rebuilt from original HTML again so only
//   this one control script owns the panel.
//
// LANGUAGE BUTTON:
//   Current English -> 繁體中文
//   Current Chinese -> ENGLISH
//
// The label always means "switch TO this language".
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// AUTHORITATIVE VISITOR RESOLUTION
// =========================================================

function readRecallV14VisitorIdFromCookie(
  request
) {
  const raw =
    String(
      request.headers.get(
        "Cookie"
      ) ||
      ""
    );

  if (!raw) {
    return null;
  }

  const pairs =
    raw.split(
      ";"
    );

  for (
    const pair
    of pairs
  ) {
    const index =
      pair.indexOf(
        "="
      );

    if (
      index < 0
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    let key =
      pair
        .slice(
          0,
          index
        )
        .trim();

    let value =
      pair
        .slice(
          index + 1
        )
        .trim();

    try {
      key =
        decodeURIComponent(
          key
        );
    } catch {}

    if (
      key !==
        WORLD_VISITOR_ID_KEY
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      value =
        decodeURIComponent(
          value
        );
    } catch {}

    return normalizeVisitorId(
      value
    );
  }

  return null;
}


function resolveRecallV14AuthoritativeVisitorId(
  request,
  fallback = null
) {
  /*
   * Parent-domain shared cookie is authoritative.
   */
  const cookieVisitor =
    readRecallV14VisitorIdFromCookie(
      request
    );

  if (cookieVisitor) {
    return cookieVisitor;
  }

  return normalizeVisitorId(
    fallback
  );
}


// =========================================================
// CONTROL BODY READER
// =========================================================

async function readRecallV14ControlBody(
  request
) {
  if (
    request.method === "GET" ||
    request.method === "HEAD"
  ) {
    return {};
  }

  try {
    const body =
      await request
        .clone()
        .json();

    return (
      body &&
      typeof body === "object" &&
      !Array.isArray(
        body
      )
    )
      ? body
      : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}


// =========================================================
// SYNTHETIC REQUEST WITH AUTHORITATIVE VISITOR
// =========================================================

function makeRecallV14ControlRequest(
  request,
  body
) {
  return new Request(
    request.url,
    {
      method:
        "POST",

      headers: {
        "content-type":
          "application/json"
      },

      body:
        JSON.stringify(
          body
        )
    }
  );
}


// =========================================================
// UNIFIED CONTROL STATE
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14ControlState(
  request,
  env,
  url
) {
  const visitorId =
    resolveRecallV14AuthoritativeVisitorId(
      request,
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitorId"
      ) ||
      url.searchParams.get(
        "visitor_id"
      )
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Could not resolve the shared Loki's Kingdom visitor identity."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const stateUrl =
    new URL(
      request.url
    );

  stateUrl.searchParams.set(
    "visitorId",
    visitorId
  );

  const v14Response =
    await handleRecallV14State(
      request,
      env,
      stateUrl
    );

  let v14Payload =
    null;

  try {
    v14Payload =
      await v14Response
        .clone()
        .json();
  } catch {
    v14Payload =
      null;
  }

  const row =
    await initializeRecallV14Player(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  const shodanEnabled =
    await getRecallV14ShodanEnabled(
      env,
      visitorId
    );

  return jsonResponse({
    ok:
      true,

    visitorId,

    v14:
      v14Payload?.v14 ||
      v14Payload ||
      null,

    language:
      normalizeRecallV14Language(
        row.language
      ),

    shodanEnabled,

    shodanLevel:
      RECALL_V14_SHODAN_START_LEVEL
  });
}


// =========================================================
// UNIFIED LANGUAGE TOGGLE
// =========================================================

async function handleRecallV14ControlLanguage(
  request,
  env
) {
  const body =
    await readRecallV14ControlBody(
      request
    );

  const visitorId =
    resolveRecallV14AuthoritativeVisitorId(
      request,
      body
        ?.visitorId ??
      body
        ?.visitor_id
    );

  if (!visitorId) {
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        ok:
          false,

        error:
          "Could not resolve the shared Loki's Kingdom visitor identity."
      },
      400
    );
  }

  const synthetic =
    makeRecallV14ControlRequest(
      request,
      {
        visitorId
      }
    );

  return await handleRecallV14LanguageToggle(
    synthetic,
    env
  );
}

// =========================================================
// UNIFIED CONTROL ROUTES
