const routeRecallV13RequestBeforeAuthoritativeControlFix =
  routeRecallV13Request;


routeRecallV13Request =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const url =
      new URL(
        request.url
      );

    if (
      request.method === "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/state"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlState(
        request,
        env,
        url
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/language"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlLanguage(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/shodan"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlShodan(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/machine"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlMachine(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "POST" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/bet"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlBet(
        request,
        env
      );
    }

    if (
      request.method === "GET" &&
      url.pathname ===
        "/v14/control/export"
    ) {
      return await handleRecallV14ControlExport(
        request,
        env,
        url
      );
    }

    return await routeRecallV13RequestBeforeAuthoritativeControlFix(
      request,
      env
    );
  };


routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// AUTHORITATIVE CONTROL CLIENT
//
// Uses the clean panel HTML/CSS already defined by the previous
// patch, but none of its JavaScript.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_AUTHORITATIVE_CONTROL_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-authoritative-control-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_AUTHORITATIVE_CONTROL_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_AUTHORITATIVE_CONTROL_INSTALLED =
    true;

  let state = {
    language:
      "en",

    shodanEnabled:
      false,

    shodanLevel:
      1,

    machine:
      null,

    betting:
      null,

    playerGold:
      0
  };

  let busy =
    false;


  function el(
    id
  ) {
    return document.getElementById(
      id
    );
  }


  function numberText(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    return Number.isFinite(
      number
    )
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            number
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function showError(
    message = ""
  ) {
    const node =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-error"
      );

    if (node) {
      node.textContent =
        String(
          message ||
          ""
        );
    }
  }


  async function json(
    path,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        path,
        {
          credentials:
            "include",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload =
        null;
    }

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        (
          "Request failed: " +
          response.status
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  function render() {
    const language =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodan =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const machine =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine"
      );

    const machineStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine-status"
      );

    const betChoice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      );

    const betWager =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
      );

    const betButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet"
      );

    const betStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-status"
      );

    /*
     * THE BUTTON ALWAYS SHOWS THE DESTINATION.
     *
     * English is active:
     *   繁體中文
     *
     * Traditional Chinese is active:
     *   ENGLISH
     */
    if (language) {
      language.textContent =
        state.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "ENGLISH"
            : "繁體中文";

      language.disabled =
        busy;
    }

    if (shodan) {
      shodan.textContent =
        state.shodanEnabled
          ? (
              "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
              numberText(
                state.shodanLevel ||
                1
              )
            )
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodan.disabled =
        busy;
    }

    const machineState =
      state.machine ||
      {};

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          state.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      machine &&
      machineStatus
    ) {
      if (
        machineState.maxed
      ) {
        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

        machine.disabled =
          true;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "MACHINE LEVEL " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          );
      } else {
        const price =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              machineState.nextPrice ||
              0
            )
          );

        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE LV " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          ) +
          " → " +
          numberText(
            Number(
              machineState.level ||
              0
            ) + 1
          ) +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            price
          ) +
          " GOLD";

        machine.disabled =
          busy ||
          gold < price;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          ) +
          " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
          numberText(
            price
          );
      }
    }

    const betting =
      state.betting ||
      {};

    const betState =
      String(
        betting.status ||
        "none"
      );

    const open =
      Boolean(
        betting.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";

    if (betChoice) {
      betChoice.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }

    if (betWager) {
      betWager.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }

    if (betButton) {
      betButton.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }

    if (betStatus) {
      if (
        betState ===
          "locked"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOCKED — " +
          String(
            betting.choice ||
            ""
          )
            .toUpperCase() +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "won"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET WON — " +
          numberText(
            betting.payout
          ) +
          " GOLD PAID";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "lost"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOST — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (open) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          );
      } else {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING CLOSED";
      }
    }
  }


  async function refresh() {
    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/state",
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    const v14 =
      payload.v14 ||
      {};

    state = {
      ...state,
      ...v14,

      language:
        payload.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-TW"
            : "en",

      shodanEnabled:
        Boolean(
          payload.shodanEnabled
        ),

      shodanLevel:
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            payload.shodanLevel ||
            1
          )
        )
    };

    render();
  }


  async function mutate(
    operation
  ) {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }

    busy =
      true;

    showError(
      ""
    );

    render();

    try {
      await operation();

      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        error?.message ||
        error ||
        "Request failed."
      );

      console.error(
        "RECALL V14 CONTROL ERROR:",
        error
      );
    } finally {
      busy =
        false;

      render();
    }
  }


  async function language() {
    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/language",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            "{}"
        }
      );

    state.language =
      payload.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    document.documentElement.lang =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
  }


  async function shodan() {
    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/shodan",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            "{}"
        }
      );

    state.shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        payload.shodanEnabled
      );

    state.shodanLevel =
      Math.max(
        1,
        Number(
          payload.shodanLevel ||
          1
        )
      );
  }


  async function machine() {
    await json(
      "/v14/control/machine",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          "{}"
      }
    );
  }


  async function bet() {
    const choice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      )
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          el(
            "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
          )
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Enter a GOLD wager."
      );
    }

    await json(
      "/v14/control/bet",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            choice,
            wager
          })
      }
    );
  }


  function exportChat() {
    window.location.href =
      "/v14/control/export";
  }


  function bind() {
    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-language"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            language
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            shodan
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-machine"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            machine
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-bet"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            bet
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-export"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        exportChat
      );

    refresh()
      .catch(
        error => {
          showError(
            error?.message ||
            error ||
            "State load failed."
          );
        }
      );

    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden &&
          !busy
        ) {
          refresh()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// ABSOLUTE FINAL PAGE ASSEMBLER
//
// Original HTML + clean panel CSS + clean panel HTML +
// authoritative script.
//
// NO previous V14 client scripts are injected.
// =========================================================

buildRecallV14FinalHtml =
  function ()
  {
    const source =
      String(
        HTML ||
        ""
      );

    const addition =
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_AUTHORITATIVE_CONTROL_SCRIPT;

    if (
      source.includes(
        "</body>"
      )
    ) {
      return source.replace(
        "</body>",
        addition +
        "\n</body>"
      );
    }

    return (
      source +
      "\n" +
      addition
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// END AUTHORITATIVE VISITOR CONTROL FIX
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME — FINAL VISITOR-ID BRIDGE FIX
//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE VERY END OF THE WORKER.
//
// The main TV already creates the correct visitor ID here:
//
//   let visitorId = getOrCreateVisitorId();
//
// and mirrors it to:
//
//   localStorage["lokis-kingdom-visitor-id"]
//
// The previous control patch stopped sending that ID and relied
// on the cookie alone. This patch sends the exact stored visitor
// ID with EVERY control request.
//
// NO COOKIE GUESSING.
// NO NEW VISITOR.
// SAME ID AS THE TELEVISION.
// =========================================================


const RECALL_V14_FINAL_VISITOR_BRIDGE_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-final-visitor-bridge-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_FINAL_VISITOR_BRIDGE_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_FINAL_VISITOR_BRIDGE_INSTALLED =
    true;

  const VISITOR_KEY =
    "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id";

  let state = {
    language:
      "en",

    shodanEnabled:
      false,

    shodanLevel:
      1,

    machine:
      null,

    betting:
      null,

    playerGold:
      0
  };

  let busy =
    false;


  function getVisitorId() {
    let value =
      null;

    try {
      value =
        localStorage.getItem(
          VISITOR_KEY
        );
    } catch {}

    value =
      String(
        value ||
        ""
      )
        .trim();

    if (
      /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}$/
        .test(
          value
        )
    ) {
      return value;
    }

    /*
     * Fallback: read the exact shared cookie used by the TV.
     */
    const prefix =
      encodeURIComponent(
        VISITOR_KEY
      ) +
      "=";

    const cookieParts =
      String(
        document.cookie ||
        ""
      )
        .split(
          ";"
        );

    for (
      const rawPart
      of cookieParts
    ) {
      const part =
        rawPart.trim();

      if (
        !part.startsWith(
          prefix
        )
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      let candidate =
        part.slice(
          prefix.length
        );

      try {
        candidate =
          decodeURIComponent(
            candidate
          );
      } catch {}

      if (
        /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}$/
          .test(
            candidate
          )
      ) {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(
            VISITOR_KEY,
            candidate
          );
        } catch {}

        return candidate;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function el(
    id
  ) {
    return document.getElementById(
      id
    );
  }


  function numberText(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    return Number.isFinite(
      number
    )
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            number
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function showError(
    message = ""
  ) {
    const node =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-error"
      );

    if (node) {
      node.textContent =
        String(
          message ||
          ""
        );
    }
  }


  async function json(
    path,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        path,
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload =
        null;
    }

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        (
          "Request failed: " +
          response.status
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  function render() {
    const language =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodan =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const machine =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine"
      );

    const machineStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine-status"
      );

    const betChoice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      );

    const betWager =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
      );

    const betButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet"
      );

    const betStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-status"
      );


    /*
     * BUTTON SHOWS THE DESTINATION LANGUAGE.
     *
     * Current English:
     *   繁體中文
     *
     * Current Traditional Chinese:
     *   ENGLISH
     */
    if (language) {
      language.textContent =
        state.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "ENGLISH"
            : "繁體中文";

      language.disabled =
        busy;
    }


    if (shodan) {
      shodan.textContent =
        state.shodanEnabled
          ? (
              "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
              numberText(
                state.shodanLevel ||
                1
              )
            )
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodan.disabled =
        busy;
    }


    const machineState =
      state.machine ||
      {};

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          state.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );


    if (
      machine &&
      machineStatus
    ) {
      if (
        machineState.maxed
      ) {
        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

        machine.disabled =
          true;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "MACHINE LEVEL " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          );
      } else {
        const price =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              machineState.nextPrice ||
              0
            )
          );

        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE LV " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          ) +
          " → " +
          numberText(
            Number(
              machineState.level ||
              0
            ) + 1
          ) +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            price
          ) +
          " GOLD";

        machine.disabled =
          busy ||
          gold < price;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          ) +
          " · NEXT UPGRADE " +

            price
          );
      }
    }


    const betting =

    const betState =

        betting.status ||

      );

    const open =

    if (betChoice) {

  async function refresh() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      throw new Error(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          visitorId
        ),
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    const v14 =
      payload.v14 ||
      {};

    state = {
      ...state,
      ...v14,

      language:
        payload.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-TW"
            : "en",

      shodanEnabled:
        Boolean(
          payload.shodanEnabled
        ),

      shodanLevel:
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            payload.shodanLevel ||
            1
          )
        )
    };

    showError(
      ""
    );

    render();
  }


  async function mutate(
    operation
  ) {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }

    busy =
      true;

    showError(
      ""
    );

    render();

    try {
      await operation();

      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        error?.message ||
        error ||
        "Request failed."
      );

      console.error(
        "RECALL V14 CONTROL ERROR:",
        error
      );
    } finally {
      busy =
        false;

      render();
    }
  }


  async function toggleLanguage() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      throw new Error(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/language",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId
            })
        }
      );

    state.language =
      payload.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    document.documentElement.lang =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
  }


  async function toggleShodan() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      throw new Error(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/shodan",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId
            })
        }
      );

    state.shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        payload.shodanEnabled
      );

    state.shodanLevel =
      Math.max(
        1,
        Number(
          payload.shodanLevel ||
          1
        )
      );
  }


  async function upgradeMachine() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      throw new Error(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );
    }

    await json(
      "/v14/control/machine",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            visitorId
          })
      }
    );
  }


  async function placeBet() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      throw new Error(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );
    }

    const choice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      )
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          el(
            "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
          )
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Enter a GOLD wager."
      );
    }

    await json(
      "/v14/control/bet",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            visitorId,
            choice,
            wager
          })
      }
    );
  }


  function exportChat() {
    const visitorId =
      getVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      showError(
        "TV visitor ID is not available."
      );

      return;
    }

    window.location.href =
      "/v14/control/export?visitorId=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        visitorId
      );
  }


  function bind() {
    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-language"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            toggleLanguage
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            toggleShodan
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-machine"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            upgradeMachine
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-bet"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            placeBet
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-export"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        exportChat
      );

    /*
     * The original TV creates visitorId during its own client
     * boot. Give it one event loop before first V14 state read.
     */
    window.setTimeout(
      () => {
        refresh()
          .catch(
            error => {
              showError(
                error?.message ||
                error ||
                "State load failed."
              );
            }
          );
      },
      250
    );

    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden &&
          !busy
        ) {
          refresh()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// ABSOLUTE FINAL HTML ASSEMBLER
//
// Start from original TV HTML.
// Inject ONE control panel and ONE control script.
// =========================================================

buildRecallV14FinalHtml =
  function ()
  {
    const source =
      String(
        HTML ||
        ""
      );

    const addition =
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_FINAL_VISITOR_BRIDGE_SCRIPT;

    if (
      source.includes(
        "</body>"
      )
    ) {
      return source.replace(
        "</body>",
        addition +
        "\n</body>"
      );
    }

    return (
      source +
      "\n" +
      addition
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// END FINAL VISITOR-ID BRIDGE FIX
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME — PREBOOT VISITOR ID RESCUE
//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE VERY END OF THE WORKER.
//
// ROOT FIX:
// The original TV's getOrCreateVisitorId() gives the shared
// parent-domain cookie priority over localStorage.
//
// That is normally useful, but if an older/stale cookie points
// at a different visitor, the established Recall run can be
// replaced as soon as the page boots.
//
// THIS PATCH RUNS BEFORE THE ORIGINAL TV SCRIPT.
//
// RULE:
// - if Recall already has a valid localStorage visitor ID,
//   preserve it;
// - synchronize the parent-domain cookie TO that same ID;
// - if localStorage has no valid ID, leave the shared cookie
//   alone and let the original TV create/adopt identity normally.
//
// This is intentionally synchronous so the identity is repaired
// BEFORE the original getOrCreateVisitorId() executes.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// PREBOOT SCRIPT
// =========================================================

const RECALL_VISITOR_PREBOOT_RESCUE_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-visitor-preboot-rescue">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const KEY =
    "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id";

  const VALID =
    /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}$/;


  function readLocal() {
    try {
      const value =
        String(
          localStorage.getItem(
            KEY
          ) ||
          ""
        )
          .trim();

      return VALID.test(
        value
      )
        ? value
        : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }


  function readCookie() {
    const prefix =
      encodeURIComponent(
        KEY
      ) +
      "=";

    const parts =
      String(
        document.cookie ||
        ""
      )
        .split(
          ";"
        );

    for (
      const rawPart
      of parts
    ) {
      const part =
        rawPart.trim();

      if (
        !part.startsWith(
          prefix
        )
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      let value =
        part.slice(
          prefix.length
        );

      try {
        value =
          decodeURIComponent(
            value
          );
      } catch {}

      value =
        String(
          value ||
          ""
        )
          .trim();

      if (
        VALID.test(
          value
        )
      ) {
        return value;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }


  function writeSharedCookie(
    value
  ) {
    document.cookie =
      encodeURIComponent(
        KEY
      ) +
      "=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        value
      ) +
      "; Max-Age=315360000" +
      "; Path=/" +
      "; Domain=lokiskingdom.com" +
      "; SameSite=Lax" +
      "; Secure";
  }


  const localId =
    readLocal();

  const cookieId =
    readCookie();


  /*
   * PRESERVE THE ESTABLISHED RECALL RUN.
   *
   * If this browser already has a valid Recall identity,
   * make the shared cookie agree with it before the TV boots.
   */
  if (localId) {
    if (
      cookieId !==
        localId
    ) {
      writeSharedCookie(
        localId
      );
    }

    window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID_PREBOOT =
      localId;

    window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID_RESCUED =
      Boolean(
        cookieId &&
        cookieId !==
          localId
      );

    return;
  }


  /*
   * No local Recall identity exists.
   * Preserve normal shared-cookie behavior.
   */
  if (cookieId) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        KEY,
        cookieId
      );
    } catch {}

    window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID_PREBOOT =
      cookieId;

    window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID_RESCUED =
      false;
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// FINAL CONTROL CLIENT — USE THE PREBOOT ID FIRST
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V14_POST_RESCUE_CONTROL_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v14-post-rescue-control-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V14_POST_RESCUE_CONTROL_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V14_POST_RESCUE_CONTROL_INSTALLED =
    true;

  const KEY =
    "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id";

  const VALID =
    /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,200}$/;

  let state = {
    language:
      "en",

    shodanEnabled:
      false,

    shodanLevel:
      1,

    machine:
      null,

    betting:
      null,

    playerGold:
      0
  };

  let busy =
    false;


  function visitorId() {
    const preboot =
      String(
        window.RECALL_VISITOR_ID_PREBOOT ||
        ""
      )
        .trim();

    if (
      VALID.test(
        preboot
      )
    ) {
      return preboot;
    }

    try {
      const local =
        String(
          localStorage.getItem(
            KEY
          ) ||
          ""
        )
          .trim();

      if (
        VALID.test(
          local
        )
      ) {
        return local;
      }
    } catch {}

    return null;
  }


  function el(
    id
  ) {
    return document.getElementById(
      id
    );
  }


  function numberText(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    return Number.isFinite(
      number
    )
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            number
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function showError(
    message = ""
  ) {
    const node =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-error"
      );

    if (node) {
      node.textContent =
        String(
          message ||
          ""
        );
    }
  }


  async function json(
    path,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await fetch(
        path,
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload =
        null;
    }

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        (
          "Request failed: " +
          response.status
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  function render() {
    const language =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodan =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const machine =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine"
      );

    const machineStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine-status"
      );

    const betChoice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      );

    const betWager =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
      );

    const betButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet"
      );

    const betStatus =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-status"
      );


    /*
     * BUTTON SHOWS WHAT YOU SWITCH TO.
     *
     * Current English -> 繁體中文
     * Current Chinese -> ENGLISH
     */
    if (language) {
      language.textContent =
        state.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "ENGLISH"
            : "繁體中文";

      language.disabled =
        busy;
    }


    if (shodan) {
      shodan.textContent =
        state.shodanEnabled
          ? (
              "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
              numberText(
                state.shodanLevel ||
                1
              )
            )
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodan.disabled =
        busy;
    }


    const machineState =
      state.machine ||
      {};

    const gold =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Number(
          state.playerGold ||
          0
        )
      );


    if (
      machine &&
      machineStatus
    ) {
      if (
        machineState.maxed
      ) {
        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

        machine.disabled =
          true;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "MACHINE LEVEL " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          );
      } else {
        const price =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              machineState.nextPrice ||
              0
            )
          );

        machine.textContent =
          "MACHINE LV " +
          numberText(
            machineState.level
          ) +
          " → " +
          numberText(
            Number(
              machineState.level ||
              0
            ) + 1
          ) +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            price
          ) +
          " GOLD";

        machine.disabled =
          busy ||
          gold < price;

        machineStatus.textContent =
          "GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          ) +
          " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
          numberText(
            price
          );
      }
    }


    const betting =
      state.betting ||
      {};

    const betState =
      String(
        betting.status ||
        "none"
      );

    const open =
      Boolean(
        betting.windowOpen
      ) &&
      betState === "none";


    if (betChoice) {
      betChoice.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }

    if (betWager) {
      betWager.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }

    if (betButton) {
      betButton.disabled =
        busy ||
        !open;
    }


    if (betStatus) {
      if (
        betState ===
          "locked"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOCKED — " +
          String(
            betting.choice ||
            ""
          )
            .toUpperCase() +
          " — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "won"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET WON — " +
          numberText(
            betting.payout
          ) +
          " GOLD PAID";
      } else if (
        betState ===
          "lost"
      ) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BET LOST — " +
          numberText(
            betting.wager
          ) +
          " GOLD";
      } else if (open) {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
          numberText(
            gold
          );
      } else {
        betStatus.textContent =
          "BETTING CLOSED";
      }
    }
  }


  async function refresh() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/state?visitorId=" +
        encodeURIComponent(
          id
        ),
        {
          method:
            "GET",

          headers:
            {}
        }
      );

    const v14 =
      payload.v14 ||
      {};

    state = {
      ...state,
      ...v14,

      language:
        payload.language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "zh-TW"
            : "en",

      shodanEnabled:
        Boolean(
          payload.shodanEnabled
        ),

      shodanLevel:
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            payload.shodanLevel ||
            1
          )
        )
    };

    showError(
      ""
    );

    render();
  }


  async function mutate(
    operation
  ) {
    if (busy) {
      return;
    }

    busy =
      true;

    showError(
      ""
    );

    render();

    try {
      await operation();

      await refresh();
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        error?.message ||
        error ||
        "Request failed."
      );

      console.error(
        "RECALL V14 CONTROL ERROR:",
        error
      );
    } finally {
      busy =
        false;

      render();
    }
  }


  async function toggleLanguage() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/language",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId:
                id
            })
        }
      );

    state.language =
      payload.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-TW"
          : "en";

    document.documentElement.lang =
      state.language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
  }


  async function toggleShodan() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );
    }

    const payload =
      await json(
        "/v14/control/shodan",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId:
                id
            })
        }
      );

    state.shodanEnabled =
      Boolean(
        payload.shodanEnabled
      );

    state.shodanLevel =
      Math.max(
        1,
        Number(
          payload.shodanLevel ||
          1
        )
      );
  }


  async function upgradeMachine() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );
    }

    await json(
      "/v14/control/machine",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            visitorId:
              id
          })
      }
    );
  }


  async function placeBet() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      throw new Error(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );
    }

    const choice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      )
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          el(
            "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
          )
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Enter a GOLD wager."
      );
    }

    await json(
      "/v14/control/bet",
      {
        method:
          "POST",

        body:
          JSON.stringify({
            visitorId:
              id,

            choice,

            wager
          })
      }
    );
  }


  function exportChat() {
    const id =
      visitorId();

    if (!id) {
      showError(
        "Recall visitor identity is unavailable."
      );

      return;
    }

    window.location.href =
      "/v14/control/export?visitorId=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        id
      );
  }


  function bind() {
    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-language"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            toggleLanguage
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            toggleShodan
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-machine"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            upgradeMachine
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-bet"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          mutate(
            placeBet
          );
        }
      );

    el(
      "recall-v14-clean-export"
    )
      ?.addEventListener(
        "click",
        exportChat
      );

    window.setTimeout(
      () => {
        refresh()
          .catch(
            error => {
              showError(
                error?.message ||
                error ||
                "State load failed."
              );
            }
          );
      },
      250
    );

    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden &&
          !busy
        ) {
          refresh()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      bind,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    bind();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// FINAL PAGE ASSEMBLER
//
// 1. Start from ORIGINAL TV HTML.
// 2. Inject visitor rescue BEFORE the ORIGINAL TV <script>.
// 3. Inject exactly ONE clean V14 panel and ONE V14 script.
// =========================================================

buildRecallV14FinalHtml =
  function ()
  {
    let source =
      String(
        HTML ||
        ""
      );

    /*
     * PREBOOT RESCUE MUST EXECUTE BEFORE THE ORIGINAL TV SCRIPT.
     */
    const originalScriptMarker =
      "<script>";

    const markerIndex =
      source.indexOf(
        originalScriptMarker
      );

    if (
      markerIndex >=
        0
    ) {
      source =
        source.slice(
          0,
          markerIndex
        ) +
        RECALL_VISITOR_PREBOOT_RESCUE_SCRIPT +
        "\n" +
        source.slice(
          markerIndex
        );
    }


    const addition =
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_POST_RESCUE_CONTROL_SCRIPT;


    if (
      source.includes(
        "</body>"
      )
    ) {
      return source.replace(
        "</body>",
        addition +
        "\n</body>"
      );
    }


    return (
      source +
      "\n" +
      addition
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// END PREBOOT VISITOR ID RESCUE
// =========================================================
// =========================================================
// RECALL THY NAME — LOCAL MANDARIN + LOCAL SHODAN FINAL OVERRIDE
//
// APPEND THIS ENTIRE BLOCK TO THE ABSOLUTE END OF V21.
//
// PURPOSE:
// - MANDARIN / TRADITIONAL CHINESE does NOT use visitorId.
// - SHODAN does NOT use visitorId.
// - Both are browser-local switches stored in localStorage.
// - The existing television continues using its own visitorId
//   exactly as it already does for game state.
// - MACHINE / BET / EXPORT remain game/economy features and
//   therefore continue using the existing game identity.
//
// LANGUAGE BUTTON:
//   current English             -> button says 繁體中文
//   current Traditional Chinese -> button says ENGLISH
//
// SHODAN:
//   OFF -> SHODAN: OFF
//   ON  -> SHODAN: ON — LV 1
//
// No V14 language/shodan state endpoint is consulted.
// No V14 language/shodan visitorId is created or required.
// =========================================================


// =========================================================
// LOCAL CONTROL NORMALIZATION
// =========================================================

function normalizeRecallLocalLanguage(
  value
) {
  return String(
    value || ""
  ) === "zh-TW"
    ? "zh-TW"
    : "en";
}


function normalizeRecallLocalShodanEnabled(
  value
) {
  return (
    value === true ||
    value === 1 ||
    value === "1" ||
    value === "true"
  );
}


function normalizeRecallLocalShodanLevel(
  value
) {
  return Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(
      10,
      integerNumber(
        value,
        1
      )
    )
  );
}


// =========================================================
// TRADITIONAL CHINESE PRESENTATION TRANSLATION
//
// This is intentionally presentation-layer translation.
//
// The canonical conversation/memory remains in the original
// generated language. The browser receives the Traditional
// Chinese presentation text when the local switch is ON.
//
// That means changing language does NOT fork player identity,
// create another D1 player row, or rewrite persistent memory.
// =========================================================

async function translateRecallDialogueToTraditionalChineseLocal(
  env,
  text
) {
  const source =
    String(
      text || ""
    )
      .trim();

  if (!source) {
    return source;
  }

  try {
    const translated =
      await callRecallModel(
        env,
        {
          instructions:
            [
              "Translate the supplied television dialogue into idiomatic Traditional Chinese (zh-TW).",
              "Return ONLY the translated dialogue.",
              "Do not explain the translation.",
              "Do not summarize, censor, soften, expand, or editorialize.",
              "Preserve names, titles, deliberate quotations, invented words, numbers, punctuation, emotional force, jokes, insults, profanity, rhythm, and speaker personality as closely as possible.",
              "The result is dialogue for the same fictional television character, not an assistant response."
            ]
              .join(
                "\n"
              ),

          input:
            source,

          webSearchEnabled:
            false,

          maxOutputTokens:
            RECALL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
        }
      );

    return String(
      translated || source
    )
      .trim() ||
      source;
  } catch (
    error
  ) {
    console.error(
      "Local Traditional Chinese translation failed:",
      error
    );

    /*
     * Never break the show merely because translation failed.
     */
    return source;
  }
}


// =========================================================
// LOCAL PRESENTATION TRANSFORM
// =========================================================

async function applyRecallLocalPresentationToPayload(
  env,
  payload,
  {
    language =
      "en",

    shodanEnabled =
      false,

    shodanLevel =
      1
  } = {}
) {
  if (
    !payload ||
    typeof payload !==
      "object"
  ) {
    return payload;
  }

  if (
    payload.ok ===
      false
  ) {
    return payload;
  }

  const sourceText =
    typeof payload.text ===
      "string"
        ? payload.text
        : "";

  if (!sourceText.trim()) {
    return payload;
  }

  let text =
    sourceText;

  const normalizedLanguage =
    normalizeRecallLocalLanguage(
      language
    );

  const normalizedShodanEnabled =
    normalizeRecallLocalShodanEnabled(
      shodanEnabled
    );

  const normalizedShodanLevel =
    normalizeRecallLocalShodanLevel(
      shodanLevel
    );


  /*
   * TRANSLATE FIRST.
   *
   * Then SHODAN corrupts the exact string that will be shown
   * and spoken.
   */
  if (
    normalizedLanguage ===
      "zh-TW"
  ) {
    text =
      await translateRecallDialogueToTraditionalChineseLocal(
        env,
        text
      );
  }


  /*
   * SHODAN applies only to the television HOST, not Nameless.
   */
  const speaker =
    String(
      payload.speaker ||
      payload.speakerKey ||
      ""
    )
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const hostIsSpeaking =
    speaker ===
      String(
        CHARACTER_HOST
      )
        .toLowerCase() ||
    speaker ===
      "host";


  if (
    normalizedShodanEnabled &&
    hostIsSpeaking
  ) {
    text =
      applyRecallV14ShodanDistortion(
        text,
        {
          /*
           * No visitor identity participates in local SHODAN.
           */
          visitorId:
            "local-shodan",

          turnNumber:
            integerNumber(
              payload
                ?.publicState
                ?.conversation
                ?.currentEpisodeTurnNumber,
              0
            ),

          intensityBias:
            normalizedShodanLevel
        }
      );
  }


  return {
    ...payload,

    text,

    localPresentation: {
      language:
        normalizedLanguage,

      shodanEnabled:
        normalizedShodanEnabled,

      shodanLevel:
        normalizedShodanLevel
    },

    /*
     * TTS must use the same visible string.
     */
    v14PreserveSpeechText:
      true,

    v14ShodanDistorted:
      normalizedShodanEnabled &&
      hostIsSpeaking
  };
}


// =========================================================
// READ LOCAL SETTINGS FROM THE EXISTING SHOW REQUEST
//
// IMPORTANT:
// visitorId is still present for the GAME because Recall itself
// uses it. These three presentation fields are independent of it.
// =========================================================

async function readRecallLocalPresentationFromRequest(
  request
) {
  try {
    const body =
      await request
        .clone()
        .json();

    return {
      language:
        normalizeRecallLocalLanguage(
          body
            ?.localLanguage
        ),

      shodanEnabled:
        normalizeRecallLocalShodanEnabled(
          body
            ?.localShodanEnabled
        ),

      shodanLevel:
        normalizeRecallLocalShodanLevel(
          body
            ?.localShodanLevel
        )
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      language:
        "en",

      shodanEnabled:
        false,

      shodanLevel:
        1
    };
  }
}


// =========================================================
// RESPONSE TRANSFORM
// =========================================================

async function transformRecallLocalShowResponse(
  response,
  env,
  localPresentation
) {
  if (
    !response ||
    !(response instanceof Response)
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  const contentType =
    String(
      response.headers.get(
        "content-type"
      ) ||
      ""
    )
      .toLowerCase();

  if (
    !contentType.includes(
      "application/json"
    )
  ) {
    return response;
  }

  let payload;

  try {
    payload =
      await response
        .clone()
        .json();
  } catch {
    return response;
  }

  const transformed =
    await applyRecallLocalPresentationToPayload(
      env,
      payload,
      localPresentation
    );

  const headers =
    new Headers(
      response.headers
    );

  headers.delete(
    "content-length"
  );

  headers.set(
    "content-type",
    "application/json; charset=UTF-8"
  );

  return new Response(
    JSON.stringify(
      transformed
    ),
    {
      status:
        response.status,

      statusText:
        response.statusText,

      headers
    }
  );
}


// =========================================================
// AUTONOMOUS TURN WRAPPER
//
// No change to the working game visitorId.
// We merely read localLanguage/localShodan* from the same request
// and transform the returned presentation text.
// =========================================================

const handleNextShowTurnBeforeLocalPresentationV22 =
  handleNextShowTurn;


handleNextShowTurn =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const localPresentation =
      await readRecallLocalPresentationFromRequest(
        request
      );

    const response =
      await handleNextShowTurnBeforeLocalPresentationV22(
        request,
        env
      );

    return await transformRecallLocalShowResponse(
      response,
      env,
      localPresentation
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// AUDIENCE INTERRUPTION WRAPPER
// =========================================================

const handleAudienceInterjectionBeforeLocalPresentationV22 =
  handleAudienceInterjection;


handleAudienceInterjection =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const localPresentation =
      await readRecallLocalPresentationFromRequest(
        request
      );

    const response =
      await handleAudienceInterjectionBeforeLocalPresentationV22(
        request,
        env
      );

    return await transformRecallLocalShowResponse(
      response,
      env,
      localPresentation
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// LOCAL-ONLY CLIENT
//
// This is the ONLY script injected for the final V14 panel.
//
// It does NOT call:
// - /v14/language
// - /v14/language-toggle
// - /v14/final-control-state
// - /v14/shodan
// - /v14/final-shodan-toggle
//
// Mandarin and SHODAN never ask the server who the player is.
// =========================================================

const RECALL_V22_LOCAL_PRESENTATION_SCRIPT = `
<script id="recall-v22-local-presentation-script">
(() => {
  "use strict";

  if (
    window.RECALL_V22_LOCAL_PRESENTATION_INSTALLED
  ) {
    return;
  }

  window.RECALL_V22_LOCAL_PRESENTATION_INSTALLED =
    true;


  const LANGUAGE_KEY =
    "recall-local-language-v22";

  const SHODAN_KEY =
    "recall-local-shodan-v22";

  const SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY =
    "recall-local-shodan-level-v22";

  const GAME_VISITOR_KEY =
    "lokis-kingdom-visitor-id";


  function readLocal(
    key,
    fallback
  ) {
    try {
      const value =
        localStorage.getItem(
          key
        );

      return value ===
        null
          ? fallback
          : value;
    } catch {
      return fallback;
    }
  }


  function writeLocal(
    key,
    value
  ) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        key,
        String(
          value
        )
      );
    } catch {}
  }


  function currentLanguage() {
    return readLocal(
      LANGUAGE_KEY,
      "en"
    ) === "zh-TW"
      ? "zh-TW"
      : "en";
  }


  function currentShodanEnabled() {
    return readLocal(
      SHODAN_KEY,
      "0"
    ) === "1";
  }


  function currentShodanLevel() {
    const value =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          readLocal(
            SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY,
            "1"
          )
        )
      );

    return Math.max(
      1,
      Math.min(
        10,
        Number.isFinite(
          value
        )
          ? value
          : 1
      )
    );
  }


  function gameVisitorId() {
    /*
     * ONLY economy/game controls use this.
     * Mandarin and SHODAN never call this function.
     */
    try {
      const value =
        String(
          localStorage.getItem(
            GAME_VISITOR_KEY
          ) ||
          ""
        )
          .trim();

      return value ||
        null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }


  function el(
    id
  ) {
    return document.getElementById(
      id
    );
  }


  function numberText(
    value
  ) {
    const number =
      Number(
        value
      );

    return Number.isFinite(
      number
    )
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          Math.floor(
            number
          )
        )
          .toLocaleString()
      : "0";
  }


  function showError(
    message = ""
  ) {
    const node =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-error"
      );

    if (node) {
      node.textContent =
        String(
          message ||
          ""
        );
    }
  }


  // =======================================================
  // LANGUAGE + SHODAN RENDER
  // =======================================================

  function renderLocalControls() {
    const languageButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodanButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const language =
      currentLanguage();

    const shodanEnabled =
      currentShodanEnabled();

    const shodanLevel =
      currentShodanLevel();


    /*
     * BUTTON SHOWS THE LANGUAGE YOU WILL SWITCH TO.
     *
     * Current English:
     *   繁體中文
     *
     * Current Traditional Chinese:
     *   ENGLISH
     */
    if (languageButton) {
      languageButton.textContent =
        language ===
          "zh-TW"
            ? "ENGLISH"
            : "繁體中文";

      languageButton.disabled =
        false;
    }


    if (shodanButton) {
      shodanButton.textContent =
        shodanEnabled
          ? (
              "SHODAN: ON — LV " +
              String(
                shodanLevel
              )
            )
          : "SHODAN: OFF";

      shodanButton.disabled =
        false;
    }


    document.documentElement.lang =
      language ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "zh-Hant"
          : "en";
  }


  function toggleLanguage(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const next =
      currentLanguage() ===
        "zh-TW"
          ? "en"
          : "zh-TW";

    writeLocal(
      LANGUAGE_KEY,
      next
    );

    renderLocalControls();

    console.log(
      "RECALL LOCAL LANGUAGE:",
      next
    );
  }


  function toggleShodan(
    event
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    const next =
      currentShodanEnabled()
        ? "0"
        : "1";

    writeLocal(
      SHODAN_KEY,
      next
    );

    /*
     * SHODAN begins at level 1.
     */
    if (
      !readLocal(
        SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY,
        ""
      )
    ) {
      writeLocal(
        SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY,
        "1"
      );
    }

    renderLocalControls();

    console.log(
      "RECALL LOCAL SHODAN:",
      next === "1"
        ? "ON — LV 1"
        : "OFF"
    );
  }


  // =======================================================
  // INJECT LOCAL PRESENTATION INTO WORKING SHOW REQUESTS
  //
  // This does not replace/remove visitorId.
  // The original TV continues sending its existing game ID.
  // We only add three independent presentation fields.
  // =======================================================

  const nativeFetch =
    window.fetch.bind(
      window
    );


  window.fetch =
    async function (
      input,
      init
    ) {
      let path =
        "";

      if (
        typeof input ===
          "string"
      ) {
        try {
          path =
            new URL(
              input,
              window.location.href
            )
              .pathname;
        } catch {
          path =
            input;
        }
      } else if (
        input &&
        typeof input.url ===
          "string"
      ) {
        try {
          path =
            new URL(
              input.url,
              window.location.href
            )
              .pathname;
        } catch {
          path =
            input.url;
        }
      }


      const localPresentationRoute =
        path ===
          "/show/next" ||
        path ===
          "/show/background-next" ||
        path ===
          "/show/interject";


      if (
        localPresentationRoute &&
        init &&
        typeof init.body ===
          "string"
      ) {
        try {
          const body =
            JSON.parse(
              init.body
            );

          body.localLanguage =
            currentLanguage();

          body.localShodanEnabled =
            currentShodanEnabled();

          body.localShodanLevel =
            currentShodanLevel();

          init = {
            ...init,

            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                body
              )
          };
        } catch {}
      }


      return nativeFetch(
        input,
        init
      );
    };


  // =======================================================
  // MACHINE / BET / EXPORT
  //
  // These are economy/game-state controls, so they still use
  // the EXISTING game identity. They do not participate in
  // Mandarin or SHODAN state.
  // =======================================================

  let economyBusy =
    false;


  async function json(
    path,
    options = {}
  ) {
    const response =
      await nativeFetch(
        path,
        {
          credentials:
            "same-origin",

          cache:
            "no-store",

          ...options,

          headers: {
            "content-type":
              "application/json",

            ...(options.headers || {})
          }
        }
      );

    let payload =
      null;

    try {
      payload =
        await response.json();
    } catch {
      payload =
        null;
    }

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      !payload?.ok
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        payload?.error ||
        (
          "Request failed: " +
          String(
            response.status
          )
        )
      );
    }

    return payload;
  }


  async function refreshEconomy() {
    const visitorId =
      gameVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      /*
       * Do not poison the local Mandarin/SHODAN controls with
       * a visitor-ID error.
       */
      return;
    }

    try {
      const payload =
        await json(
          "/v14/state?visitorId=" +
          encodeURIComponent(
            visitorId
          ),
          {
            method:
              "GET",

            headers:
              {}
          }
        );

      const v14 =
        payload?.v14 ||
        {};

      const machine =
        v14?.machine ||
        {};

      const gold =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            v14?.playerGold ||
            0
          )
        );

      const machineButton =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-machine"
        );

      const machineStatus =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-machine-status"
        );


      if (
        machineButton &&
        machineStatus
      ) {
        if (
          machine.maxed
        ) {
          machineButton.textContent =
            "MACHINE — MAXIMUM";

          machineButton.disabled =
            true;

          machineStatus.textContent =
            "MACHINE LEVEL " +
            numberText(
              machine.level
            );
        } else {
          const price =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                machine.nextPrice ||
                0
              )
            );

          machineButton.textContent =
            "MACHINE LV " +
            numberText(
              machine.level
            ) +
            " → " +
            numberText(
              Number(
                machine.level ||
                0
              ) + 1
            ) +
            " — " +
            numberText(
              price
            ) +
            " GOLD";

          machineButton.disabled =
            economyBusy ||
            gold < price;

          machineStatus.textContent =
            "GOLD " +
            numberText(
              gold
            ) +
            " · NEXT UPGRADE " +
            numberText(
              price
            );
        }
      }


      const betting =
        v14?.betting ||
        {};

      const betState =
        String(
          betting.status ||
          "none"
        );

      const open =
        Boolean(
          betting.windowOpen
        ) &&
        betState === "none";

      const betChoice =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
        );

      const betWager =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
        );

      const betButton =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-bet"
        );

      const betStatus =
        el(
          "recall-v14-clean-bet-status"
        );


      if (betChoice) {
        betChoice.disabled =
          economyBusy ||
          !open;
      }

      if (betWager) {
        betWager.disabled =
          economyBusy ||
          !open;
      }

      if (betButton) {
        betButton.disabled =
          economyBusy ||
          !open;
      }


      if (betStatus) {
        if (
          betState ===
            "locked"
        ) {
          betStatus.textContent =
            "BET LOCKED — " +
            String(
              betting.choice ||
              ""
            )
              .toUpperCase() +
            " — " +
            numberText(
              betting.wager
            ) +
            " GOLD";
        } else if (
          betState ===
            "won"
        ) {
          betStatus.textContent =
            "BET WON — " +
            numberText(
              betting.payout
            ) +
            " GOLD PAID";
        } else if (
          betState ===
            "lost"
        ) {
          betStatus.textContent =
            "BET LOST — " +
            numberText(
              betting.wager
            ) +
            " GOLD";
        } else if (open) {
          betStatus.textContent =
            "BETTING OPEN — GOLD " +
            numberText(
              gold
            );
        } else {
          betStatus.textContent =
            "BETTING CLOSED";
        }
      }
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      console.error(
        "RECALL ECONOMY CONTROL ERROR:",
        error
      );
    }
  }


  async function upgradeMachine() {
    const visitorId =
      gameVisitorId();

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      economyBusy
    ) {
      return;
    }

    economyBusy =
      true;

    try {
      await json(
        "/v14/machine/upgrade",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId
            })
        }
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        error?.message ||
        "MACHINE upgrade failed."
      );
    } finally {
      economyBusy =
        false;

      await refreshEconomy();
    }
  }


  async function placeBet() {
    const visitorId =
      gameVisitorId();

    if (
      !visitorId ||
      economyBusy
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const choice =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet-choice"
      )
        ?.value;

    const wager =
      Math.floor(
        Number(
          el(
            "recall-v14-clean-bet-wager"
          )
            ?.value ||
          0
        )
      );

    if (
      !choice ||
      wager <= 0
    ) {
      showError(
        "Enter a GOLD wager."
      );

      return;
    }

    economyBusy =
      true;

    try {
      await json(
        "/v14/bet",
        {
          method:
            "POST",

          body:
            JSON.stringify({
              visitorId,
              choice,
              wager
            })
        }
      );

      showError(
        ""
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        error?.message ||
        "BET failed."
      );
    } finally {
      economyBusy =
        false;

      await refreshEconomy();
    }
  }


  function exportChat() {
    const visitorId =
      gameVisitorId();

    if (!visitorId) {
      showError(
        "Game identity unavailable for chat export."
      );

      return;
    }

    window.location.href =
      "/v14/export-chat?visitorId=" +
      encodeURIComponent(
        visitorId
      );
  }


  // =======================================================
  // BOOT
  // =======================================================

  function boot() {
    const languageButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-language"
      );

    const shodanButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-shodan"
      );

    const machineButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-machine"
      );

    const betButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-bet"
      );

    const exportButton =
      el(
        "recall-v14-clean-export"
      );


    if (languageButton) {
      languageButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        toggleLanguage,
        true
      );
    }


    if (shodanButton) {
      shodanButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        toggleShodan,
        true
      );
    }


    if (machineButton) {
      machineButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        upgradeMachine
      );
    }


    if (betButton) {
      betButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        placeBet
      );
    }


    if (exportButton) {
      exportButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        exportChat
      );
    }


    /*
     * Defaults:
     * - English presentation.
     * - SHODAN OFF.
     * - SHODAN persona level exists at 1.
     */
    if (
      !readLocal(
        SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY,
        ""
      )
    ) {
      writeLocal(
        SHODAN_LEVEL_KEY,
        "1"
      );
    }


    renderLocalControls();

    /*
     * Delayed economy refresh gives the original television
     * time to initialize its ordinary game identity.
     */
    window.setTimeout(
      () => {
        refreshEconomy()
          .catch(
            () => {}
          );
      },
      1000
    );


    window.setInterval(
      () => {
        if (
          !document.hidden &&
          !economyBusy
        ) {
          refreshEconomy()
            .catch(
              () => {}
            );
        }
      },
      10000
    );
  }


  if (
    document.readyState ===
      "loading"
  ) {
    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      boot,
      {
        once:
          true
      }
    );
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
</script>
`;


// =========================================================
// ABSOLUTE FINAL HTML ASSEMBLER
//
// CRITICAL:
// Start from original HTML.
// Inject ONE clean panel.
// Inject ONE local-presentation script.
//
// Every earlier Mandarin/SHODAN client script is therefore
// absent from the actual served page and cannot flicker or
// overwrite these buttons.
// =========================================================

buildRecallV14FinalHtml =
  function ()
  {
    const source =
      String(
        HTML ||
        ""
      );

    const addition =
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_STYLE +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V14_CLEAN_PANEL_HTML +
      "\n" +
      RECALL_V22_LOCAL_PRESENTATION_SCRIPT;


    if (
      source.includes(
        "</body>"
      )
    ) {
      return source.replace(
        "</body>",
        addition +
        "\n</body>"
      );
    }


    return (
      source +
      "\n" +
      addition
    );
  };


// =========================================================
// FINAL CORS REBIND
// =========================================================

routeRecallV13RequestWithCors =
  async function (
    request,
    env
  ) {
    const response =
      await routeRecallV13Request(
        request,
        env
      );

    if (!response) {
      return null;
    }

    return addCorsToResponse(
      response
    );
  };

//
// =========================================================
// END LOCAL MANDARIN + LOCAL SHODAN FINAL OVERRIDE
// =========================================================
